programme.title: Football Qualifying for SP 2026 / Fudbal Kvalifikacije za SP 2026
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague / Košarka - Euroleague
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The FIBA ​​led the main word in this competition until 2000. when clubs took control of the competition through its association "Eurologue Basketball". The format of the competition changed through history and contained a part of the groups after which elimations in the playoffs followed. The winner of this competition is decided on the final tournament called "Final Four". The most successful clubs of this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathianos, Varese, Olympiacos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja "Eurolegaue Basketball". Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva "Final Four". Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.title: Ples sudbine
programme.desc: Joaquim apologizes to Rafael and Isadora after losing his nerves. After Joaquim's jealous outburst, Rafael thinks of preventing his engagement and steals his engagement rings. Violeta dâ Isadori Elisa's diamond bracelet as a engagement gift. Úrsula dâ ring Joaquimu to try to save the engagement, but at that moment Matias saw Elisa's bracelet and crazy trying to save her daughter in her hallucinations. Violeta begs Eugenia for advice and he tells her that he is still listening to her heart and keeping Matias on the property. Isadora tells Joaquim that he does not want to arrange the date of engagement because he thinks it is too early for their marriage. It angered Joaquim and úrsul. Rafael listens to Joaquim and úrsul how the intrigues against Isadora. / Joaquim se ispriča Rafaelu i Isadori nakon što je izgubio živce. Nakon Joaquimova ljubomornog ispada Rafael razmišlja o tome da spriječi zaruke i ukrade zaručničke prstene. Violeta dâ Isadori Elisinu dijamantnu narukvicu kao zaručnički dar. Úrsula dâ prsten Joaquimu kako bi pokušao spasiti zaruke, ali u tom času Matias ugleda Elisinu narukvicu i poludi pokušavajući spasiti kćer u svojim halucinacijama. Violeta moli Eugenija za savjet i on joj kaže da i dalje sluša svoje srce i zadrži Matiasa na imanju. Isadora kaže Joaquimu da ne želi dogovoriti datum zaruka jer misli da je prerano za njihov brak. To razljuti Joaquima i Úrsulu. Rafael sluša Joaquima i Úrsulu kako spletkare protiv Isadore.

programme.title: Cacau
programme.desc: Susana says to Tomane, Sal and Salomao to believe that Majoris will help her fight Simon. Júlia clashes with Lalá and Simone. He warned them that he would return to his place in the law office and distance Lalá. Regina asked Quim to help her convince Cacau not to return to Brazil because she should support her in the fight against Simon. / Susana kaže Tomaneu, Sal i Salomao da vjeruje da će joj Majoris pomoći u borbi protiv Simone. Júlia se sukobi s Lalá i Simone. Upozori ih da će se vratiti na svoje mjesto u odvjetničkom uredu i udaljiti Lalá. Regina zamoli Quima da joj pomogne uvjeriti Cacau da se ne vraća u Brazil jer je treba kao potporu u borbi protiv Simone.

programme.title: With our home / Kod nas doma
programme.desc: Two talented women, two strong music stories and two new singles! We know one from theater boards and dora, the other from Voice, music studios _ and maybe hospital corridors. Our guest is Irma Dragicevic, and with her Ana Siric! Another interesting series starts on HRT _ Remember to leave a review. What are the hidden sides of Croatian tourism and can social networks and reviews form a reputation of destinations? The answers are made by the authors of the series _ producer Rea Rajcic and director Ivan Grgur. And we also bring news that has delighted fans around the world _ probably the most popular pop star of today, Taylor Swift, has released a new album The Life of a Showgirl. Twelve new songs are already demolishing records, and we bring details about the album and the audience's reactions. / Dvije talentirane žene, dvije snažne glazbene priče i dva nova singla! Jednu poznajemo s kazališnih dasaka i Dore, drugu s Voicea, glazbenih studija _ a možda i bolničkih hodnika. Naša gošća je Irma Dragičević, a s njom i Ana Širić! Na HRT-u počinje još jedan zanimljiv serijal _ Ne zaboravite ostaviti recenziju. Koje su skrivene strane hrvatskog turizma i mogu li društvene mreže i recenzije oblikovati reputaciju destinacija? Odgovore donose autori serijala _ producentica Rea Rajčić i redatelj Ivan Grgur. A donosimo i vijest koja je oduševila fanove diljem svijeta _ vjerojatno najpopularnija pop zvijezda današnjice, Taylor Swift, objavila je novi album The Life of a Showgirl. Dvanaest novih pjesama već ruši rekorde, a mi donosimo detalje o albumu i reakcijama publike.

programme.title: Vijesti iz kulture
programme.desc: Culture news is followed daily events from different areas of culture and art. / Vijesti iz kulture svakodnevno prate događaje iz različitih područja kulture i umjetnosti.

programme.title: Skica za portret
programme.desc: In the form of a short documentary film, the show represents the authors important for Croatian history and culture. / U formi kratkog dokumentarnog filma emisija predstavlja autore važne za hrvatsku povijest i kulturu.

programme.title: Third age / Treća dob
programme.desc: The generation of which we owe the future and which provided us with the present on the International Day of the Elderly "honored" by a decision of the Government, according to which an annual allowance or colloquially called thirteenth pension will be 6 euros per year of service. Shocked and disappointed, as they say with this shameful decision, it is a generation that is difficult to break, and with some inexplicable fervor in the reportage of Višnja Ružojčić, they talk about survival from pension to retirement. With sea stories, we sail further through the Doriana Tikveni story show about people who have won championships and medals in various disciplines in diving. The 91-year-old fisherman who does not leave the passion for fishing, Marko Percan brings us the story. And often neglected retirees and those who care for them were visited by our Split team. / Generacija kojoj dugujemo budućnost i koja je nama osigurala sadašnjost na Međunarodni dan starijih osoba "počašćena" je odlukom Vlade prema kojoj će godišnji dodatak ili kolokvijalno nazvan trinaesta mirovina iznositi 6 eura po godini staža. Šokirani i razočarani, kako kažu ovom sramotnom odlukom, generacija je to koju je teško slomiti, pa s nekim neobjašnjivim žarom u reportaži Višnje Ružojčić govore o preživljavaju od mirovine do mirovine. S morskim pričama plovimo dalje kroz emisiju s pričom Doriane Tikvicki o ljudima koji su u različitim disciplinama u ronjenju osvajali prvenstva i medalje. O 91-godišnjem ribaru kojeg strast za ribarenjem ne napušta, priču nam donosi Marko Percan. A često zanemarene umirovljenike i one o koji njima skrbe, na Visu je posjetila naša splitska ekipa.

programme.title: Dr. Beck
programme.desc: The theme of today's show is the health of the legs. The causes of painful legs can be diverse. Some times this is a common situation and some times alarm signal. / Tema današnje emisije je zdravlje nogu. Uzroci bolnih nogu mogu biti raznoliki. Neki put je to uobičajena situacija, a neki put signal za uzbunu.

programme.title: Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: Lydia's soul feeds the memories of the late neighbor. Dandelion and chickpea salad arouses the memories of picking wild nutrients in nature, which Lidia adored eating in childhood. Sometimes its heat is crucial in the dish, as is the case with "Parmigian" of chicken and eggplant. It is easy to prepare, and will satisfy the classic food for food. Let's prepare dishes that feed the body, mind and soul. / Lidijinu dušu hrane uspomene na pokojne bližnje. Salata od maslačka i slanutka pobuđuje uspomene na branje samoniklog hranjivog bilja u prirodi, koje je Lidia obožavala jesti u djetinjstvu. Katkad je u jelu ključna njegova toplina, kao što je slučaj s "parmigianom" od piletine i patlidžana. Jednostavno se pripremi, a zadovoljit će klasičnu žudnju za hranom. Pripremimo jela koja hrane tijelo, um i dušu.

programme.title: TV kalendar
programme.desc: Documentary-historical show, has been aired daily since 1976. Timing is extremely inconvenient because Margaret expects a television interview with Brian Walden in just a few days. No Brian sve više sumnja u njezinu moć prosudbe. Stanje dodatno eskalira kada ministar financija Nigel Lawson podnese ostavku, čime pokreće krizu u Thatcherinoj vladi. Tajming je krajnje nezgodan jer Margaret za samo nekoliko dana očekuje televizijski intervju s Brianom Waldenom. Ona se, međutim, ne uzbuđuje previše _ uvjerena je da će joj prijatelj pomoći da ponovno pridobije javnost. Ali jesu li oni doista prijatelji?

programme.title: Otvoreno
programme.desc: The second anniversary of the Hamas attack on Israel, when almost 1,200 people were killed and 250 were abducted and taken to Gaza's belt. Israel then launched an attack for the complete destruction of Hamas and tens of thousands of people have been killed in daily shells. In Egypt, the negotiations of Israel and Hamas on the peacekeeping plan of US President Donald Trump. Can two sides reach an agreement, how acceptable is Trump's plan and can the negotiations contribute to the permanent interruption of fire in Gaza? Guests are: Assoc. Ph.D. Đana Luša, Political Science, Faculty of Political Science in Zagreb, Ph.D. Gordan Akrap, Vice -Rector of the University of Defense and Security "Dr. Franjo Tudjman", Hassan Haidar Diab, a journalist of "Vecernji List". / Druga je godišnjica napada Hamasa na Izrael, kada je ubijeno gotovo 1200 ljudi, a 250 oteto i odvedeno u pojas Gaze. Izrael je nakon toga pokrenuo napad za potpuno uništenje Hamasa i od tada su u svakodnevnim granatiranjima ubijeni deseci tisuća ljudi. U Egiptu traju pregovori Izraela i Hamasa o mirovnom planu američkog predsjednika Donalda Trumpa. Mogu li dvije strane postići dogovor, koliko im je Trumpov plan prihvatljiv i mogu li pregovori pridonijeti trajnom prekidu vatre u Gazi? Gosti su: izv. prof. dr. sc. Đana Luša, politologinja, Fakultet političkih znanosti u Zagrebu, dr. sc. Gordan Akrap, prorektor Sveučilišta obrane i sigurnosti "Dr. Franjo Tuđman", Hassan Haidar Diab, novinar "Večernjeg lista".

programme.title: Razgovor s razlogom
programme.desc: Guest is one of the most important and read French writers Leila Slimani. Honestly and without hesitation, he will explain to us why identity perceives as a moral and ethical question. How did she answer the question _ who am I? What detects us more, our social status or national identity? Why was her own family served as an inspiration for the trilogy "in the country of others" and why did she decide to tell that story of Morocco? How to look at the immigrant policy of the European Union and what are the mistakes of integration? Why doesn't it matter that others love her? What is it like to live in the country of others is a question that gives us a reason to talk to Leil Slimani. / Gošća je jedna od najvažnijih i najčitanijih francuskih književnica Leila Slimani. Iskreno i bez zadrške objasnit će nam zašto identit doživljava kao moralno i etičko pitanje. Kako je sebi odgovorila na pitanje _ tko sam ja? Što nas više određuje, naš socijalni status ili nacionalni identitet? Zašto joj je kao inspiracija za trilogiju "U zemlji drugih" poslužila vlastita obitelj i zašto je odlučila ispričati baš tu priču o Maroku? Kako gleda na imigrantsku politiku Europske unije i koje su greške integracije? Zašto joj nije važno da je drugi vole? Kako je živjeti u zemlji drugih, pitanje je koje nam daje razlog za razgovor s Leilom Slimani.

programme.title: Remek-djelo ili zlodjelo
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce and Philip Mould go to North London to meet Glyna Hopkina, a dealer with special affinities towards art. Although the ad is stated that "in the style of Sir Joshue Reynolds", Glyn decided to try his happiness and paid him 2700 pounds. programme.title: Unit 414: witnesses and victims on October 7 / Postrojba 414: Svjedokinje i žrtve 7. listopada
programme.desc: The documentary brings a unique view of the events of October 7, 2023, from the perspective of women who were on the front line at that moment. There were 23. They saw what was preparing and were among the first victims. Today, guards guarding the border with Gaza require the truth to be told and give us the cross -section of today's Israeli society. Bilo ih je 23. Zvali su ih "očima države". Riječ je o jedinici 414 iz vojne baze Nahal Oz. One su upozoravale, ali država ih nije slušala. Vidjele su što se sprema i bile su među prvim žrtvama. Danas stražarice koje čuvaju granicu s Gazom zahtijevaju da se kaže istina i daju nam presjek današnjeg izraelskog društva. Da su ih poslušali, napad 7. listopada mogao se spriječiti. programme.title: In India with Bettany Hughes / U Indiji s Bettany Hughes
programme.desc: The Bettany's trip starts in one of the most tallest cities of the subcontinent _ Varanasia. The amazing palace is decorated with massive marble slabs with inserted rubes, onyx, jade and carnella _ that allegedly served as inspiration for decorations within that mahala. The legendary treasure and monument of love, Taj Mahal, was built in 1632. As a tomb for a favorite woman of the Mogulski Emperor Shah Restrained, Mumtaz Mahal. Bettany goes out in front of a bright white marble structure to reveal the intriguing secret _ how they are neglected and oversetting the world-famous mausoleum once a haven of love and loss. Hindusi vjeruju da smrt u Varanasiju i kremiranje na obalama rijeke Ganges omogućuje da se ciklus ponovnog rađanja prekine, a spasenje ostvari. Fatehpur Sikri zamišljen je kao carska prijestolnica mogulskog cara Akbara. Njegov novi grad bio je veći od Londona, no bio je naseljen samo 14 godina. Bettany istražuje njegove prazne palače, hramove i privatne paviljone _ istovremeno otkrivajući jedinstven svjetonazor čovjeka koji ih je izgradio. Bettany obilazi palače Udaipura. Legendarno blago i spomenik ljubavi, Taj Mahal, izgrađen je je 1632. godine kao grobnica za omiljenu ženu mogulskog cara Shah Jahana, Mumtaz Mahal. Bettany izlazi ispred građevine od blistavo bijelog mramora kako bi otkrila intrigantnu tajnu _ kako su zapušteni i zarasli vrtovi koji okružuju svjetski poznati mauzolej nekoć bili utočišta ljubavi i gubitka. programme.title: In India with Bettany Hughes / U Indiji s Bettany Hughes
programme.desc: The exceptional capital of the Empire of Vijayanagar from the 14th century includes the ruins of the palaces, temples, forts, shrines, halls with colonnades, water channels, guardians, checkpoints and special carriage streets. In this Hindu center of Rama, Rama allegedly met Hanuman for the first time, and the largest monolithic statue of the divinity of Elephant Ganesha was kept. Thanjavur, also known as the Tanjore, became the capital of the Chola Empire, one of the longest -running dynasties in the history of the world in the 8th century. Bettany travels to the heart of the city to reveal an incredible story of these powerful rulers. He explores the Bihadeeswarar Braci Temple from 10th century, and then travels to the nearby town of Swamamalalai, where he discovers divine statues that literally pop out of the mold. Together with the Himalayan rail of Darjeeling and the rail between Kalka and Shimle, the Nilgiri mountain railway is an extraordinary example of an innovative transportation system on uneven and challenging terrain. Bettany enjoys a amazing journey between Mettupalayama and Udhagamandal, a pleasant ride across the Tamil Nadu hill. Arriving at the final destination high in the mountains, he meets a unique people of Toda, who still celebrates the arrival of the train, which has forever changed their way of life. Bettanyno's journey south India takes her to the glittering state of Kerara. There he testifies to the extraordinary dance of Theyattam, typical of this region. The holy dancers visit villages and temples, dressed in rich costumes and vividly colored bodies, and embodies gods and goddesses in music scenes that last all night. Bettanyna an adventure on the Malabar coast ends on one of the famous housing ships. Sailing the channels, she explores the ancient trade of spices that shaped the landscape and the history of India. / Iznimna prijestolnica Carstva Vijayanagara iz 14. stoljeća obuhvaća ruševine palača, hramova, utvrda, svetišta, dvorane s kolonadama, vodene kanale, stražarnice, kontrolne točke i posebne ulice za kočije. U ovom hinduističkom središtu Rama je navodno prvi put susreo Hanumana, a čuva se i najveći monolitni kip božanstva slona Ganesha. Thanjavur, također poznat kao Tanjore, u 8. je stoljeću postao prijestolnica Carstva Chola, jedne od najdugovječnijih dinastija u povijesti svijeta. Bettany putuje u srce grada kako bi otkrila nevjerojatnu priču o ovim moćnim vladarima. Istražuje hram Brihadeeswarar iz 10. stoljeća, a zatim putuje u obližnji gradić Swamimalai, gdje otkriva božanske kipove koji doslovno iskaču iz kalupa. Zajedno s Himalajskom željeznicom Darjeeling i željeznicom između Kalke i Shimle, planinska željeznica Nilgiri izvanredan je primjer inovativnog sustava prijevoza na neravnu i izazovnu terenu. Bettany uživa u zadivljujućem putovanju između Mettupalayama i Udhagamandalama, ugodnoj vožnji preko brežuljaka Tamil Nadua. Stigavši na konačno odredište visoko u planinama, susreće jedinstveni narod Toda, koji još uvijek slavi dolazak vlaka što je zauvijek promijenio njihov način života. Bettanyno putovanje južnom Indijom vodi je u blistavu državu Kerala. Ondje svjedoči izvanrednom plesu theyattam, tipičnom za ovu regiju. programme.title: Legende o Zemlji
programme.desc: According to ancient philosophy, four basic elements intersection create our planet. One of them is a country. She has created exceptional places that have always enchanted and confusing a man, wonderful landscapes like Feroj islands and a centuries -old species like the Palma Lodoice Maldivica from Seychelles or California sequins. In this sequel, legends and science help explain the origin and beauty of these unusual landscapes. / Prema antičkoj filozofiji, četiri osnovna elementa međudjelovanjem stvaraju naš planet. Jedan je od njih zemlja. Stvorila je iznimna mjesta koja oduvijek očaravaju i zbunjuju čovjeka, čudesne krajolike poput Ferojskih otoka i stoljetne vrste poput palme Lodoicea maldivica sa Sejšela ili kalifornijskih sekvoja. U ovom nastavku legende i znanost pomažu objasniti postanak i ljepotu tih neobičnih krajolika.

But suddenly he finds himself in a very dangerous cat and mouse game when his computer scientist Ed begins to use his skills to stalk Mike's daughter and threatens his family, work and life very quickly. In a world where there is no privacy, Mike must rely on her old relationships to beat a new type of enemy ... / Mike Regan je poduzetnik koji ima sve: divnu suprugu, lijepu mladu kćer i otmjeni moderni dom. No iznenada se nađe u izrazito opasnoj igru mačke i miša kada njegov informatičar Ed počinje upotrebljavati svoje vještine za uhođenje Mikeove kćeri i vrlo brzo ugrozi njegovu obitelj, posao i život. U svijetu gdje nema privatnosti, Mike se mora osloniti na svoje stare veze kako bi pobijedio novu vrstu neprijatelja...

programme.title: Inspektor Lynley
programme.desc: Lynley and Havers go into the bizarre world of online vice: they explore the violent and unusual death of young lawyer Emily Prctor. While exposing the layers of her life, they find out that four months ago she quit at Tony Wainwright's office and started working for her older sister Lisa on her pornographic channel on the Internet. Further investigation detectives came to Robert Tanner who contacted Emily and threatened her. There is also a abuse in the Proctor family and the death of Wainwright's fiancée. While Lynley faces a sharp lawyer and victim's lover, Haver visits her mentor, retired detective Robert Mills, whom she has not seen for 15 years. He entrusts him with his concerns about the case, but soon doubts the real reasons for his arrival. / Lynley i Havers zalaze u bizaran svijet internetskih poroka: istražuju nasilnu i neobičnu smrt mlade odvjetnice Emily Proctor. Dok razotkrivaju slojeve njezina života, doznaju da je prije četiri mjeseca dala otkaz u uredu Tonyja Wainwrighta i počela raditi za stariju sestru Lisu na njezinu pornografskom kanalu na internetu. Daljnjom istragom detektivi dođu do Roberta Tannera koji je kontaktirao Emily i prijetio joj. Otkrije se i zlostavljanje u obitelji Proctor te smrt Wainwrightove zaručnice. Dok se Lynley suočava s oštrim odvjetnikom i žrtvinim ljubavnikom, Havers posjeti njezin mentor, umirovljeni detektiv Robert Mills kojeg nije vidjela 15 godina. Povjeri mu svoje nedoumice glede slučaja, ali uskoro posumnja u stvarne razloge njegova dolaska.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: A month has passed since his grandfather's death and no family member is worn well with a loss. At the urging of a friend, Murray reluctantly tries to help the family go to the next step in the mourning process. Unexpectedly, the Goldbergs find themselves on a hilarious, bitter-sweet, but in the end with a cheerful daily excursion to spill his grandfather's ashes in his favorite place. By the way we pay tribute to the legendary 80s movie, "Bill and Teds Excellent Adventure." The themes of this classic comedy perfectly reflect the way the grandfather lived, "Be great to each other" and, of course, "It's time for a party!" / Prošlo je mjesec dana od djedove smrti i nijedan član obitelji ne nosi se dobro s gubitkom. Na nagovor prijatelja, Murray nevoljko pokuša pomoći obitelji da prijeđu na sljedeći korak u procesu žalovanja. Neočekivano, Goldbergovi se nađu na urnebesnom, gorko-slatkom, ali na kraju veselom dnevnom izletu kako bi prosuli djedov pepeo na njegovu omiljenu mjestu. Usput odajemo počast legendarnom filmu iz 80-ih, "Bill And Teds Excellent Adventure." Teme te klasične komedije savršeno odražavaju način na koji je djed živio: "Budite sjajni jedni prema drugima" i, naravno, "Vrijeme je za tulum!"

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: When they put it on the pending list for college, Adam tries, with Beverly help, find a way to enroll and achieve his dream. programme.desc: When Geoff sees that Beverly and Erica are arguing around the wedding organization, he decides to be a good fiancé and help Eric, but only worsens the situation. Kada Barry dozna da se vodeni park koji su posjećivali u djetinjstvu zatvara, traži od Adama da mu pomogne da spriječi zatvaranje.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: An inspired humorous series The Wonder Years, this is a classic teenage story about errors and maturation. When Adam ruin the recording of the important matches of American football, the Deputy Director of the School help him see how he can offer a lot to other students. When Neighbor Goldberg puts his house for sale, Beverly and Murray see the perfect new home in her after their children were moving away. Kad Adam upropasti snimku važne utakmice američkog nogometa, zamjenik ravnatelj škole pomogne mu da uvidi kako može puno ponuditi drugim đacima. Kad susjed Goldbergovih stavi svoju kuću na prodaju, Beverly i Murray u njoj vide savršen novi dom nakon što im se djeca odsele. Ali ubrzo će shvatiti da, iako se kuća čini savršenom, već imaju savršen dom.

programme.title: Escape to the interior / Bijeg u unutrašnjost
programme.desc: In search of inspiration in the magnificent landscape of northern Yorkshire, Buckinghamshire friends are enthusiastic about the Counts and a series of houses that Nicki Chapman shows them. Nicki also visits a painter who almost completely renewed her beautiful old farm and turned it into a peculiar refuge for artists. / U potrazi za inspiracijom u veličanstvenom krajoliku Sjevernog Yorkshirea, prijateljice iz Buckinghamshirea oduševljene su grofovijom i nizom kuća koje im pokazuje Nicki Chapman. Nicki također posjećuje slikaricu koja je gotovo u potpunosti sama obnovila prelijepu staru farmu i pretvorila je u osebujno utočište za umjetnike.

programme.title: The Wonderful World of Design - Australia / Čudesni svijet dizajna - Australija
programme.desc: How to turn the small, dilapidated Working House in the middle of a densely populated Sydney suburbs into a beautiful, self -sustaining home? Is that really impossible? For seven years, seven architects, 15 water specialists, 10 solar experts, 3 sustainability experts, two legalists and 1 one project manager Laura assured that the idea was impossible for her. But Laura still, with a budget of $ 900,000 and a 4 -month -old period, went into impossible. The house finally began to be built. The construction was accompanied by problems from the very beginning, from completely technical, financial to administrative _ even the local council rejected her request to install solar panels toward the street. Maybe the house is impossible to build. / Kako malu, oronulu radničku kuću usred gusto naseljenog sydneyskog predgrađa pretvoriti u prekrasan, samoodrživ dom? Je li to doista nemoguće? Sedam godina su sedam arhitekata, 15 specijalista za vodu, 10 solarnih eksperata, 3 stručnjaka za održivost, dva legalista i 1 jedan voditelj projekata Lauru uvjeravali da joj je ideja neizvediva. Ali Laura je ipak, s budžetom od 900.000 $ i rokom od 4 mjeseca, krenula u neizvedivo. Kuća se napokon počela graditi. Gradnju su od samog početka pratili problemi, od posve tehničkih, novčanih do administrativnih _ čak joj je i mjesno vijeće odbilo molbu za postavljanje solarnih panela prema ulici. Možda je kuću ipak nemoguće sagraditi.

programme.title: Patina Mexican dishes / Patina meksička jela
programme.desc: Pati Jinich wanders the vibrant streets of the capital Yucatán, Meride, looking for local specialties. The Wayane Restaurant will taste "the best Tacose in Merida". U restoranu Wayane kušat će "najbolje tacose u Meridi". Miris tek pečenih kolačića namamit će je u Donde Fabric, bez čijih su globitosa i bizcochitosa jutra u Meridi nezamisliva.

programme.title: Vrtlarski klub Alana Titchmarsha
programme.desc: Alan leads us through our garden, showing the splendor of colors and seasonal flowers and helps the tips to grow the beautiful flower garden ourselves. Giovanna Fletcher is a new face of the series and in her debut invites us to our own garden as he talks about her personal gardening path and the joy of breeding herbs. programme.title: Unit 414: witnesses and victims on October 7 / Postrojba 414: Svjedokinje i žrtve 7. listopada
programme.desc: The documentary brings a unique view of the events of October 7, 2023, from the perspective of women who were on the front line at that moment. There were 23. They were called "the eyes of the state." It is a unit 414 from Nahal Oz military base. They warned, but the state did not listen to them. They saw what was preparing and were among the first victims. Today, guards guarding the border with Gaza require the truth to be told and give us the cross -section of today's Israeli society. If they had listened to them, the attack on October 7 could be prevented. Listening to their story, we are talking about the attack, of the training of Hamas's attackers to which they testified, the failures of the Israeli secret service and the Government, the fate of hostages, and the present lines of tension in Israeli society, especially the role of women in the military. / Dokumentarni film donosi jedinstven pogled na događaje od 7. listopada 2023., iz perspektive žena koje su u tom trenutku bile na prvoj crti. Bilo ih je 23. Zvali su ih "očima države". Riječ je o jedinici 414 iz vojne baze Nahal Oz. One su upozoravale, ali država ih nije slušala. Vidjele su što se sprema i bile su među prvim žrtvama. Danas stražarice koje čuvaju granicu s Gazom zahtijevaju da se kaže istina i daju nam presjek današnjeg izraelskog društva. Da su ih poslušali, napad 7. listopada mogao se spriječiti. Slušajući njihovu priču, govorimo o napadu, o obuci Hamasovih napadača kojoj su svjedočile, o propustima izraelske tajne službe i vlade, o sudbini talaca te sadašnjim linijama napetosti u izraelskom društvu, osobito o ulozi žena u vojsci.

Iza sebe je ostavio veliki umjetnički opus i na tisuće stranica osobnog dnevnika koji je vodio do smrti. Njegova djela su izložena u svim relevantnim svjetskim muzejima _ od Francuske, Japana, Belgije, Velike Britanije, Njemačke, Švicarske, preko SAD-a i Kanade. programme.title: In India with Bettany Hughes / U Indiji s Bettany Hughes
programme.desc: The exceptional capital of the Empire of Vijayanagar from the 14th century includes the ruins of the palaces, temples, forts, shrines, halls with colonnades, water channels, guardians, checkpoints and special carriage streets. In this Hindu center of Rama, Rama allegedly met Hanuman for the first time, and the largest monolithic statue of the divinity of Elephant Ganesha was kept. Thanjavur, also known as the Tanjore, became the capital of the Chola Empire, one of the longest -running dynasties in the history of the world in the 8th century. Bettany travels to the heart of the city to reveal an incredible story of these powerful rulers. He explores the Bihadeeswarar Braci Temple from 10th century, and then travels to the nearby town of Swamamalalai, where he discovers divine statues that literally pop out of the mold. Together with the Himalayan rail of Darjeeling and the rail between Kalka and Shimle, the Nilgiri mountain railway is an extraordinary example of an innovative transportation system on uneven and challenging terrain. Bettany enjoys a amazing journey between Mettupalayama and Udhagamandal, a pleasant ride across the Tamil Nadu hill. Arriving at the final destination high in the mountains, he meets a unique people of Toda, who still celebrates the arrival of the train, which has forever changed their way of life. Bettanyno's journey south India takes her to the glittering state of Kerara. There he testifies to the extraordinary dance of Theyattam, typical of this region. The holy dancers visit villages and temples, dressed in rich costumes and vividly colored bodies, and embodies gods and goddesses in music scenes that last all night. Bettanyna an adventure on the Malabar coast ends on one of the famous housing ships. Sailing the channels, she explores the ancient trade of spices that shaped the landscape and the history of India. / Iznimna prijestolnica Carstva Vijayanagara iz 14. stoljeća obuhvaća ruševine palača, hramova, utvrda, svetišta, dvorane s kolonadama, vodene kanale, stražarnice, kontrolne točke i posebne ulice za kočije. U ovom hinduističkom središtu Rama je navodno prvi put susreo Hanumana, a čuva se i najveći monolitni kip božanstva slona Ganesha. Thanjavur, također poznat kao Tanjore, u 8. je stoljeću postao prijestolnica Carstva Chola, jedne od najdugovječnijih dinastija u povijesti svijeta. Bettany putuje u srce grada kako bi otkrila nevjerojatnu priču o ovim moćnim vladarima. Istražuje hram Brihadeeswarar iz 10. stoljeća, a zatim putuje u obližnji gradić Swamimalai, gdje otkriva božanske kipove koji doslovno iskaču iz kalupa. Zajedno s Himalajskom željeznicom Darjeeling i željeznicom između Kalke i Shimle, planinska željeznica Nilgiri izvanredan je primjer inovativnog sustava prijevoza na neravnu i izazovnu terenu. Bettany uživa u zadivljujućem putovanju između Mettupalayama i Udhagamandalama, ugodnoj vožnji preko brežuljaka Tamil Nadua. Stigavši na konačno odredište visoko u planinama, susreće jedinstveni narod Toda, koji još uvijek slavi dolazak vlaka što je zauvijek promijenio njihov način života. Bettanyno putovanje južnom Indijom vodi je u blistavu državu Kerala. Ondje svjedoči izvanrednom plesu theyattam, tipičnom za ovu regiju. Sveti plesači obilaze sela i hramove, odjeveni u bogate kostime i živopisno obojenih tijela, te utjelovljuju bogove i boginje u glazbenim prizorima koji traju cijelu noć. Bettanyna avantura na Malabarskoj obali završava na jednom od poznatih brodova za stanovanje. Ploveći kanalima ona istražuje drevnu trgovinu začinima koja je oblikovala krajolik i povijest Indije.

Zabrinutost pojačaju i zle glasine koje dovode u pitanje reputaciju mladog župnika, za kojeg se sumnja da je bio u ljubavnoj vezi sa žrtvom. Niz otkrića odvest će istražitelje u potragu za bratom volonterke koji je bio u lošim odnosima sa sestrom, a viđen je na mjestu zločina i otad je nestao. programme.desc: Today we will be about old _ in a new way. We will also talk about gifted people who have been able to find inspiration in what is daily to create something new and unique. programme.title: As it is said / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The HTV Education and Science Department, in cooperation with the Croatian Language Institute, has recorded thirty videos in which, in addition to linguistic advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language such as the language of young people and foreign words in the Croatian language are addressed. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Stokavian and Chakavian dialects and unusual names of the place, but also of the frequent and unusual personal names. The head of the interview is the Croatian language professor Katarina Marjanovic, who gives numerous followers on Instagram. Her interviewees are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijevic, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidovic, Ivana Kurtovic Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. The show was realized by Danijela Ivancevic, Ana Radmilovic, Robert Cecelj, Alan Stankovic and Viktor Nenadic and Branimir Volf with the support of colleagues from the web HRT department Ive Hren and Matko Svarc and Tomislav Mrsic and Maja Fišter. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec. Emisiju su realizirali Danijela Ivančević, Ana Radmilović, Robert Cecelja, Alan Stanković i Viktor Nenadić i Branimira Volf uz potporu kolega iz Odjela Web HRT-a Ive Hren i Matka Švarca te Tomislava Mršića i Maje Fišter.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon is a cute little rabbit that foists the vitalness of childhood. In age, when small bunnies (like small children) are studying in people and experience challenges in relation to their parents, they move to school, learn generally about the world, they face authorities and, of course, learn their language. Children can take Simon for an example of taking care of himself, I can learn from him and from his incompetents, from situations where simon needs to give in in his insistence and spoiling, and always remain polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on books Stephanie Blake in the edition of the French publisher Lecole des loisirs. He was directed by the TV series Julien Cayot, and it was produced by Go-N Productions. The series in France had Prime Minister 17. December 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. U svojim njedrima Velebit čuva zaštićeno područje Nacionalnoga parka Sjeverni Velebit s posebno lijepim Vučjakom, Velikim i Malim Zavižanom i Kozjakom. Hajdučki kukovi, s Rožanskim, strogi je rezervat prirode stjenovitih vrhova međusobno odvojenih dubokim ponikvama i provalijama, u sebi kriju Lukinu jamu. Od Zavižana prema južnom Velebitu slijedimo od kamena u kamenu, vijugavu Premužićevu stazu. Provlačeći se uskim kanjonima, gustim šumama i zaravnima nabrojit će 57 kilometara. Velebit je sa zaštićena 2274 četvorna kilometra najveće, ali i najvažnije endemsko čvorište flore i kopnene faune u Hrvatskoj. Preko Alančića dolazimo do prijelaza Velikog Alana, razdjelnice i granice sjevernog i srednjeg Velebita. Najdominantnija u srednjem Velebitu, Šatorina s livadnom zaravni dominira nad koritastom mističnom i drevnom Štirovačom i Klepinom dulibom. Ovdje se stoljetne šume smreke prošarane jelama i bukvama rađaju, stare i umiru bez utjecaja čovjeka. Preko Budakova brda dolazimo do 10 kilometara dugih Dabarskih kukova, predvođenih Bačić kukom. Kukove prate duboke koritaste udoline, dabrovi. Kraj Dabarskih kukova i završetak Premužićeve staze dovodi nas do prirodne razdjelnice Baških Oštarija i važne komunikacije između Karlobaga i Gospića. Starom drevnom Terezijanom prelazimo u krševitiji južni Velebit. Vijencem Groba, nazubljenih, kamenih vrhova letimo iznad Visočice, ogledala najvećega ličkoga grada Gospića. Ribničkim vratima i Javornikom dolazimo do drugoga zaštićenog područja, NP Paklenice. Sveto brdo kao mitski čuvar s dva lica dominira nad južnim Velebitom. Orijentir je pastiru, planinaru i putniku od Like pa sve do mora. Majstorska cesta lijeno vijuga pokraj crkve sv. Franje, preko Tulovih greda i Malog Alana i spaja Obrovac i Sveti Rok. Ovdje počinje jugoistočni Velebit. Kršovitim i surovijim putem preko novije izgrađene ceste Obrovac _ Gračac, dolazimo do usamljenog Crnopca koji u sebi krije Cerovačke špilje. Ispod južnih obronaka Velebita izviru rijeke Krnjeze koja se nakon 600 m predaje Krupi, a nakon 10 kilometara i ona se predaje Zrmanji kojom dolazimo do granice Parka prirode Velebit.

programme.desc: In 1935. The British Group led by high diplomat and writer Robert Conway (R. Colman) from the Chinese city of Baskula is fleeing the aircraft before the revolution. After the aircraft collapses on the Himalayas, the survivors will be found in Tibet, where help provide them with Buddhist priests. They take them to Shangri-La, an idyllic valley that exists in the middle of the mountains under the snow. With his companions, Brother George (J. Howard), Tuberculosis Glorio Stone, Paleontologist Alexander P. Lovetto (Everett Hortar), Robert will reveal extremely quiet and carefree life in the valley, and with conversations with high Lama (S. Jaffe) meet the girl Sondru Bizet (J. Wyatt) ... / Godine 1935. skupina Britanaca predvođena visokim diplomatom i piscem Robertom Conwayom (R. Colman) iz kineskog grada Baskula zrakoplovom bježi pred revolucijom koja se već valja ulicama. Nakon što se zrakoplov sruši na Himalaji, preživjeli putnici naći će se u Tibetu, gdje će im pomoć pružiti budistički svećenici. Oni ih odvode u Shangri-La, idiličnu dolinu koja postoji usred planina pod snijegom. Sa svojim suputnicima, bratom Georgeom (J. Howard), tuberkuloznom prostitutkom Gloriom Stone (I. Jewell), paleontologom Alexanderom P. Lovettom (E. Everett Horton) i zagonetnim Henryjem Barnardom (T. Mitchell), Robert će otkriti izuzetno miran i bezbrižan život u dolini, te uz razgovore s visokim lamom (S. Jaffe) upoznati i djevojku Sondru Bizet (J. Wyatt)...

programme.title: What is a classic? / Što je klasik?
programme.desc: Welcome to the anniversary season of the show seeking the holy grail of the art of words, the show in which the world is not a screen but a text! We are just entering the tenth year of searching to answer the question of what a classic is. From the moment when someone in Mesopotamia on a clay tile engraved the first signs of a king seeking immortality, the world became written. Words became the boundaries of empires, prayers to the gods, calls for the rebellion and the beacons of hope. Stories form civilizations, change history. They change us. Her power is aware of our tonight's guest, Harvard Professor Martin Puchner, who claims that she shapes people, history and civilization. / Dobro došli u obljetničku sezonu emisije koja traži sveti gral umjetnosti riječi, emisije u kojoj svijet nije ekran, nego tekst! Upravo ulazimo u desetu godinu traganja za odgovorom na pitanje što je klasik. Od trenutka kada je netko u Mezopotamiji na glinenu pločicu urezao prve znakove o kralju koji traži besmrtnost, svijet je postao pisan. Riječi su postale granice carstava, molitve bogovima, pozivi na pobunu i svjetionici nade. Priče oblikuju civilizacije, mijenjaju povijest. Mijenjaju nas. Njezine je moći svjestan naš večerašnji gost, harvardski profesor Martin Puchner, koji tvrdi da ona oblikuje ljude, povijest i civilizaciju.

programme.title: In search of actor Negromante - Pero Kvrgic / U potrazi za glumcem Negromantom - Pero Kvrgić
programme.desc: The show recorded on the occasion of the 80th birthday of the great actor Pere Kvrgic (1927 _ 2020). This excellent Negromant-Glumac-Carobnjak always poured the theater mirror to the audience, so that she would be reflected in his dramatic characters. Wishing with "light blood and lordship a quiet night and a good day," he always knew how to smiling mockingly, alluding to the time we live in. He was born on March 4, 1927 in Moravica. Of all the drama heroes played by Pero Kvrgic, the role of the sweep in the play "Dundo Maroje", directed by Mladen Škiljan in 1955, has been embodied in it. Pero Kvrgic had a Harlekina costume and a mask with a caricated long nose in the first Pomet scene and thus costly the essential parts of Negromante text. He brought the actors procession to the scene with thin ropes. In this way, a actor, wizard, a larch and a sage, who will reveal to the audience, united the secret about the right and false people of the people, "praised" and "naming" in this way. / Emisija snimljena u povodu 80. rođendana velikog glumca Pere Kvrgića (1927. _ 2020.). Ovaj vrsni negromant-glumac-čarobnjak uvijek je publici podmetao kazališno zrcalo, kako bi se ona ogledala u njegovim dramskim likovima. Zaželjevši "svijetloj krvi i gospodstvu mirnu noć i dobar dan", uvijek se znao podrugljivo nasmiješiti, aludirajući na vrijeme u kojem živimo. Rođen je 4. ožujka 1927. u Moravicama. Od svih dramskih junaka koje je Pero Kvrgić odigrao ističe se uloga Pometa u predstavi "Dundo Maroje", u režiji Mladena Škiljana 1955. U njoj se Držićev negromant Dugi Nos utjelovio u liku Pometa. Pero Kvrgić je u prvom Pometovom prizoru imao harlekinski kostim i masku s karikiranim dugim nosom i tako kostimiran govorio bitne dijelove Negromantova teksta. Tankim konopcima dovukao je na scenu povorku glumaca. Na taj se način u Negromantu sjedinio glumac, čarobnjak, lakrdijaš i mudrac, koji će publici otkriti tajnu o pravim i lažnim ljudima _ o ljudima "nahvao" i ljudima "nazbilj".

programme.title: Austrijska gorska sela
programme.desc: From Kaning through Feld Am See, Africa and Fresach to Arriach, we encounter farmers to whom the life of the peasants is innate, as well as caterers who are sustainability and natural food from their region of equivalent to the quality of life. At the Arriachu Climate Spa on the southeast slopes of Nock's highlands, we get an insight into the daily challenges of a passionate hunter and a farmer. Despite the uniqueness of each individual village, their inhabitants are a common connection with nature, a family community and a love of work. / Od Kaninga preko Feld am Seea, Afritza i Fresacha do Arriacha, susrećemo poljodjelce kojima je život seljaka urođen, kao i ugostitelje kojima su održivost i prirodna hrana iz njihova kraja istoznačnice za kvalitetu života. U klimatskom lječilištu Arriachu na jugoistočnim obroncima gorja Nock dobivamo uvid u svakodnevne izazove jednog strastvenog lovca i poljodjelca. Unatoč jedinstvenosti svakog pojedinog sela, njihovim stanovnicima zajednička je povezanost s prirodom, obiteljsko zajedništvo i ljubav prema radu.

programme.title: It's time for jazz / Vrijeme je za jazz
programme.desc: The tenth edition of the Fest Jazz Koprivnica Festival in 2024 hosted a hundred musicians from Croatia, Slovenia, Austria, Italy, and even from Australia. A rich music program included concerts in the Hall of the Koprivnica Youth Hall, a music program and socializing in Jazz Garden, the Jutarnji Jazz Program, Concerts and Jam Sessione at the MMC ball club, the Vinilija Gramophon Ploče Fair, and a music workshop for children. The festival began with a concert by the Slovenian Big Band Radlje, followed by the performance of the brothers band, Tamara Obrovac Transhistria Ensemble, the Virje Wind Orchestra, Zvonimir Sestak Groove Assembly, and Brekky Boy Trio Electronic Jazz Trio from Sydney. / Deseto izdanje festivala Fest jazza Koprivnica 2024. godine ugostilo je stotinjak glazbenika iz Hrvatske, Slovenije, Austrije, Italije, pa čak i iz Australije. Bogat glazbeni program obuhvatio je koncerte u dvorani Doma mladih Koprivnica, glazbeni program i druženje u Jazz gardenu, Jutarnji jazz program, koncerte i jam sessione u klubu Mmc Kugla, sajam gramofonskih ploča Vinilija, te glazbene radionice za djecu. Festival je započeo koncertom slovenskog Big Banda Radlje, uslijedio je nastup sastava Brothers, Tamara Obrovac Transhistria ensemblea, Puhački orkestar Virje, Zvonimir Šestak Groove Assembly, te Brekky Boy Trio elektronički jazz trio iz Sydneya.

programme.title: Ćiribirci
programme.desc: In the documentary "Ćiribirje" Tanja Kanceljak we will lead you through perhaps the least known part of Croatia. Cyribrians or Istor -Romania are a small linguistic group living in Istria. In the north, we will meet the Ciribirians in the village of Zejana, while on the southern slopes of Učka they live in Susnjevica and the surrounding villages. The Zupan people say they speak the female, and in Susnjevica they say they speak Vlach. Despite the small differences, we can say that it is one language, Istor -Romanian. But they have a common origin that has not yet been sufficiently explored. The version is many. The most likely one is that they arrived in Istria in the 14th century, fleeing in front of the Turks. Ciriberians were cattlemen and nomads, and over the centuries they merged with the local population. They brought with them a language that, although without a written trace, has remained in everyday use to this day. Interestingly, the speakers of the Istrorumanjski do not feel a minority or the Romanian diaspora, declared either Croats or regionally. According to UNESCO data, there are about a thousand Ciribirians in the world today, while only two hundred are left in Croatia. Apart from a few poems and traditions of bell -winning in Žejan, they do not have their own literature and art. They were left only language and they are a great and significant specialty for Istria and Croatia today. In the documentary Fima "Ciriborica", recorded in 2006, a life of people are shown that many in Croatia do not know exist. The team of Croatian Television toured them from oblivion. / U dokumentarnom filmu "Ćiribirci" Tanje Kanceljak provest ćemo vas kroz možda najmanje poznati dio Hrvatske. Ćiribirci ili Istrorumunji mala su jezična skupina koja živi u Istri. Na sjeveru ćemo Ćiribirce susresti u selu Žejane, dok na južnim padinama Učke žive u Šušnjevici i okolnim selima. Žejanci kažu kako govore žejanski, a u Šušnjevici kažu kako govore vlaški. Unatoč malim razlikama, možemo reći kako je to jedan jezik, istrorumunjski. No zajedničko im je porijeklo koje još uvijek nije dovoljno istraženo. Verzija je mnogo. Najvjerojatnija je ona da su u Istru stigli u 14. stoljeću bježeći pred Turcima. Ćiribirci su bili stočari i nomadi, a tijekom stoljeća stopili su se s domaćim stanovništvom. Sa sobom su donijeli jezik koji je, iako bez pisanog traga, i do danas ostao u svakodnevnoj uporabi. Zanimljivo je da se govornici istrorumunjskog ne osjećaju manjinom, ali niti rumunjskom dijasporom, deklariraju se ili kao Hrvati ili regionalno. Prema podacima UNESCO-a, Ćiribiraca u svijetu danas ima oko tisuću, dok ih je u Hrvatskoj ostalo samo dvjestotinjak. Osim nekoliko pjesama i tradicije zvončarstva u Žejanama, oni nemaju svoju književnost i umjetnost. Ostao im je jedino jezik i oni su danas za Istru i Hrvatsku velika i značajna posebnost. U dokumentarnom fimu "Ćiribirci", snimljenom 2006., prikazan je život ljudi za koje mnogi u Hrvatskoj i ne znaju da postoje. Od zaborava ih je istrgnula ekipa Hrvatske televizije.

programme.title: Izvan formata
programme.desc: There is a magazine in Croatia where you will not find a single advertisement, a magazine whose texts are read several times, and each copy is kept on shelves among books. Tonight we talk about a project called "Kàko" tonight, which brings us back to the time when we enjoyed texts that require dedication and attention _ texts that bring stories about creative individuals, guardians of tradition, social phenomena and amazing places. In the studio, we talk to Nives Bosniak, Magazine editor, and Ivan Blagajic, the driver of this unique project. Vid Baric, Lucija Tunkovic, Kristina Gavran and Alen Maric also participate in the show. / U Hrvatskoj postoji magazin u kojem nećete naći ni jednu reklamu, magazin čiji se tekstovi čitaju više puta, a svaki primjerak čuva se na policama među knjigama. Večeras u emisiji razgovaramo o projektu pod nazivom "Kàko", koji nas vraća u vremena kad smo uživali u tekstovima koji zahtijevaju posvećenost i pažnju _ tekstovima koji donose priče o kreativnim pojedincima, čuvarima tradicije, društvenim fenomenima i začudnim mjestima. U studiju razgovaramo s Nives Bošnjak, urednicom magazina, i Ivanom Blagajićem, pokretačem ovog jedinstvenog projekta. U emisiji sudjeluju i Vid Barić, Lucija Tunković, Kristina Gavran i Alen Marić.

programme.title: Groznica
programme.desc: The episode explores that these glittering goods have shaped the foundations of many economies and that the dedicated search for it influenced the course of human history. From the minatersraSrand pool from the mining flourishing, where 40 % of the world gold, to the "Golden Mili" mine in Western Australia, has been excavated, we explore that the search for gold has transformed landscapes and communities. From its beginnings and key roles in ancient civilizations, to the future of gold excavation in the ocean, and amateur hunters on gold that continue to be enriched, we explore why gold drives us to move the borders and exploration of new appetizers in our continuous search for this precious metal. / Epizoda istražuje kako je ova svjetlucava roba oblikovala temelje mnogih ekonomija te kako je predano traganje za njom utjecalo na tijek ljudske povijesti. Od rudarskog procvata u bazenu Witwatersrand, gdje je iskopano 40 % svjetskog zlata, do rudnika "Zlatne milje" u zapadnoj Australiji, istražujemo kako je potraga za zlatom preoblikovala krajolike i zajednice. Od svojih početaka i ključne uloge u drevnim civilizacijama, do budućnosti iskapanja zlata u oceanu te amaterskih lovaca na zlato koji se i dalje uspijevaju obogatiti, istražujemo zašto nas zlato tjera na pomicanje granica i istraživanje novih predjela u našoj neprekidnoj potrazi za tim dragocjenim metalom.

programme.title: Eternal Comedy cycle: Funny things happened on the way to forum / Vječni ciklus komedije: Smiješne su se stvari dogodile na putu za forum
programme.desc: The most common slave in ancient Rome pseudolous (Z. Mostel) is just accompanying his lord Senex (M. Hordern) and his wife Domin (P. Jessel) on a shorter trip outside the city, hoping that the moment has finally arrived to gain long -desired freedom. The road to her leads him through Senex's son Hero (M. Crawford), a mad in love with beautiful slave Philia (A. Andre). But her owner, an early Lycus (P. Silvers), who in the neighborhood he runs a lucrative job of trading young women, promised her to the war hero Miles Gloriosus (L. Greene). The pseudolous therefore proposes an unhappy in love with Herou firmly a firm agreement: The pseudolous will do his best to get Hero to his beloved Philia despite Lycus' promise, and the young slave will give him freedom in return. The cunning slave soon convinced Lycus that Philia had an infectious disease and when everything was done to flow according to plan, Senex suddenly returned to the city and very prone to a rabbit slave ... / Najljeniji rob u starom Rimu Pseudolous (Z. Mostel) upravo ispraća svog gospodara Senexa (M. Hordern) i njegovu suprugu Dominu (P. Jessel) na kraće putovanje izvan grada iskreno se nadajući da je napokon stigao trenutak da stekne dugo priželjkivanu slobodu. Put ga do nje vodi preko Senexova sina Heroa (M. Crawford), ludo zaljubljenog u lijepu robinju Philiju (A. Andre). No, njezin ju je vlasnik, prijetvorni Lycus (P. Silvers) koji u susjedstvu vodi unosan posao trgovanja mladim ženama, još otprije obećao ratnom junaku Milesu Gloriousu (L. Greene). Pseudolous stoga predloži nesretno zaljubljenom Herou čvrst dogovor: Pseudolous će učiniti sve kako bi Hero unatoč Lycusovom obećanju došao do voljene Philije, a mladi će mu robovlasnik zauzvrat dati slobodu. Lukavi rob ubrzo uvjeri Lycusa da Philia ima zaraznu bolest i kad se učini da sve teče po planu, u grad se iznenada vrati Senex i sam vrlo sklon zanosnoj robinji...

programme.title: Simpsoni
programme.desc: After a ruthless interest arrives at Springfield, Homer's and Nes' life begins to resemble a praised crime. / Nakon što nemilosrdni kamatar stigne u Springfield, Homerov i Nedov život počinje nalikovati na hvaljeni krimić.

programme.title: Nitram
programme.desc: The film deals with the life and behavior of a mentally disturbed young man with nitra (based on Martin Bryant) and events that led to his participation in the Masakra at Port Arthur in Tasmania in 1996. In the mid-1990s, he lived with his mother and father in the suburbs in Australia. He is isolated and frustrated and fails to fit into society. This lasts until an unexpected friend of the withdrawn heir to Helen. However, when that connection is tragically ends and nitram's loneliness and anger start to grow, he slowly falls into a spiral leading to the disaster. / Film se bavi životom i ponašanjem mentalno poremećenog mladića Nitrama (temeljenog na Martinu Bryantu) i događajima koji su doveli do njegova sudjelovanja u masakru u Port Arthuru u Tasmaniji 1996. godine. Sredinom 1990-ih Nitram živi s majkom i ocem u predgrađu u Australiji. Izoliran je i frustriran i ne uspijeva se uklopiti u društvo. To traje dok neočekivano ne postane blizak prijatelj povučene nasljednice Helen. Međutim, kada ta veza tragično završi, a Nitramova usamljenost i gnjev počnu rasti, on polako pada u spiralu koja vodi u katastrofu.

programme.title: Hrvatsko vodeno blago
programme.desc: Paklina created in smoke and fire, from the harbor squeezed, named the Velebit -deeply engraved scars below the Holy Hill. Canyons Mala and Velika Paklenica, twins Introduced by the water of her streams that rush to the sea for large rains and dissolved snow. Little Paklenica is twelve kilometers long, four hundred to five hundred meters wide, and a large one is two kilometers longer. This impressive canyon beauty, wealth and diversity of forests of the source of the Bujic streams of Velika and Mala Paklenica, was proclaimed in 1949 by the Paklenica National Park for 95 square kilometers of the area. In the western part of the Ribnica Gate Park, Javornik and Debelo Hill dominate above September and Bojinac Plateau. Through the Vrh Golić, who leaned over the dry Draga, the widow of Brezimenjak and in her hidden Ramići and Parići, our gaze extends toward the northern border over which Veli Golić, Malovan and Crkljen Kuk dominated. Above the hidden and hard -to -reach canyon of the Mali Paklenica creek are Jerkovac and Badalj with great mockes. Through Jerkovac above the Lokvani Lok, we climb the mythical Holy Hill on the hair of a thick hill. Having him with him, calling him, talk about him and hang out with him, the privilege is rare. The view from the Holy Hill testifies to us about the greatness and shows us the way through the time we stopped for a moment. In Ramići we felt traces of past times. At the Straženica source, we headed through the water of Golubinka. We followed her underground path in Vrulji Modrič and Bunny. We followed the whimsical flow of Velika Paklenica water through the seasons. In the manner furnace, we flared our imagination. Of the thousands of recorded plant species, 79 are endemic. The climbers by cliffs divide the place with the divocoses (Rupicapra Rupicapra). From the sea level to the highest highs in the Paklenica National Park, many animal species have found their home. / Paklina nastala u dimu i vatri, iz luča iscijeđena, dala je ime velebitskim duboko urezanim ožiljcima ispod Svetoga brda. Kanjoni Mala i Velika Paklenica, blizanci izdubljeni vodom njezinih potoka koji se za velikih kiša i otopljenih snjegova žure prema moru. Mala Paklenica duga je dvanaest kilometara, široka četiristo do petsto metara, a Velika je duža dva kilometra. Ova dojmljiva kanjonska ljepota, bogatstvo i raznolikost šuma izvorišta bujičnih potoka Velike i Male Paklenice, proglašena je 1949. godine Nacionalnim parkom Paklenica na 95 četvornih kilometara površine. U zapadnom dijelu Parka Ribnička vrata, Javornik i Debelo brdo dominiraju iznad visoravni Velikog Rujna i Bojinca. Preko vrha Golić koji se nadvio nad Suhom dragom, udolinom Brezimenjača i u njoj skrivenim Ramićima i Parićima pogled nam seže prema sjevernoj granici nad kojom dominiraju Veli Golić, Malovan i Crljeni kuk. Iznad skrivenog i teško dostupnog kanjona potoka Male Paklenice stoje Jerkovac i Badalj s Velikim močilima. Preko Jerkovca iznad Ivanjske lokve po kosi Debelog brda penjemo se na mitsko Sveto brdo. Imati ga uz sebe, zvati ga svojim, pričati o njemu i družiti se s njim, povlastica je rijetkih. Na izvoru Stražbenica krenuli smo putem vode Golubinki. Slijedili smo njezin podzemni put u vruljama Modrič i Zečica. Pratili smo ćudljivi tok vode Velike Paklenice kroz godišnja doba. U Manitoj peći rasplamsali smo maštu. Od tisuću zabilježenih biljnih vrsta 79 ih je endemično. Penjači uz litice dijele mjesto s divokozama (Rupicapra rupicapra). Od razine mora pa do najviših visova u Nacionalnom parku Paklenica mnoge su životinjske vrste našle svoj dom.

programme.title: Austrijska gorska sela
programme.desc: In the mountain border towards Slovenia, people who live there create an idyll associated with a lot of work and conscious renunciation. Tradition of the Janezic family from St. Jacob in Rosental, that is, Sentjakoba V Roz, can be traced back to the beginning of the 16th century, the Čertov family from the village of Zell Pfarre, that is, Sele-Fare, lives from sheep and bees as well as sheep and bees, in Arnoldstein the church year is celebrated, while in the nearby border triangle, in which they meet Italy and Austria The Marion Pucher Mountaineering House welcomes cross -border mountaineers. / U planinskom pograničju prema Sloveniji ljudi koji ondje žive stvaraju idilu povezanu s mnogo rada i svjesnog odricanja. Tradicija obitelji Janežič iz St. Jakoba u Rosentalu, odnosno, Šentjakoba v Rožu, može se pratiti unatrag sve do početka 16. stoljeća, obitelj Čertov iz sela Zell Pfarre, odnosno, Sele-Fare, živi od ovaca i pčela kao i s ovcama i pčelama, u Arnoldsteinu se slavi crkveni god, dok u obližnjem graničnom trokutu, u kojem se sastaju Italija, Slovenija i Austrija, domaćica planinarskog doma Marion Pucher dočekuje prekogranične planinare.

programme.title: Fotografija u Hrvatskoj
programme.desc: The charismatic oeuvre of Brkan brothers, two true greats of contemporary Croatian photographs, are the foundation of the so -called Zadar schools of photography. Older brother Ante (1918-2004) in 1951 opens a photographic studio in Zadar. For the whole treasure trove of masterful works, he should not have traveled to unknown and exotic countries, seek sophisticated and aesthetic motives. He creates his works on the threshold of the family home and in the "calet" of his city. The value of these photos, far ahead of his time, was difficult to recognize at the time as a true masterpiece. Only when there were numerous awards at international photographic salons in the world, did we dare to say that the photo could be something else entirely, that the topic is irrelevant, and the motive is only an external form for multiple mean layers. / Karizmatski opusi braće Brkan, dvojice istinskih velikana suvremene hrvatske fotografije, temelj su tzv. zadarske škole fotografije. Stariji brat Ante (1918.-2004.) godine 1951. otvara fotografski atelijer u Zadru. Za cijelu riznicu majstorskih djela nije trebao putovati u nepoznate i egzotične zemlje, tražiti sofisticirane i estetizirane motive. Svoja djela on stvara na pragu obiteljskog doma i po "kaletama" svoga grada. Vrijednost tih fotografija, daleko ispred svoga vremena, bilo je tada teško prepoznati kao istinska remek-djela. Tek kada su na međunarodnim fotografskim salonima u svijetu osvojile brojne nagrade, usudili smo se ustvrditi da fotografija može biti i nešto sasvim drugo, da je tema nebitna, a motiv tek vanjska forma za mnogostruke značenjske slojeve.

programme.title: Opera Selecta Festival: Soloists Bolt theater - Kamerlengo Fortress in Trogir / Festival Opera Selecta: Solisti Boljšoj teatra - Tvrđava Kamerlengo u Trogiru
programme.desc: The thirteenth edition of the important classical music festival and the cultural and music brand of the city of Trogir _ Opera Selecta brings us the opera gala concert from 2021, whose recording of HRT displays, which featured the stars of Bolšoj Theater. These are: Olga Seliverstova (Soprano), Svetlana Shilova (Mezzo -soprano) and Konstantin Shushakov (Bariton) with the piano support of the prominent Croatian pianist Vesna Podrug Kossjanenko. The most famous opera arias, duets and solo songs of N. Roman-Korsakova, P. I. Tchaikovsky, C. Gounoda, G. Donizetti, F. Lehara, J. Offenbach and G. Bizet performed for the Trogir audience. The Opera Selecta Festival has been moving to one of the most prestigious summer music events in the Adriatic, and the fort or tower of Kamerlengo has hosted dozens of top performers. / Trinaesto izdanje važnog festivala klasične glazbe i kulturno-glazbeni brend grada Trogira _ Opera Selecta, donosi nam operni gala koncert iz 2021., čiju snimku HRT prikazuje, a na kojemu su nastupile zvijezde Boljšoj teatra. To su: Olga Seliverstova (sopran), Svetlana Shilova (mezzosopran) te Konstantin Shushakov (bariton) uz glasovirsku podršku istaknute hrvatske pijanistice Vesne Podrug Kossjanenko. Za trogirsku publiku izveli su najpoznatije operne arije, duete i solo pjesme N. Rimski-Korsakova, P. I. Čajkovskog, C. Gounoda, G. Donizettija, F. Lehara, J. Offenbacha i G. Bizeta. Festival Opera Selecta prometnuo se u jedan od najprestižnijih ljetnih glazbenih događaja na Jadranu, a tvrđava ili kula Kamerlengo ugostila je na desetke vrhunskih izvođača.

programme.title: ART
programme.desc: Art _ Your Culture Address! Every week from Monday to Thursday at 8.10pm, we bring you the best from the art world and ideas, stories that shape theater, art, literature, architecture, film, music. / Art _ vaša adresa za kulturu! Svaki tjedan od ponedjeljka do četvrtka u 20.10 donosimo vam najbolje iz svijeta umjetnosti i ideja, priče koje oblikuju kazalište, likovnost, književnost, arhitekturu, film, glazbu.

programme.title: Razgovor s razlogom
programme.desc: Guest is one of the most important and read French writers Leila Slimani. Honestly and without hesitation, he will explain to us why identity perceives as a moral and ethical question. How did she answer the question _ who am I? What detects us more, our social status or national identity? Why was her own family served as an inspiration for the trilogy "in the country of others" and why did she decide to tell that story of Morocco? How to look at the immigrant policy of the European Union and what are the mistakes of integration? Why doesn't it matter that others love her? What is it like to live in the country of others is a question that gives us a reason to talk to Leil Slimani. / Gošća je jedna od najvažnijih i najčitanijih francuskih književnica Leila Slimani. Iskreno i bez zadrške objasnit će nam zašto identit doživljava kao moralno i etičko pitanje. Kako je sebi odgovorila na pitanje _ tko sam ja? Što nas više određuje, naš socijalni status ili nacionalni identitet? Zašto joj je kao inspiracija za trilogiju "U zemlji drugih" poslužila vlastita obitelj i zašto je odlučila ispričati baš tu priču o Maroku? Kako gleda na imigrantsku politiku Europske unije i koje su greške integracije? Zašto joj nije važno da je drugi vole? Kako je živjeti u zemlji drugih, pitanje je koje nam daje razlog za razgovor s Leilom Slimani.

programme.title: Klub čitatelja
programme.desc: Each week, passionate readers, critics and theorists talk about one title currently read in Croatia. / Svaki tjedan strastveni čitatelji, kritičari i teoretičari razgovaraju o jednom naslovu koji se trenutačno čita u Hrvatskoj.

programme.title: Klub čitatelja
programme.desc: Reader Club _ Supplementary teaching / Klub čitatelja _ Dopunska nastava

programme.title: Kolibrić
programme.desc: Nonlinear story about Marca Carrere's life, which stretches for sixty years. Although the tragedies and various adversity, Marco manages to avoid chaos in their environment, such as the colibrator, focusing all its energy to "stand in place". The shop includes three generations of one family, whose life stories are overrated by the experiences of happiness, excitement, but also disappointments and pain. / Nelinearna priča o životu Marca Carrere, koja se proteže na šezdeset godina. Iako ga prate tragedije i razne nedaće, Marco uspijeva izbjeći kaos u svom okruženju, poput kolibrića, fokusirajući svu svoju energiju na to da "stoji na mjestu". Radnja obuhvaća tri generacije jedne obitelji, čije su životne priče premrežene iskustvima sreće, uzbuđenja, ali i razočarenja i boli.

programme.title: Simpsoni
programme.desc: Ayo! Nedu and Homer Life is further complicated in the tense finish of the Simplifix's prestigious criminal triller. / Ajoj! Nedu i Homeru život se dodatno zakomplicira u napetoj završnici Simplifixova prestižnog kriminalističkog trilera.

programme.title: Hrvatsko vodeno blago
programme.desc: The closest to the sky, illuminated by the sun, Milovan clouds worn winds, with thunder scars, locked snow in the wild in which only a few survive. Full of large stone blocks of desolate and impassable paths, pushed by dense forests and meadows, hidden widows and pits, North Velebit National Park with its 109 kilometers of square mystical and remembered niches to those who find peace in the listening of silence. Starting from Velika and Mali Zavizan, Rajinac, through the Hajduk and Rozan hips, we fly along the crossing of Alan and Dundovic to the end of the Premuzic track to the end to the end, to Stirovaca. Constantly thirsty for water that runs into a dark and mystical underground in which we only know some steps. Most of these waters will end their trip to the sea that mourns him. We will travel across the tops of the Velebit Breče, to pass the Premužić path, to meet the most beautiful flowers of Velebit, to peek into his animal world. Go through the water at the underground. To feel the spirit of tradition, to go with wolf traces and to witness the struggle of stone and fire. / Najbliži nebu, obasjan suncem, milovan oblacima nošenim vjetrovima, s ožiljcima od gromova, zaključan snjegovima u divljini u kojoj samo rijetki preživljavaju. Prepun velikih kamenih blokova pustih i neprohodnih staza, prošaran gustim šumama i livadama, skrovitim udolinama i jamama, Nacionalni park Sjeverni Velebit sa svojih 109 kilometara četvornih mistična je i sjetna niša onima koji u osluškivanju tišine pronalaze mir. Krenuvši od Velikog i Malog Zavižana, Rajinca, preko Hajdučkih i Rožanskih kukova, uzduž Premužićeve staze letimo prema prijelazu Alan i Dundović Mirovu pa do kraja, do Štirovače. Stalno žedan vode koja mu bježi u mračno i mistično podzemlje u kojemu tek neke korake znamo. Većina tih voda završit će svoje putovanje u moru koje ga oplakuje. Putovat ćemo preko vrhova presvučenih velebitskim brečama, proći Premužićevom stazom, upoznati najljepše cvjetove Velebita, zaviriti u njegov životinjski svijet. Krenuti putem vode u podzemlje. Osjetiti duh tradicije, krenuti vučjim tragovima i svjedočiti borbi kamena i vatre.

programme.title: As it is said / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The HTV Education and Science Department, in cooperation with the Croatian Language Institute, has recorded thirty videos in which, in addition to linguistic advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language such as the language of young people and foreign words in the Croatian language are addressed. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Stokavian and Chakavian dialects and unusual names of the place, but also of the frequent and unusual personal names. The head of the interview is the Croatian language professor Katarina Marjanovic, who gives numerous followers on Instagram. Her interviewees are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijevic, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidovic, Ivana Kurtovic Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. The show was realized by Danijela Ivancevic, Ana Radmilovic, Robert Cecelj, Alan Stankovic and Viktor Nenadic and Branimir Volf with the support of colleagues from the web HRT department Ive Hren and Matko Svarc and Tomislav Mrsic and Maja Fišter. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec. Emisiju su realizirali Danijela Ivančević, Ana Radmilović, Robert Cecelja, Alan Stanković i Viktor Nenadić i Branimira Volf uz potporu kolega iz Odjela Web HRT-a Ive Hren i Matka Švarca te Tomislava Mršića i Maje Fišter.

programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore together and discover the world around us, learn about ourselves and others. We learn in play, in songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuh every morning, every day from 6.30am to 1pm. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sixty short stories of sound, which are heard through the ears of a small but very active being called "sound collector", which has a passion for sound and all the concepts related to sound, despite the fact that he hears very poorly. This small being spends his days discovering and learning new sounds he finds on his adventures: these are the most common sounds of the sea, sounds that produce beings in the sea, the sounds produced by insects, including snoring his best friend and pet Marta. / Šezdeset kratkih pričica o zvuku, koje se čuju kroz uši malog, ali vrlo aktivnog bića zvanog "Sakupljač zvukova", koji ima strast za zvuk i sve pojmove vezane uz zvuk, unatoč činjenici da on vrlo slabo čuje. To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: The mayor of Goodway and Humdinger, and the hen, invaded an icy trouble during fishing. // Kaubojka Beryl leads an exciting pattern challenge on the Wingnuts Farm! / Gradonačelnici Goodway i Humdinger, te Kokoška, upadnu u ledenu nevolju tijekom ribolova. // Kaubojka Beryl vodi Uzbudljivi Rodeo Izazov na farmi Wingnutsa!

programme.title: Vrijeme je za Timmyja
programme.desc: Timmy is a little lamb eager for new knowledge. He has just been three years old, and since he is the only lamb in the herd, he used to being all over his. But now he is going to kindergarten with other cubs and will have to learn to behave in the company of his peers. In each episode, one day is shown in kindergarten. The daily routine of the only crazy toddler disrupts. Through various events and accidents, Timmy and his friends learn about life and friendship. / Timmy je malo janje željno novih znanja. Upravo je navršio tri godine, a budući da je jedino janje u stadu, navikao je da sve bude po njegovom. No sad kreće u vrtić s drugim mladuncima i morat će se naučiti ponašati u društvu svojih vršnjaka. U svakoj se epizodi prikazuje jedan dan u vrtiću. Svakodnevnu rutinu remete jedino ludorije mališana. Kroz razne zgode i nezgode, Timmy i njegovi prijatelji uče o životu i prijateljstvu.

programme.title: Krceki
programme.desc: Krceki is a small family: squirrel, acorn, coconut and peanuts. They live together in Krcograd and love adventures. Because of their curiosity, they fall into various troubles, and in order to solve the problem, they always invent a machine. The machine does not always work the way they imagined and emerge many humorous and unforeseen situations. We wish you a great party with Krcek! You are also awaiting rhymes and computer games! / Krceki su mala obitelj: vjeverica, žir, kokos i kikiriki. Žive zajedno u Krcogradu i vole avanture. Zbog svoje znatiželje upadaju u razne nevolje, a kako bi riješili problem izmisle uvijek neki stroj. Stroj ne radi uvijek onako kako su zamislili i nastanu mnoge šaljive i nepredviđene situacije. Želimo vam odličnu zabavu s Krcekima! Također vas očekuju i pjesmice i računalna igra!

programme.title: Krceki - song / Krceki - pjesmica
programme.desc: In addition to the animated series of Krceki, we are also coming to us by seven rhymes: bragger, plack, smart, good, angry, shy and brave. Each rhyme sings about the features of one character from the Krceki series. Music, Verses, Performance: David Vurdelja _ Baby Dooks Authors of the series: Denis Alenta, Vjekoslav Zivkovic, Marija Ivsic Editor: Sanja Nakic / Uz animiranu seriju Krceki stiže nam i sedam pjesmica: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljivko i Hrabrica. Svaka pjesmica pjeva o osobinama jednog lika iz serijala Krceki. Glazba, stihovi, izvedba: David Vurdelja _ Baby Dooks Autori serije: Denis Alenti, Vjekoslav Živković, Marija Ivšić Urednica: Sanja Nakić
