programme.title: Pocoyo
programme.desc: Pocoyo is a curious toddler dressed in blue from head to toe, prone to jokes and tiny mischief. The series follows the fun adventures of Pocoya and his friends, and each episode deals with another topic. The cheerful societies explore the world through play and teaches new words and concepts. And by the way she has a good time. The fourth season introduces us to the new character Nina and her pet robot Robert. / Pocoyo je radoznali mališan odjeven u plavo od glave do pete, sklon šali i sitnim nestašlucima. Serija prati zabavne pustolovine Pocoya i njegovih prijatelja, a svaka se epizoda bavi drugom temom. Veselo društvance kroz igru istražuje svijet i uči nove riječi i pojmove. I usput se dobro zabavlja. Četvrta sezona upoznaje nas s novim likom Ninom i njezinim kućnim ljubimcem robotom Robertom.

programme.title: Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty -two -minute episodes of the series, you are waiting for unprecedented stories and posts: how to wash your paws with your puppy, how to feed it, how to put the laundry on drying and beat the clips, remove the dishes from the washing machine, prepare the orange juice, sweep the house, plant the plants in the garden, or to pack yourself for a trip. Spend the morning in the company of a two -year -old! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey is a lovely and tireless little six -year -old bitch of Australian cattle who lives with his mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves playing and draws all his family and the whole neighborhood into his world of fun and playing. / Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja.

programme.title: Mali Malabar

programme.title: As it is said / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The HTV Education and Science Department, in cooperation with the Croatian Language Institute, has recorded thirty videos in which, in addition to linguistic advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language such as the language of young people and foreign words in the Croatian language are addressed. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec.

programme.title: Hrvatsko vodeno blago
programme.desc: The closest to the sky, illuminated by the sun, Milovan clouds worn winds, with thunder scars, locked snow in the wild in which only a few survive. Full of large stone blocks of desolate and impassable paths, pushed by dense forests and meadows, hidden widows and pits, North Velebit National Park with its 109 kilometers of square mystical and remembered niches to those who find peace in the listening of silence. Starting from Velika and Mali Zavizan, Rajinac, through the Hajduk and Rozan hips, we fly along the crossing of Alan and Dundovic to the end of the Premuzic track to the end to the end, to Stirovaca. Constantly thirsty for water that runs into a dark and mystical underground in which we only know some steps. Most of these waters will end their trip to the sea that mourns him. We will travel across the tops of the Velebit Breče, to pass the Premužić path, to meet the most beautiful flowers of Velebit, to peek into his animal world. Go through the water at the underground. To feel the spirit of tradition, to go with wolf traces and to witness the struggle of stone and fire. / Najbliži nebu, obasjan suncem, milovan oblacima nošenim vjetrovima, s ožiljcima od gromova, zaključan snjegovima u divljini u kojoj samo rijetki preživljavaju. Prepun velikih kamenih blokova pustih i neprohodnih staza, prošaran gustim šumama i livadama, skrovitim udolinama i jamama, Nacionalni park Sjeverni Velebit sa svojih 109 kilometara četvornih mistična je i sjetna niša onima koji u osluškivanju tišine pronalaze mir. Krenuvši od Velikog i Malog Zavižana, Rajinca, preko Hajdučkih i Rožanskih kukova, uzduž Premužićeve staze letimo prema prijelazu Alan i Dundović Mirovu pa do kraja, do Štirovače. Stalno žedan vode koja mu bježi u mračno i mistično podzemlje u kojemu tek neke korake znamo. Većina tih voda završit će svoje putovanje u moru koje ga oplakuje. Putovat ćemo preko vrhova presvučenih velebitskim brečama, proći Premužićevom stazom, upoznati najljepše cvjetove Velebita, zaviriti u njegov životinjski svijet. Krenuti putem vode u podzemlje. Osjetiti duh tradicije, krenuti vučjim tragovima i svjedočiti borbi kamena i vatre.

programme.title: Razgovor s razlogom
programme.desc: Guest is one of the most important and read French writers Leila Slimani. Honestly and without hesitation, he will explain to us why identity perceives as a moral and ethical question. How did she answer the question _ who am I? What detects us more, our social status or national identity? Why was her own family served as an inspiration for the trilogy "in the country of others" and why did she decide to tell that story of Morocco? How to look at the immigrant policy of the European Union and what are the mistakes of integration? Why doesn't it matter that others love her? What is it like to live in the country of others is a question that gives us a reason to talk to Leil Slimani. / Gošća je jedna od najvažnijih i najčitanijih francuskih književnica Leila Slimani. Iskreno i bez zadrške objasnit će nam zašto identit doživljava kao moralno i etičko pitanje. Kako je sebi odgovorila na pitanje _ tko sam ja? Što nas više određuje, naš socijalni status ili nacionalni identitet? Zašto joj je kao inspiracija za trilogiju "U zemlji drugih" poslužila vlastita obitelj i zašto je odlučila ispričati baš tu priču o Maroku? Kako gleda na imigrantsku politiku Europske unije i koje su greške integracije? Zašto joj nije važno da je drugi vole? Kako je živjeti u zemlji drugih, pitanje je koje nam daje razlog za razgovor s Leilom Slimani.

programme.title: Austrijska gorska sela
programme.desc: In Trins, an idyllic village of farmers, the Maier family with 500 silver spruce lays the foundation for their own breeding of Christmas trees, a family -owned company to which the originality of Tyrol is inherent. Just ten kilometers south of Trins, Vals Valina begins where Helga, one of the few shepherds in Tyrol, took over the Nockerlalm mountain estate from its grandfather. For several years, her skin grazes. Helga has a mission: explain as many people as possible the connection between the use of mountain pastures, cultural heritage and ensuring the living space as well as the functional mountain landscape. / U Trinsu, idiličnom selu poljodjelaca, obitelj Maier s 500 srebrnih smreka polaže temelj za vlastiti uzgoj božićnih drvca, obiteljsko poduzeće kojemu je svojstvena izvornost Tirola. Samo deset kilometara južno od Trinsa počinje dolina Vals gdje je Helga, jedna od malobrojnih pastirica u Tirolu, preuzela planinsko imanje Nockerlalm od svoga djeda. Već nekoliko godina na njemu pasu njezine koze. Helga ima misiju: objasniti što većem broju ljudi povezanost korištenja planinskih pašnjaka, kulturne baštine i osiguravanja životnog prostora kao i funkcionalnoga gorskog krajolika.

programme.title: Svijet klasike
programme.desc: Ballet Sergei Prokofiev in the choreography of Leo Mujić, April 26, 2025, HNK Ivan pl. Rijeka. The first ballet prime minister in the Rijeka mandate of Intendant Dubravka Vrgoc returns to the "city flowing" by his favorite choreographer Leo Mujic, to whom this is the fourth play with the Rijeka ballet. Wanting to find something known and attractive, which would return to Rijeka children on stage and ballerina "on the spots", select the Neoclassical Ballet of Sergei Prokofiev according to the famous story of Charles Perrault _ Cinderella _ premiered on the Moscow Podium of the Moscow Theater in 1945. Mangiole, who will soon give place to her colleague Leonard Jakovina. But the point is that he started the back of the dance "on the spikes", opening a series of auditions for new dancers. Here we get to know the old and new stars of the ensemble, these are Marta Voinea Cavrak (half -sister Zorica), Yurik Kimura (Ella/Cinderella), Leonard Cel (John/Prince) and Marta Kanazir (Cindy/Mother), as well as a number of children from Rijeka's dance schools. For the first time in Croatia, a young Belgian, otherwise chief Dirigent of the Ljubljana Opera, Maestro Ayrton Despelaere. / Balet Sergeja Prokofjeva u koreografiji Lea Mujića, 26. travnja 2025., HNK Ivana pl. Zajca Rijeka. Prva baletna premijera u riječkom mandatu intendantice Dubravke Vrgoč vraća u "grad koji teče" omiljenog koreografa Lea Mujića kojemu je ovo četvrta predstava s Riječkim baletom. Želeći naći nešto svima poznato i privlačno, što bi vratilo u Rijeku djecu na scenu i balerine "na špice", odabiru neoklasični balet Sergeja Prokofjeva prema poznatoj priči Charlesa Perraulta _ Pepeljugu _ praizvedenu na podiju moskovskoga Boljšoj teatra godine 1945. To je prvo predstavljanje novog, a sada već bivšeg ravnatelja Riječkog baleta, Talijana Paola Mangiole, koji će uskoro ustupiti mjesto kolegi Leonardu Jakovini. Ali bit je da je pokrenuo povratak plesa "na špicama" otvorivši niz audicija za nove plesače. Tu upoznajemo stare i nove zvijezde ansambla, to su Marta Voinea Čavrak (polusestra Zorica), Yurika Kimura (Ella/Pepeljuga), Leonard Cela (John/Princ) i Marta Kanazir (Cindy/Majka), ali i niz djece iz riječkih plesnih škola. Orkestrom prvi put u Hrvatskoj ravna mladi Belgijanac, inače šef-dirigent Ljubljanske opere, maestro Ayrton Desimpelaere.

programme.title: Svijet jazza
programme.desc: As Cuba marked American culture in its entirety, Cuban music has been registered with jazz history since his early days. Today, the Afrokuban jazz is one of his great genres and one of the two pillars of the music continent named Latin Jazz, and the pianist Gonzalo Rubalcab is among his leading representatives, but also the most famous jazz-pivnists in general. He began to show the unusual tendency of Rubalcab music at the youngest age, so as a six -year -old he played drums in the orchestra of Father Guillermo. Zarana labeled as a miracle of a child, Rubalcabs will attract the attention of one of the greatest popularizers of the Afrokububan jazz and jazz _ Dizzy Gillespie, who will invite him to play with him, in the mid -1980s. Shortly thereafter, another key encounter will happen _ The one with the consistent Charlie Haden, which will significantly mark Rubalcab's musical path. Since then, Rubalcaba will achieve a glittering record and concert career, with a number of notable release from Cuban and the wider tradition of jazz such as "Nocturni" and "Land of the Sun" album. The last major recognition of Rubalcabi arrived for the album "Skyline" from 2021, which he recorded with two jazz greats Jack Dejohnette and Ron Carter. It is accompanied by an excellent "Turning Point/Trio Dete", which was joined by a great Matt Brewer and Eric Harland. In addition to Ernest Simpson as a replacement for Harland on drums, Rubalcaba presented his impressive music in early July and at a small Roman theater in Pula. / Kao što je Kuba obilježila američku kulturu u cijelosti, kubanska glazba upisana je u povijest jazza od njegovih ranih dana. Danas je afrokubanski jazz jedan od njegovih velikih žanrova i jedan od dva stupa glazbenog kontinenta po imenu Latin jazz, a pijanist Gonzalo Rubalcaba među njegovim je vodećim predstavnicima, ali i najpoznatijim jazz-pijanistima općenito. Neobičnu sklonost glazbi Rubalcaba je počeo pokazivati u najmlađoj dobi, pa je već kao šestogodišnjak zasvirao bubnjeve u orkestru oca Guillerma. Zarana označen kao čudo od djeteta, Rubalcaba će sredinom osamdesetih u Havani privući pažnju jednog od najvećih popularizatora afrokubanskog jazza i ikone jazza _ Dizzyja Gillespieja, koji će ga pozvati da s njim zasvira. Ubrzo nakon toga dogodit će se još jedan ključan susret _ onaj s konstrabasistom Charliejem Hadenom, koji će bitno obilježiti Rubalcabin glazbeni put. Otad će Rubalcaba ostvariti blistavu diskografsku i koncertnu karijeru, uz niz zapaženih izdanja izniklih iz kubanske, ali i šire tradicije jazza poput albuma "Nocturne" i "Land of the Sun". Posljednje veliko priznanje Rubalcabi je stiglo za album "Skyline" iz 2021., koji je snimio s dvama velikanima jazza Jackom DeJohnetteom i Ronom Carterom. Na njega se nadovezuje izvrsni "Turning Point/Trio Dete", na kojem su mu se pridružili sjajni Matt Brewer i Eric Harland. Uz Ernesta Simpsona kao zamjenu za Harlanda na bubnjevima, Rubalcaba je svoju impresivnu glazbu predstavio početkom srpnja i u Malom rimskom kazalištu u Puli.

programme.title: Monika Leskovar and HRT Symphony Orchestra under the direction of Pascal Rophea - KD V. Lisinski / Monika Leskovar i Simfonijski orkestar HRT-a pod ravnanjem Pascala Rophea - KD V. Lisinski
programme.desc: The HRT Symphony Orchestra opens the new season of the master cycle under the guidance of Maestro Pascal Rophe, who, with this concert, begins his second term of the chief of conductor of the esteemed orchestra. The program begins with the Singing Song of Slava (Chant du Rossignol) Igor Stravinsky, derived from his opera Slavuj (1914). Stravinski's contemporary and countryman Sergei Rahmanjin's second symphony returned his faith in a composer call after a catastrophic failure of the first symphony of 1897 and the severe creative crisis that followed. Another symphony, intended for the large composition of the symphony orchestra, with as many as three instruments each in most width sections and an extended group of percussion, contains an abundance of beautiful, swollen romantic music, but at the same time a masterfully controlled tension that is released in the magnificent final. The concert soloist is one of our most awarded cellist, Monika Leskovar, who, as a thirteen -year -old, became the youngest winner of the International Tchaikovsky Competition in Japan (1995). Rich in international careers, today he teaches at the Academy of Music in Zagreb and always gladly returns to the HRT Symphony Orchestra, and on this occasion in the interpretation of the variation on the Rokoko Theme of Petra Iljic Tchaikovsky. Although his role model were classic forms and type of orchestra from Hayn's time, Petar Iljic Tchaikovsky created more than a virtuosic and romantic gorgeous work with a prose rococo theme and complex variations in his variations. / Simfonijski orkestar HRT-a otvara novu sezonu Majstorskog ciklusa pod vodstvom maestra Pascala Rophea koji ovim koncertom počinje svoj drugi mandat šefa dirigenta cijenjenog orkestra. Program počinje simfonijskom pjesmom Pjev slavuja (Chant du rossignol) Igora Stravinskog, proizašlom iz njegove opere Slavuj (1914.). Stravinskijev suvremenik i zemljak Sergej Rahmanjinov Drugom simfonijom vratio je svoju vjeru u skladateljski poziv nakon katastrofalnog neuspjeha Prve simfonije 1897. i teške stvaralačke krize koja je uslijedila. Druga simfonija, namijenjena velikom sastavu simfonijskog orkestra, s čak po tri instrumenta u većini puhačkih sekcija i proširenom skupinom udaraljki, sadrži obilje predivne, nabujale romantičarske glazbe, ali i istovremeno majstorski kontroliranu napetost koja se oslobađa u veličanstvenom finalu. Solistica na koncertu je jedna od naših najnagrađivanijih violončelistica, Monika Leskovar, koja je kao trinaestogodišnjakinja postala najmlađa pobjednica Međunarodnog natjecanja Čajkovski u Japanu (1995.). Bogate međunarodne karijere, danas predaje na Muzičkoj akademiji u Zagrebu te se uvijek rado vraća pred Simfonijski orkestar HRT-a, a ovom prigodom u interpretaciji Varijacija na rokoko temu Petra Iljiča Čajkovskog. Iako su mu uzor bile klasične forme i tip orkestra iz Haydnova doba, Petar Iljič Čajkovski u svojim je Varijacijama stvorio više nego virtuozno i romantičarski raskošno djelo s prpošnom rokoko temom i kompleksnim varijacijama.

Posramljeni Leo sve se više odvaja od zbunjenog Remija i njihovo prijateljstvo postupno se narušava.

programme.title: Split Blues Festival
programme.desc: As part of the 11th Split Blues Festival, the Croatian Bluesers from the Homeland and Diaspora held a full -time concert. Thus, Croatian Blues performers from Amsterdam, Bologna, London, Paris, as well as from Velika Gorica, Zabok, Sisak, Split, Rogoznica, Lepoglava, Zagreb, Hvar, Solina, Veliki Trgovišće performed: Tony Lee King And Southern Cooking and Charlie and Bell Blues Experience, which are this year's winners of Croatian Blues Challenge and Croatian representatives at the World Blues Competition in Memphis. / U sklopu 11. Split Blues Festivala cjelovečernje koncerte održali su hrvatski blueseri iz domovine i dijaspore. Tako su na istoj pozornici u splitskom Đardinu prodefilirali hrvatski izvođači bluesa iz Amsterdama, Bologne, Londona, Pariza, ali i iz Velike Gorice, Zaboka, Siska, Splita, Rogoznice, Lepoglave, Čiova, Zagreba, Hvara, Solina, Velikog Trgovišća... Nastupili su: Tony Lee King, Tomislav Goluban, Harpoon Blues Band, Francesco And Southern Cooking te Charlie And Bell Blues Experience koji su ovogodišnji pobjednici Croatian Blues Challengea i predstavnici Hrvatske na svjetskom blues natjecanju u Memphisu.

programme.title: Razgovor sa stijenama
programme.desc: In the first episode, we embark on geological sides with the beautiful Slavonian mountain of Papuk. With the help of scientists, our professional guides, we get to know the exceptional geological, biological and cultural and historical heritage of this mountain. What at first glance was just a piece of rock will suddenly bring us back to the Cambria period, 450 million years back, to a global event of a sudden development of life. Following the clues, we climb the time ladder and travel for millions of years of geological past. From the rest of the ancient volcanoes, through strong tectonic movements, to traces of the Pannonian Sea. Along the way we meet the famous Charug, we also visit the Geo-Info Center in Voćin through a sensational virtual walk through the geological wealth of this area. In the House of Pannonian Sea in the Great, in the attractive lineup, we also meet Carcharodon Megalodon, a twenty -meter shark that swam in the former Pannonian Sea. And so step by step, millions of years long, in the youngest tufa deposits we will see the nose of the benign Diva Regoc. Finally, we will rest at one of the most beautiful natural spaces of Papuk, in the Gorski Kotar Valley Jankovac. / U prvoj epizodi krećemo na geološke skitnje predivnom slavonskom planinom Papuk. Uz pomoć znanstvenika, naših stručnih vodiča, upoznajemo iznimnu geološku, biološku i kulturno-povijesnu baštinu ove planine. Ono što nam je na prvi pogled bio tek komad stijene odjednom će nas vratiti u razdoblje kambrija, 450 milijuna godina unatrag, u globalni događaj naglog razvoja života. Slijedeći tragove penjemo se vremenskom ljestvicom i putujemo milijunima godina geološke prošlosti. Od ostatka drevnih vulkana, preko snažnih tektonskih pokreta, do tragova Panonskoga mora. Na putu susrećemo i znamenitog Čarugu, posjećujemo i Geo-info centar u Voćinu kroz senzacionalnu virtualnu šetnju geološkim bogatstvom ovoga kraja. U Kući Panonskoga mora u Velikoj, u atraktivnom postavu susrećemo i carcharodon megalodona, dvadesetmetarskoga morskoga psa koji je plivao u nekadašnjem Panonskom moru. I tako korak po korak, dugačak milijune godina, u najmlađim naslagama sedre ugledat ćemo nos dobroćudnoga diva Regoča. Za kraj, odmorit ćemo se na jednom od najljepših prirodnih prostora Papuka, u gorskoj dolini Jankovac.

programme.title: As it is said / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The HTV Education and Science Department, in cooperation with the Croatian Language Institute, has recorded thirty videos in which, in addition to linguistic advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language such as the language of young people and foreign words in the Croatian language are addressed. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Stokavian and Chakavian dialects and unusual names of the place, but also of the frequent and unusual personal names. The head of the interview is the Croatian language professor Katarina Marjanovic, who gives numerous followers on Instagram. Her interviewees are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijevic, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidovic, Ivana Kurtovic Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. The show was realized by Danijela Ivancevic, Ana Radmilovic, Robert Cecelj, Alan Stankovic and Viktor Nenadic and Branimir Volf with the support of colleagues from the web HRT department Ive Hren and Matko Svarc and Tomislav Mrsic and Maja Fišter. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec. Emisiju su realizirali Danijela Ivančević, Ana Radmilović, Robert Cecelja, Alan Stanković i Viktor Nenadić i Branimira Volf uz potporu kolega iz Odjela Web HRT-a Ive Hren i Matka Švarca te Tomislava Mršića i Maje Fišter.

programme.desc: Simon is a cute little rabbit that foists the vitalness of childhood. Simon is a French animated television series based on books Stephanie Blake in the edition of the French publisher Lecole des loisirs. He was directed by the TV series Julien Cayot, and it was produced by Go-N Productions. The series in France had Prime Minister 17. December 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. programme.title: As it is said / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The HTV Education and Science Department, in cooperation with the Croatian Language Institute, has recorded thirty videos in which, in addition to linguistic advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language such as the language of young people and foreign words in the Croatian language are addressed. The head of the interview is the Croatian language professor Katarina Marjanovic, who gives numerous followers on Instagram. Her interviewees are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijevic, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidovic, Ivana Kurtovic Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec.

programme.title: Razgovor sa stijenama
programme.desc: In the first episode, we embark on geological sides with the beautiful Slavonian mountain of Papuk. With the help of scientists, our professional guides, we get to know the exceptional geological, biological and cultural and historical heritage of this mountain. What at first glance was just a piece of rock will suddenly bring us back to the Cambria period, 450 million years back, to a global event of a sudden development of life. Following the clues, we climb the time ladder and travel for millions of years of geological past. From the rest of the ancient volcanoes, through strong tectonic movements, to traces of the Pannonian Sea. Along the way we meet the famous Charug, we also visit the Geo-Info Center in Voćin through a sensational virtual walk through the geological wealth of this area. In the House of Pannonian Sea in the Great, in the attractive lineup, we also meet Carcharodon Megalodon, a twenty -meter shark that swam in the former Pannonian Sea. And so step by step, millions of years long, in the youngest tufa deposits we will see the nose of the benign Diva Regoc. Finally, we will rest at one of the most beautiful natural spaces of Papuk, in the Gorski Kotar Valley Jankovac. / U prvoj epizodi krećemo na geološke skitnje predivnom slavonskom planinom Papuk. Uz pomoć znanstvenika, naših stručnih vodiča, upoznajemo iznimnu geološku, biološku i kulturno-povijesnu baštinu ove planine. Ono što nam je na prvi pogled bio tek komad stijene odjednom će nas vratiti u razdoblje kambrija, 450 milijuna godina unatrag, u globalni događaj naglog razvoja života. Slijedeći tragove penjemo se vremenskom ljestvicom i putujemo milijunima godina geološke prošlosti. Od ostatka drevnih vulkana, preko snažnih tektonskih pokreta, do tragova Panonskoga mora. Na putu susrećemo i znamenitog Čarugu, posjećujemo i Geo-info centar u Voćinu kroz senzacionalnu virtualnu šetnju geološkim bogatstvom ovoga kraja. U Kući Panonskoga mora u Velikoj, u atraktivnom postavu susrećemo i carcharodon megalodona, dvadesetmetarskoga morskoga psa koji je plivao u nekadašnjem Panonskom moru. I tako korak po korak, dugačak milijune godina, u najmlađim naslagama sedre ugledat ćemo nos dobroćudnoga diva Regoča. Za kraj, odmorit ćemo se na jednom od najljepših prirodnih prostora Papuka, u gorskoj dolini Jankovac.

programme.title: Bernadette
programme.desc: The film was accompanied by Bernadette Chirac during her two presidential terms of her husband Jacques Chirac, that is, from 1995 until Nicolas Sarkozy's election in 2007. Bernadette expected to finally get the place she deserves to come to the Elysee Palace, because she was always a support to her husband and helped him to become president, but she fooled. She avenged herself by becoming an influential media figure. / Film prati Bernadette Chirac tijekom dva predsjednička mandata njezina supruga Jacquesa Chiraca, odnosno od 1995. do izbora Nicolasa Sarkozyja 2007. Bernadette je očekivala da će dolaskom u Elizejsku palaču konačno dobiti mjesto koje zaslužuje, jer je svom suprugu uvijek bila potpora i pomogla mu da postane predsjednik, ali prevarila se. Osvetila se tako što je postala utjecajna medijska ličnost.

programme.title: Lanternist
programme.desc: Documentary movie about going, a lighthouse on Stončica. Ivan Bulić Ićo has been working as a lighthouse since 1995. He changed several lighthous, from Blitvenica to Palagruza. He is currently working on Stončica, a lighthouse located on the east side of Vis. Ićo has one -month shifts, he is a month in Split, where he lives, and a month on the lighthouse. The Stončica is twenty minutes away from Vis by car and a twenty minute walk in a goat path. Sometimes friends from Vis or Split come to him. In his spare time, he closed himself in his little workshop and made fish from wooden charges, which he has shown several times at exhibitions in Split, Vis and Zagreb. The film shows the life of a lighthouse, and through the story of Ivan Bulic it can be seen that loneliness is not conditioned by being alone somewhere. / Dokumentarni film o Ići, svjetioničaru na Stončici. Ivan Bulić Ićo od 1995. godine radi kao svjetioničar. Promijenio je nekoliko svjetionika, od Blitvenice do Palagruže. Trenutačno radi na Stončici, svjetioniku smještenome na istočnoj strani Visa. Ićo ima jednomjesečne smjene, mjesec dana je u Splitu, gdje živi, a mjesec dana na svjetioniku. Stončica je udaljena od Visa dvadesetak minuta automobilom i još dvadesetak minuta hoda kozjom stazom. Ponekad mu dođu prijatelji iz Visa ili Splita. U slobodno vrijeme zatvori se u svoju malu radionicu i od drvenih naplavina izrađuje ribe koje je već nekoliko puta prikazao na izložbama u Splitu, Visu i Zagrebu. U filmu je prikazan život svjetioničara, a kroz priču o Ivanu Buliću vidi se da samoća nije uvjetovana time da si negdje sam.

programme.title: We were born on Morava / Rodili smo se na Moravi
programme.desc: On the occasion of the 70th anniversary of the beginning of the emigration of Moravian Croats, produced by the emissions of folk and dedicated culture by culture during 2017 and 2018, the documentary film by Davor Boric and Ljiljana Sismanovic was created. The film is reminiscent of an almost forgotten and wider Croatian public of the unknown historical fate of the Croatian minority in the Czech Republic and documents their memories and remains of the heritage of Moravian Croats, which they have been trying to record from the 1990s and revitalize. Every first Sunday in September, displaced Moravian Croats, their descendants and their friends Czechs and Germans gather at Kiritof in Jevišovka. They participate in the mass celebration, lay flowers on monuments and graves, and then hang out and remember the last days with a folklore program, eating and drinks. The Association of Citizens of Croatian National in the Czech Republic, led by brother and sister Jan Kopřiva and Lenka Kopřivová, launched in 2010. An extensive documentation project of the fate and the language of Moravian Croats, which made Lenka Kopřivová about 30 conversations with the old Moravian Croats who still speak their dialect and remember old customs, legend and details. A songbook of Moravian Croats and a CD with their songs. The documentary film with the atmosphere of Kiritof in Jevišovki, the fragments of Josef Lawitschke's life stories, Marie Šalamon and Ana Luzarov, and the narration of Lenka Kopivova, brings only the preserved folklore treasure _ "Croatian wedding", the choreography depicting the wedding customs of the Moravian Croats, and today, as well as the nation's nation of the Croats, members of the Czech Society "Palava" from Mikulov. / U povodu obilježavanja 70. obljetnice od početka iseljavanja moravskih Hrvata u produkciji emisija pučke i predajne kulture PO Kultura tijekom 2017. i 2018. godine nastajao je dokumentarni film autora Davora Borića i Ljiljane Šišmanović. Film podsjeća na gotovo zaboravljenu i široj hrvatskoj javnosti nepoznatu povijesnu sudbinu hrvatske manjine u Češkoj i dokumentira njihova sjećanja i ostatke baštine moravskih Hrvata koju od devedesetih pokušavaju zabilježiti i koliko je moguće, revitalizirati. Svake prve nedjelje u rujnu raseljeni moravski Hrvati, njihovi potomci i njihovi prijatelji Česi i Nijemci okupljaju se na Kiritofu u Jevišovki. Sudjeluju u misnom slavlju, polažu cvijeće na spomenike i grobove, a potom se druže i prisjećaju minulih dana uz folklorni program, jelo i piće. Udruga građana hrvatske narodnosti u Češkoj, koju vode brat i sestra Jan Kopřiva i Lenka Kopřivová, pokrenula je 2010. opsežan dokumentacijski projekt Sudbine i jezik moravskih Hrvata, u sklopu kojeg je Lenka Kopřivová snimila oko 30 razgovora sa starim moravskim Hrvatima koji još govore svoj dijalekt i pamte stare običaje, predaje, legende i detalje iz svakodnevnog života prije 1945. Objavljena je i pjesmarica moravskih Hrvata te CD s njihovim pjesmama. Dokumentarni film uz atmosferu Kiritofa u Jevišovki, fragmente životnih priča Josefa Lawitschke, Marie Šalamonove i Ane Luzarove, te naraciju Lenke Koprivove, donosi i jedino sačuvano folklorno blago _ "Hrvatsku svadbu", koreografiju koja prikazuje svadbene običaje moravskih Hrvata, a danas je, kao i narodne nošnje moravskih Hrvata, čuvaju i izvode članovi češkoga društva "Palava" iz Mikulova.

programme.title: Vatroslav Kulish - Riffs / Vatroslav Kuliš - Riffovi
programme.desc: In this documentary, we present the creativity of Vatroslav Kuliš, certainly one of the most annoying contemporary Croatian painters. The film shows a painter whose studio is not only indoors, but also outdoors, in his home, as well as the city where he lives, on the streets and squares. Kulish is a painter whose work is open to a creative process that is his daily life, in the studio, and in the city of the Atelier. This concept is read through the painter's phase from the mid-70s to the work that creates the year the show was filmed. / U ovom dokumentarnom filmu predstavljamo stvaralaštvo Vatroslava Kuliša, zacijelo jednog od najintrigantnijih suvremenih hrvatskih slikara. Film prikazuje slikara čiji atelijer nije samo u zatvorenom prostoru, već i na otvorenom, u njegovu domu, kao i gradu u kojemu živi, na ulicama i trgovima. Kuliš je slikar čije je djelo otvoren stvaralački proces koji je sam njegov svakodnevni život, u atelijeru, i u gradu _ atelijeru. Ta se koncepcija iščitava kroz slikareve faze od sredine 70-ih godina do djela koja stvara u godini kad je emisija snimana.

programme.title: Klasika mundi
programme.desc: From the unique court park of Schonbrunn in Vienna, see a recording of the first part of the traditional summer concert of the Vienna Philharmonic Orchestra under the direction of the renowned maestro of Tugan Sozhi's. On the open stage, in a carefully selected program, they will be joined by a glad guest of the world's stage tenor Piotr Beczala and for the first time one of the most famous children's choirs, the Viennese boys. The program basis of the concert is the performance of the popular arias from the operetta and the operetta and works from the rich cultural European heritage. With this free concert in the unique ambience of the Schonbrunn Palace Palace in Vienna, which has been held since 2004, this brilliant orchestra continues to follow a specific cultural goal _ approaching classical music with a wide range of listeners and arousing interest outside its usual audience. Enjoy a spectacle produced by Orf television, which follow millions of viewers around the world in eighty countries. / Iz jedinstvenog dvorskog perivoja Schonbrunn u Beču pogledajte snimku prvog dijela tradicionalnog ljetnog koncerta Bečke filharmonije pod ravnanjem renomiranog maestra Tugana Sokhijeva. Na otvorenoj pozornici, u brižljivo odabranom programu, pridružit će im se rado viđeni gost svjetskih pozornica tenor Piotr Beczala te prvi put i jedan od najpoznatijih dječjih zborova, Bečki dječaci. Programska osnova koncerta je izvođenje popularnih arija iz opera i opereta te djela iz bogatog kulturnog europskog nasljeđa. Ovim besplatnim koncertnom u jedinstvenom ambijentu perivoja palače Schonbrunn u Beču, koji se održava još od 2004. godine, ovaj briljantni orkestar nastavlja slijediti specifičan kulturni cilj _ približavanje klasične glazbe širokom spektru slušatelja i pobuđivanje zanimanja izvan svoje uobičajene publike. Uživajte u spektaklu koji producira televizija ORF, a koji prate milijuni gledatelja diljem svijeta u osamdeset zemalja.

programme.desc: Week of the show in which the given topics in science, art and culture and social and political events that directly affect our lives are thinking of intellectuals, with moderation. / Tjedna emisija u kojoj zadane teme iz znanosti, umjetnosti i kulture te društvena i politička zbivanja koja izravno utječu na naš život promišljaju intelektualci, uz moderiranje.

programme.title: Parm, you are Nessala? / Garbo, kamo si nestala?
programme.desc: Innovative and poignant exploration of life, beauty and talent Greta Garbo and the reasons she left Hollywood at the height of her career. In 1941, at the age of 35, the biggest Hollywood star Greta Garbo suddenly announced that she was withdrawing. The fact that she would never play again commented on her, "If I could look at the premiere at least once and go home satisfied." In a unique and strong documentary by director Lorne Tucker, who connects exclusive archival recordings, interviews with people who knew her and the key moments of her life, Garbo re -speaks the voice of the award -winning actress Noomi Rapace (a girl with a Zmaja tattoo), providing dramatic insight and revealing the biggest puzzle of the film world. / Inovativno i potresno istraživanje života, ljepote i talenta Grete Garbo te razloga zbog kojeg je napustila Hollywood na vrhuncu karijere. Godine 1941., u dobi od 35 godina, najveća holivudska zvijezda Greta Garbo iznenada je objavila da se povlači. Činjenicu da nikada više neće glumiti oštro je komentirala: "Kad bih barem jedanput mogla pogledati pretpremijeru i otići doma zadovoljna." U jedinstvenom i snažnom dokumentarcu redateljice Lorne Tucker, koji spaja ekskluzivne arhivske snimke, intervjue s osobama koje su je poznavale te ključne trenutke njezina života, Garbo ponovno progovara glasom nagrađivane glumice Noomi Rapace (Djevojka s tetovažom zmaja), pružajući dramski uvid i razotkrivajući najveću zagonetku filmskog svijeta.

programme.title: Bitch, a deteriorating expression for a woman / Prasica, slabšalni izraz za žensko
programme.desc: The film follows a young artist Eva who is struggling with creative blockade, financial problems and chaotic private life. Through a series of humorous and raw situations, a generation of thirty -year -olds in Slovenia is shown, trying to find meaning, stability and himself in contemporary society. The film connects humor, irony and a realistic account of everyday life. / Film prati mladu umjetnicu Evu koja se bori s kreativnom blokadom, financijskim problemima i kaotičnim privatnim životom. Kroz niz duhovitih i sirovih situacija prikazuje se generacija tridesetogodišnjaka u Sloveniji koja pokušava naći smisao, stabilnost i sebe u suvremenom društvu. Film spaja humor, ironiju i realističan prikaz svakodnevice.

programme.title: Povlačenje
programme.desc: When their father dies, Ana meets his half -brother Ulija, who has come from Israel to France for a funeral. In her father's will it says that Ana cannot take over the inheritance until she finds a child she has given to adopt as a teenager. The journey takes it to Gaza during the 2005 Israeli withdrawal, a time of full danger and uncertainty. / Kada im umre otac, Ana susreće svog polubrata Ulija koji je iz Izraela doputovao u Francusku na pogreb. U očevoj oporuci piše da Ana ne može preuzeti nasljedstvo dok ne pronađe dijete koje je dala na posvajanje kao tinejdžerica. Putovanje je vodi u Gazu tijekom izraelskog povlačenja 2005., vremena punog opasnosti i neizvjesnosti.

programme.title: Klasika mundi
programme.desc: From the unique court park of Schonbrunn in Vienna, see a recording of the first part of the traditional summer concert of the Vienna Philharmonic Orchestra under the direction of the renowned maestro of Tugan Sozhi's. On the open stage, in a carefully selected program, they will be joined by a glad guest of the world's stage tenor Piotr Beczala and for the first time one of the most famous children's choirs, the Viennese boys. The program basis of the concert is the performance of the popular arias from the operetta and the operetta and works from the rich cultural European heritage. With this free concert in the unique ambience of the Schonbrunn Palace Palace in Vienna, which has been held since 2004, this brilliant orchestra continues to follow a specific cultural goal _ approaching classical music with a wide range of listeners and arousing interest outside its usual audience. Enjoy a spectacle produced by Orf television, which follow millions of viewers around the world in eighty countries. / Iz jedinstvenog dvorskog perivoja Schonbrunn u Beču pogledajte snimku prvog dijela tradicionalnog ljetnog koncerta Bečke filharmonije pod ravnanjem renomiranog maestra Tugana Sokhijeva. Na otvorenoj pozornici, u brižljivo odabranom programu, pridružit će im se rado viđeni gost svjetskih pozornica tenor Piotr Beczala te prvi put i jedan od najpoznatijih dječjih zborova, Bečki dječaci. Programska osnova koncerta je izvođenje popularnih arija iz opera i opereta te djela iz bogatog kulturnog europskog nasljeđa. Ovim besplatnim koncertnom u jedinstvenom ambijentu perivoja palače Schonbrunn u Beču, koji se održava još od 2004. godine, ovaj briljantni orkestar nastavlja slijediti specifičan kulturni cilj _ približavanje klasične glazbe širokom spektru slušatelja i pobuđivanje zanimanja izvan svoje uobičajene publike. Uživajte u spektaklu koji producira televizija ORF, a koji prate milijuni gledatelja diljem svijeta u osamdeset zemalja.

programme.title: Bernadette
programme.desc: The film was accompanied by Bernadette Chirac during her two presidential terms of her husband Jacques Chirac, that is, from 1995 until Nicolas Sarkozy's election in 2007. Bernadette expected to finally get the place she deserves to come to the Elysee Palace, because she was always a support to her husband and helped him to become president, but she fooled. She avenged herself by becoming an influential media figure. / Film prati Bernadette Chirac tijekom dva predsjednička mandata njezina supruga Jacquesa Chiraca, odnosno od 1995. do izbora Nicolasa Sarkozyja 2007. Bernadette je očekivala da će dolaskom u Elizejsku palaču konačno dobiti mjesto koje zaslužuje, jer je svom suprugu uvijek bila potpora i pomogla mu da postane predsjednik, ali prevarila se. Osvetila se tako što je postala utjecajna medijska ličnost.

programme.title: Fotografija u Hrvatskoj
programme.desc: U formi kratkog dokumentarnog filma emisija predstavlja autore i teme iz povijesti hrvatske fotografije te suvremene autore koji djeluju na hrvatskoj sceni.

programme.title: 45. Osor music evenings / 45. Osorske glazbene večeri
programme.desc: This music festival, which has been held since 1976, has founded television and film director Daniel Marusic, guided by three basic premises: international character, affirmation of Croatian contemporary artistic creativity and the affirmation of Osor as a city of culture and music. In the Renaissance Basilica, the Church of the Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary, the 45th Osor Music Evening was opened by the HRT Women's Choir with an instrumental ensemble of the blower and percussionist under the direction of Tomislav Facini, with the performance of Madrigal by Eccellen Petar Bergama. Along with his matrigals, the song of the sea of ​​Igor Kuljeric was performed, whose creativity and long-standing leadership of the HRT choir left a strong mark in Croatian music culture. The European breath at the concert was brought by Les Angelus Claude Debussy in the choir processing of Clytus Gottwald. / Ovaj glazbeni festival koji se održava od 1976. godine utemeljio je televizijski i filmski redatelj Daniel Marušić vođen trima osnovnim premisama: međunarodnim karakterom, afirmacijom hrvatskog suvremenog umjetničkog stvaralaštva te afirmacijom Osora kao grada kulture i glazbe. U renesansnoj bazilici, crkvi Uznesenja Blažene Djevice Marije, 45. Osorske glazbene večeri otvorio je Ženski zbor HRT-a uz instrumentalni ansambl puhača i udaraljkaša pod ravnanjem Tomislava Fačinija i to izvedbom madrigala Spiriti eccellenti Petra Bergama. Uz njegove madrigale izvedena je i skladba More Igora Kuljerića, čije su stvaralaštvo i dugogodišnje vodstvo Zbora HRT-a ostavili snažan trag u hrvatskoj glazbenoj kulturi. Europski dašak na koncertu donijela je skladba Les Angelus Claudea Debussyja u zborskoj obradi Clytusa Gottwalda.

programme.title: Razgovor sa stijenama
programme.desc: Little is known that the geological material of the Earth's crust in the territory of Croatia reflects originally from two continents: European and African. Only a small part of Croatia belongs to the old European use. The beginning of our journey with Medvednica is the border zone of African, that is, the Adriatic microplog and the Eurasian slab. It is here that this tectonic border and zone of the collision of these two plates. The study of the geological material of Medvednica is started along its northwest edge, on a seismogenous fault that was the causative agent of the last Zagreb earthquake on March 2, 2020. After that, we get acquainted with the rocks of this mountain that differ in the type, composition, way and place of Genesis. In the word, it will really be boring here and uniformly talking to the rocks. In the mystical landscape of the abandoned Upper Bistra Mine, we discover unusual stone pillows, pillow lava or pillow lava. These findings represent the rest of the former Oceanic area called Neotetthys and thus geologically follow where this ocean was located at the time of the Mesozoik, in the Triassic period 250 million years ago. Following the traces in the rocks woven in Medvedgrad's walls, we explore the geological heritage of Medvednica from the Paleozoic period all the way to the rocks of only 16 million years old, such as the most famous _ lithotamian limestone from which the Zagreb Cathedral was built. We travel to a period of warm mycene about 12 million years ago, when Medvednica was mostly surrounded by water and occasionally emerged as an island in the sea of ​​paratetitis. We will also visit the Veternica Cave created by the action of the water for millions of years. The water path leads us a little more west, to the Žumberak Nature Park. The story of the Triassic Dolomites that prevail here is located in the period 240 million years ago. In Samobor Highlands, we will enter the mine of St. Barbara, the only place in Croatia where you can see the Siderit mineral. With the return to Medvedgrad, we round out this journey enriched with insights that go back to the past. Participants: prof. Ph.D. Bruno Tomljenović, prof. Ph.D. Drazen Balen, Ph.D. Jasenka Sremac, Asst. Ph.D. Ivica Pavičić, prof. Ph.D. Vesnica Garešić, Maja Klisurić and Tajana Ban Ćurić, B.Sc. geol. / Malokome je poznato kako geološka građa Zemljine kore na području Hrvatske odražava podrijetlo iz dvaju kontinenata: europskog i afričkog. Staroj europskoj kori pripada samo manji dio Hrvatske. Početak našeg putovanja Medvednicom je granična zona Afričke, odnosno Jadranske mikroploče i Euroazijske ploče. Upravo je ovdje ta tektonska granica i zona sudara tih dviju ploča. Istraživanje geološke građe Medvednice započinjemo uz njezin sjeverozapadni rub, na seizmogenom rasjedu koji je bio uzročnikom zadnjeg zagrebačkog potresa 22. ožujka 2020. godine. Nakon toga upoznajemo se sa stijenama ove planine koje se razlikuju po vrsti, sastavu, načinu i mjestu postanka. Riječju, ovdje zbilja neće biti dosadno i jednolično razgovarati sa stijenama. U mističnom krajoliku napuštenoga rudnika Gornja Bistra otkrivamo neobične kamene jastuke, pillow lave ili jastučaste lave. Ovi nalazi predstavljaju ostatak nekadašnjeg oceanskoga prostora koji se zvao Neotethys i tako geološki pratimo gdje se taj ocean nalazio u vrijeme mezozoika, u razdoblju trijasa prije 250 milijuna godina. Slijedeći tragove u stijenama utkanih u zidine Medvedgrada, istražujemo geološku baštinu Medvednice od razdoblja paleozoika sve do stijena starih tek nekih 16 milijuna godina, poput najpoznatijeg _ litotamnijskog vapnenca od kojeg je sagrađena i Zagrebačka katedrala. Putujemo do razdoblja toploga miocena prije oko 12 milijuna godina, kada je Medvednica većinom bila okružena vodom i povremeno izranjala kao otok u moru Paratetis. Posjetit ćemo i špilju Veternicu nastalu djelovanjem vode tijekom milijuna godina. Put vode vodi nas malo zapadnije, u Park prirode Žumberak. Priča o trijaskim dolomitima koji ovdje prevladavaju smještena je u razdoblje prije 240 milijuna godina. U Samoborskom gorju, ući ćemo u rudnik Sv. Barbara, jedino mjesto u Hrvatskoj gdje možete vidjeti mineral siderit. Povratkom na Medvedgrad zaokružujemo ovo putovanje obogaćeni spoznajama koje sežu milijune godina u prošlost. Sudjeluju: prof. dr. sc. Bruno Tomljenović, prof. dr. sc. Dražen Balen, dr. sc. Jasenka Sremac, doc. dr. sc. Ivica Pavičić, prof. dr. sc. Vesnica Garešić, Maja Klisurić i Tajana Ban Ćurić, dipl. ing. geol.

programme.title: As it is said / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The HTV Education and Science Department, in cooperation with the Croatian Language Institute, has recorded thirty videos in which, in addition to linguistic advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language such as the language of young people and foreign words in the Croatian language are addressed. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Stokavian and Chakavian dialects and unusual names of the place, but also of the frequent and unusual personal names. The head of the interview is the Croatian language professor Katarina Marjanovic, who gives numerous followers on Instagram. Her interviewees are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijevic, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidovic, Ivana Kurtovic Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec.

programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore together and discover the world around us, learn about ourselves and others. We learn in play, in songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuh every morning, every day from 6.30am to 1pm. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sixty short stories of sound, which are heard through the ears of a small but very active being called "sound collector", which has a passion for sound and all the concepts related to sound, despite the fact that he hears very poorly. This small being spends his days discovering and learning new sounds he finds on his adventures: these are the most common sounds of the sea, sounds that produce beings in the sea, the sounds produced by insects, including snoring his best friend and pet Marta. / Šezdeset kratkih pričica o zvuku, koje se čuju kroz uši malog, ali vrlo aktivnog bića zvanog "Sakupljač zvukova", koji ima strast za zvuk i sve pojmove vezane uz zvuk, unatoč činjenici da on vrlo slabo čuje. To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: The little brother of the great Hairy fell into the hole and the great Hairy took Tracker. It's time to rescue in the jungle! // Daring Deni tempts extreme climbing with Ace Sorenson. Dogs on patrol must save the climbing duo. / Mali brat Velikog Hairyja je pao u rupu, a Veliki Hairy je odnio Trackera. Vrijeme je za spašavanje u džungli! // Odvažni Deni iskušava ekstremno penjanje s Ace Sorenson. Psići u ophodnji moraju spasiti penjački dvojac.

programme.title: Vrijeme je za Timmyja
programme.desc: Timmy is a little lamb eager for new knowledge. He has just been three years old, and since he is the only lamb in the herd, he used to being all over his. But now he is going to kindergarten with other cubs and will have to learn to behave in the company of his peers. In each episode, one day is shown in kindergarten. The daily routine of the only crazy toddler disrupts. Through various events and accidents, Timmy and his friends learn about life and friendship. / Timmy je malo janje željno novih znanja. Upravo je navršio tri godine, a budući da je jedino janje u stadu, navikao je da sve bude po njegovom. No sad kreće u vrtić s drugim mladuncima i morat će se naučiti ponašati u društvu svojih vršnjaka. U svakoj se epizodi prikazuje jedan dan u vrtiću. Svakodnevnu rutinu remete jedino ludorije mališana. Kroz razne zgode i nezgode, Timmy i njegovi prijatelji uče o životu i prijateljstvu.

programme.title: Krceki
programme.desc: Krceki is a small family: squirrel, acorn, coconut and peanuts. They live together in Krcograd and love adventures. Because of their curiosity, they fall into various troubles, and in order to solve the problem, they always invent a machine. The machine does not always work the way they imagined and emerge many humorous and unforeseen situations. We wish you a great party with Krcek! You are also awaiting rhymes and computer games! / Krceki su mala obitelj: vjeverica, žir, kokos i kikiriki. Žive zajedno u Krcogradu i vole avanture. Zbog svoje znatiželje upadaju u razne nevolje, a kako bi riješili problem izmisle uvijek neki stroj. Stroj ne radi uvijek onako kako su zamislili i nastanu mnoge šaljive i nepredviđene situacije. Želimo vam odličnu zabavu s Krcekima! Također vas očekuju i pjesmice i računalna igra!

programme.title: Krceki - song / Krceki - pjesmica
programme.desc: In addition to the animated series of Krceki, we are also coming to us by seven rhymes: bragger, plack, smart, good, angry, shy and brave. Each rhyme sings about the features of one character from the Krceki series. Music, Verses, Performance: David Vurdelja _ Baby Dooks Authors of the series: Denis Alenta, Vjekoslav Zivkovic, Marija Ivsic Editor: Sanja Nakic / Uz animiranu seriju Krceki stiže nam i sedam pjesmica: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljivko i Hrabrica. Svaka pjesmica pjeva o osobinama jednog lika iz serijala Krceki. Glazba, stihovi, izvedba: David Vurdelja _ Baby Dooks Autori serije: Denis Alenti, Vjekoslav Živković, Marija Ivšić Urednica: Sanja Nakić

programme.title: Pussy and puppy / Maca i Psić
programme.desc: Maca and a puppy walk through the woods. / Maca i Psić šetaju šumom.

programme.title: Pocoyo
programme.desc: Pocoyo is a curious toddler dressed in blue from head to toe, prone to jokes and tiny mischief. The series follows the fun adventures of Pocoya and his friends, and each episode deals with another topic. The cheerful societies explore the world through play and teaches new words and concepts. And by the way she has a good time. The fourth season introduces us to the new character Nina and her pet robot Robert. / Pocoyo je radoznali mališan odjeven u plavo od glave do pete, sklon šali i sitnim nestašlucima. Serija prati zabavne pustolovine Pocoya i njegovih prijatelja, a svaka se epizoda bavi drugom temom. Veselo društvance kroz igru istražuje svijet i uči nove riječi i pojmove. I usput se dobro zabavlja. Četvrta sezona upoznaje nas s novim likom Ninom i njezinim kućnim ljubimcem robotom Robertom.

programme.title: Pjesmica Prsti
programme.desc: Our fingers are wonderful and they are constantly beside us. Where do we, they are there! What do we come up with, they do! Sometimes they are obedient, sometimes naughty. They are so important and useful that they deserved to have their song, do you agree? / Naši prsti su čudesni i stalno su pored nas. Kud mi, tud i oni! Što mi smislimo, oni odrade! Katkad su poslušni, katkad nestašni. Toliko su važni i korisni da su zaslužili imati i svoju pjesmu, slažete li se?

programme.title: Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty -two -minute episodes of the series, you are waiting for unprecedented stories and posts: how to wash your paws with your puppy, how to feed it, how to put the laundry on drying and beat the clips, remove the dishes from the washing machine, prepare the orange juice, sweep the house, plant the plants in the garden, or to pack yourself for a trip. Spend the morning in the company of a two -year -old! The series prepared by: Dario Hacek, Valentina Mavretić, Srđan Gulić Producer: Marinela Brala Editors: Sanja Nakić, Tanja Kirhmajer / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka! Seriju pripremili: Dario Hacek, Valentina Mavretić, Srđan Gulić Producentica: Marinela Brala Urednice: Sanja Nakić, Tanja Kirhmajer

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey is a lovely and tireless little six -year -old bitch of Australian cattle who lives with his mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves playing and draws all his family and the whole neighborhood into his world of fun and playing. / Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja.

programme.title: Mali Malabar
programme.desc: Little Malabar and octopus will get to know the water droplets, whose evaporation arises a huge cloud ... They will go with them and find out that they turn into ice crystals and alternate electrons, which is why lightning occur! Ice crystals in large clouds travel up and down by alternating electrons. These electric charges then unite and move the same channel, making lightning! / Mali Malabar i hobotnica upoznat će vodene kapljice, čijim isparavanjem nastane golemi oblak... Otići će s njima i doznati da se one pretvore u ledene kristale i izmjenjuju elektrone, zbog čega nastanu munje! Ledeni kristali u velikim oblacima putuju gore-dolje izmjenjujući elektrone. Ti se električni naboji potom ujedine i kreću istim kanalom, pri čemu stvaraju munje!

programme.title: Pepe, Bubi and Lu near Dr. Zdravka / Pepe, Bubi i Lu kod dr. Zdravke
programme.desc: Pepe, Bubi and Lu with Dr. Zdravka Puppet Played series for the youngest about going to the doctor. Her main characters are Pepe, Bubi and Lu, toddlers who still grow milk teeth. They are a little naughty and are very afraid of doctors and injections, but with the dear doctor Zdravko and the ridiculous uncle of God, they will overcome all the lessons and overcome the fear of the office. There are three fun songs in the series! / PEPE, BUBI I LU kod dr. Zdravke Lutkarska igrana serija Serija za najmlađe o odlasku liječniku. Njezini su glavni junaci Pepe, Bubi i Lu, mališani kojima još rastu mliječni zubi. Malo su nestašni i jako se boje doktora i injekcije, ali uz dragu doktoricu Zdravku i smiješnog ujaka Božu savladat će sve lekcije i pobijediti strah od ordinacije. U serijalu vas očekuju i tri zabavne pjesmice!

programme.title: Oggy Oggy
programme.desc: OGGY OGGY is a computer animated series for the preschool age of the author Jean Cayrol and Cedrica Gunerry, the series follows a kitten Ogya who embarks on an adventure with friends of Mallow and Sporty into the world where everything is made of children's toys. / Oggy Oggy je kompjuterski animirana serija za predškolsku dob autora Jeana Cayrola i Cedrica Guarnerija, Serija prati mačića Oggyja koji kreće u avanturu s prijateljima Mallow i Sporty u svijet gdje je sve napravljeno od dječjih igračaka.

programme.title: Pjesmica Brokula

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon is a cute little rabbit that foists the vitalness of childhood. In age, when small bunnies (like small children) are studying in people and experience challenges in relation to their parents, they move to school, learn generally about the world, they face authorities and, of course, learn their language. Children can take Simon for an example of taking care of himself, I can learn from him and from his incompetents, from situations where simon needs to give in in his insistence and spoiling, and always remain polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on books Stephanie Blake in the edition of the French publisher Lecole des loisirs. He was directed by the TV series Julien Cayot, and it was produced by Go-N Productions. The series in France had Prime Minister 17. December 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. programme.title: Romano Bolkovic - 1 on 1 / Romano Bolković - 1 na 1
programme.desc: With guest Gordan Kolak, we talk about how Koncar managed to grow 21 quarterly in a row, despite global disorders and challenges, and what were the most critical moments during this period and key decisions that made continuity. We are talking about his lead of leadership of 2019, the first moves and knowledge, as well as what he would do otherwise today, with more experience. In the show, we discover that Koncar has reached a level where more than 70% of revenue comes from foreign markets, such as the tactic of entering demanding markets such as Germany, Scandinavia, Saudi Arabia _ and how an ambitious expansion in the US develops. We also discuss the transformation of the organization's mentality with a long industrial tradition and ways of motivating employees to accept changes. We also touched on business scaning issues with a book of orders of 2 billion euros, adjustments to internal systems and challenges of maintenance and deadlines. We are talking about strategic projects _ from tram and trains to transformer for Saudi Arabia and the first battery electric motor train _ and which of them Kolak sees them as a turning point for Koncar. We are especially involved in investments worth more than 85 million euros in the last five years and plans for an additional 80+ million, as well as the logic and criteria of investment decisions. We find out why Koncar does not follow trends in the field of sustainability and ESG, but leads them, and how it positions in the context of the global green transition _ as a manufacturer, integrator and innovator. We also discuss global political-economic challenges _ market fragmentation, customs barriers and tensions between the EU, the US and China _ and the strategies to relieve these risks. Particular emphasis is placed on Končar _ Digital, the goals of this project, digitization and artificial intelligence in energy, maintenance and production. We find out how difficult it is to find and maintain top engineers in Croatia today, how Koncar resolves this challenge, but also how foreign workforce and different cultures integrate. We also asked him what he would say to those who claim that Croatia no longer has a serious industry, and what he would change in cooperation with the domestic industry and the state, the legislative and fiscal framework. On a personal level, Kolak reveals that his experience from the Homeland War and the UN missions forms his style of leadership and decisions in crises. And there are sports lessons _ triathlon endurance, planning and mental strength _ used in guiding Koncar and maintaining a balance in the demanding role of the leader. Gordan Kolak, CEO of Koncar d.d., graduated from the Faculty of Technical at the University of Rijeka and received his master's degree from the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and Naval Architecture, University of Zagreb. During his professional career, he develops intensively knowledge and skills in the field of strategic organizations, as well as in the field of national and homeland security, through university education and later training on prestigious American and European civil and military colleges. He is an expert in the business, financial and organizational restructuring of complex business systems with exceptional management and consulting experience, which he confirms with the successful management of his own consulting company focused on business consultations in the ICT solution, strategic planning, implementation, control and corporate management and audit. He developed and applied his professional experiences as director and CEO of DOK-ING (robotic special-purpose machinery), King ICT (ICT system integration), megatrend (ICT distribution), megatrend business solutions (ICT solutions) and transmission lines. In 2019, he was appointed Deputy President, and in 2020 CEO Končar d.d. As a leading man, he conducted a comprehensive restructuring of the company with the aim of strengthening the segment of renewable energy and digital and advanced technological solutions. In doing so, revenues, profit, profit margin and newly reached jobs reached the highest levels in the history of the group. Particular emphasis puts on internationalization of business, modernization of production capacity, digital transformation, investment in research and development, and strengthening corporate culture and organization resistance. Under his leadership, Koncar positioned himself as the largest Croatian net exporter and leader of technological innovations in the region, with a clear focus on sustainability and digital transition. As a member of the Armed Forces of the Republic of Croatia, he actively participated in the Homeland War and the development of the defense system. He also participated in the UN peacekeeping mission in Sierra Leone, and is still active in the development of the national security and defense system of the Republic of Croatia. He served as president of the Croatian Association of Business Advisers and lecturers at the Zagreb School of Economics and Management. From 2015 to 2020 he was the secretary of the Homeland Security Council of the President of the Republic of Croatia. In addition, he is an active member of numerous business associations. Gordan is a feature / S gostom Gordanom Kolakom razgovaramo o tome kako je Končar uspio ostvariti rast 21 kvartal zaredom, unatoč globalnim poremećajima i izazovima, te koji su bili najkritičniji trenuci u tom razdoblju i ključne odluke koje su omogućile kontinuitet. Govorimo o njegovom preuzimanju vodstva 2019., prvim potezima i spoznajama, kao i o tome što bi danas, s više iskustva, napravio drugačije. U emisiji otkrivamo kako je Končar dosegnuo razinu na kojoj više od 70% prihoda dolazi s inozemnih tržišta, kakva je bila taktika ulaska na zahtjevna tržišta poput Njemačke, Skandinavije, Saudijske Arabije _ i kako se razvija ambiciozna ekspanzija u SAD-u. Razgovaramo i o transformaciji mentaliteta organizacije s dugom industrijskom tradicijom, te načinima motiviranja zaposlenika da prihvate promjene. Dotaknuli smo se i pitanja skaliranja poslovanja s knjigom narudžbi težom od 2 milijarde eura, prilagodbi internih sustava te izazova održavanja kvalitete i rokova. Govorimo o strateškim projektima _ od tramvaja i vlakova do transformatora za Saudijsku Arabiju i prvog baterijskog elektromotornog vlaka _ i o tome koji od njih Kolak vidi kao prekretnicu za Končar. Posebno se bavimo ulaganjima vrijednim više od 85 milijuna eura u posljednjih pet godina i planovima za dodatnih 80+ milijuna, kao i logikom i kriterijima investicijskih odluka. Saznajemo zašto Končar u području održivosti i ESG-a ne prati trendove, već ih predvodi, te kako se pozicionira u kontekstu globalne zelene tranzicije _ kao proizvođač, integrator i inovator. Razgovaramo i o globalnim političko-ekonomskim izazovima _ fragmentaciji tržišta, carinskim barijerama i napetostima između EU-a, SAD-a i Kine _ te strategijama za ublažavanje tih rizika. Poseban naglasak stavljamo na Končar _ Digital, ciljeve tog projekta, digitalizaciju i umjetnu inteligenciju u energetici, održavanju i proizvodnji. Saznajemo koliko je danas teško pronaći i zadržati vrhunske inženjere u Hrvatskoj, kako Končar rješava taj izazov, ali i kako se integriraju strana radna snaga i različite kulture. Pitali smo ga i što bi poručio onima koji tvrde da Hrvatska više nema ozbiljnu industriju, te što bi mijenjao u suradnji domaće industrije i države, zakonodavnom i fiskalnom okviru. Na osobnoj razini, Kolak otkriva kako njegovo iskustvo iz Domovinskog rata i UN-ovih misija oblikuje njegov stil liderstva i odluke u krizama. A tu su i sportske lekcije _ triatlonska izdržljivost, planiranje i mentalna snaga _ koje koristi u vođenju Končara i održavanju ravnoteže u zahtjevnoj ulozi lidera. Gordan Kolak, predsjednik uprave Končara d.d., diplomirao je na Tehničkom fakultetu Sveučilišta u Rijeci, a magistrirao na Fakultetu strojarstva i brodogradnje Sveučilišta u Zagrebu. Tijekom svoje profesionalne karijere intenzivno razvija znanja i vještine na području strateškog upravljanja organizacijama, kao i u području nacionalne i domovinske sigurnosti, kroz sveučilišno obrazovanje i kasnije usavršavanje na prestižnim američkim i europskim civilnim i vojnim učilištima. Stručnjak je za poslovno, financijsko i organizacijsko restrukturiranje složenih poslovnih sustava s iznimnim menadžerskim i konzultantskim iskustvom, koje potvrđuje uspješnim vođenjem vlastite konzultantske tvrtke usmjerene na poslovno savjetovanje u području ICT rješenja, strateškog planiranja, implementacije, nadzora te korporativnog upravljanja i revizije. Svoja profesionalna iskustva razvijao je i primjenjivao kao direktor i predsjednik Uprava tvrtki DOK-ING (robotizirani strojevi za posebne namjene), King ICT (integracija ICT sustava), Megatrend (ICT distribucija), Megatrend poslovna rješenja (ICT rješenja) te Dalekovod proizvodnja. Godine 2019. imenovan je zamjenikom predsjednika, a 2020. predsjednikom Uprave tvrtke KONČAR d.d. Kao čelni čovjek proveo je sveobuhvatno restrukturiranje kompanije s ciljem jačanja segmenta obnovljivih izvora energije te digitalnih i naprednih tehnoloških rješenja. Pritom su prihodi, dobit, profitna marža i novougovoreni poslovi dosegli najveće razine u povijesti Grupe. Poseban naglasak stavlja na internacionalizaciju poslovanja, modernizaciju proizvodnih kapaciteta, digitalnu transformaciju, ulaganja u istraživanje i razvoj te jačanje korporativne kulture i otpornosti organizacije. Pod njegovim vodstvom KONČAR se pozicionirao kao najveći hrvatski neto izvoznik i predvodnik tehnoloških inovacija u regiji, s jasnim fokusom na održivost i digitalnu tranziciju. Kao pripadnik Oružanih snaga Republike Hrvatske aktivno je sudjelovao u Domovinskom ratu i razvoju obrambenog sustava. Sudjelovao je i u UN-ovoj mirovnoj misiji u Sierra Leoneu, a i dalje je aktivan u razvoju nacionalnog sigurnosno-obrambenog sustava Republike Hrvatske. Obnašao je dužnost predsjednika Hrvatske udruge poslovnih savjetnika te predavača na Zagrebačkoj školi ekonomije i menadžmenta. Od 2015. do 2020. godine bio je tajnik Vijeća za domovinsku sigurnost predsjednice Republike Hrvatske. Uz to, aktivan je član brojnih poslovnih udruga. Gordan je odlikov

programme.title: Otvoreno
programme.desc: The second anniversary of the Hamas attack on Israel, when almost 1,200 people were killed and 250 were abducted and taken to Gaza's belt. Israel then launched an attack for the complete destruction of Hamas and tens of thousands of people have been killed in daily shells. In Egypt, the negotiations of Israel and Hamas on the peacekeeping plan of US President Donald Trump. Can two sides reach an agreement, how acceptable is Trump's plan and can the negotiations contribute to the permanent interruption of fire in Gaza? Guests are: Assoc. Ph.D. Đana Luša, Political Science, Faculty of Political Science in Zagreb, Ph.D. Gordan Akrap, Vice -Rector of the University of Defense and Security "Dr. Franjo Tudjman", Hassan Haidar Diab, a journalist of "Vecernji List". / Druga je godišnjica napada Hamasa na Izrael, kada je ubijeno gotovo 1200 ljudi, a 250 oteto i odvedeno u pojas Gaze. Izrael je nakon toga pokrenuo napad za potpuno uništenje Hamasa i od tada su u svakodnevnim granatiranjima ubijeni deseci tisuća ljudi. U Egiptu traju pregovori Izraela i Hamasa o mirovnom planu američkog predsjednika Donalda Trumpa. Mogu li dvije strane postići dogovor, koliko im je Trumpov plan prihvatljiv i mogu li pregovori pridonijeti trajnom prekidu vatre u Gazi? Gosti su: izv. prof. dr. sc. Đana Luša, politologinja, Fakultet političkih znanosti u Zagrebu, dr. sc. Gordan Akrap, prorektor Sveučilišta obrane i sigurnosti "Dr. Franjo Tuđman", Hassan Haidar Diab, novinar "Večernjeg lista".

programme.desc: Flats in Croatia are re -destroying records in Croatia. New construction in just one year has increased 14 percent, ancient construction almost 13. programme.title: Labirint
programme.desc: Not so long ago it wasn't enough, today sixty years later we throw it in large quantities. With about 300,000 tons of thrown food, Croatia is an average of the EU annually, but at the very top when it comes to throwing food from households. Why do we buy excessively and then throw it, how much euros so end up in the basket, how to better plan and save? / Još ne tako davno nije je bilo dovoljno, danas šezdesetak godina poslije bacamo je u velikim količinama. S oko 300.000 tona bačene hrane godišnje Hrvatska je u prosjeku EU ali je zato pri samom vrhu kada je riječ o bacanju hrane iz kućanstava. Zašto prekomjerno kupujemo a onda bacamo, koliko eura tako završi u košu, kako bolje planirati i pri tome uštedjeti?

programme.title: Third age / Treća dob
programme.desc: The generation of which we owe the future and which provided us with the present on the International Day of the Elderly "honored" by a decision of the Government, according to which an annual allowance or colloquially called thirteenth pension will be 6 euros per year of service. Shocked and disappointed, as they say with this shameful decision, it is a generation that is difficult to break, and with some inexplicable fervor in the reportage of Višnja Ružojčić, they talk about survival from pension to retirement. With sea stories, we sail further through the Doriana Tikveni story show about people who have won championships and medals in various disciplines in diving. The 91-year-old fisherman who does not leave the passion for fishing, Marko Percan brings us the story. And often neglected retirees and those who care for them were visited by our Split team. / Generacija kojoj dugujemo budućnost i koja je nama osigurala sadašnjost na Međunarodni dan starijih osoba "počašćena" je odlukom Vlade prema kojoj će godišnji dodatak ili kolokvijalno nazvan trinaesta mirovina iznositi 6 eura po godini staža. Šokirani i razočarani, kako kažu ovom sramotnom odlukom, generacija je to koju je teško slomiti, pa s nekim neobjašnjivim žarom u reportaži Višnje Ružojčić govore o preživljavaju od mirovine do mirovine. S morskim pričama plovimo dalje kroz emisiju s pričom Doriane Tikvicki o ljudima koji su u različitim disciplinama u ronjenju osvajali prvenstva i medalje. O 91-godišnjem ribaru kojeg strast za ribarenjem ne napušta, priču nam donosi Marko Percan. A često zanemarene umirovljenike i one o koji njima skrbe, na Visu je posjetila naša splitska ekipa.

programme.desc: The entertaining teenage quiz has the ambitious goal of providing viewers with a new view of the possibility of the learning material being presented in the public space through modern and interactive television games. The matches are played for a single Cup system in which extensions are played after a regular 90 minutes and after the penalty box if the winner does not decide by then. Ostatak sudionika dolazi od strane pobjednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukome kup sistemu u kojemu se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toka jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobjednik. programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and every year is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...
