programme.title: SOKO Wien
programme.desc: Lukas Brandt lies shot to death in a warehouse. Together with his brother Jan and mother Ulli, he was part of a petty criminal family gang. To the outside world, they appear as bar owners who are in the process of getting their bar into shape. In fact, they earn their money through burglaries of all kinds. In Gokhan Kaya's pawn shop they get rid of their stolen goods, most recently jewelry from a notorious jeweler. His shop is considered a hub for money laundering by the Kogler gang, led by Colin, whose father and actual boss is currently sitting. Colin's brother paid for his intervention in Brandt's jewelry store break-in by losing an eye. Reason enough to punish Lukas for this? An alibi is claimed, and the question arises as to which perpetrator knew where Lukas was and when. The warehouse seemed to be a meeting place with his dealer, as evidenced by telltale puncture marks and the ecstasy he consumed shortly before his death. The fact that Luka's six-year-old niece Mia, who lives with her mother, "nibbled" one of the colorful pills while visiting her father Jan and had to go to the hospital, gives the research a new dimension. Just like the fact that fence Gokhan was duped by the Brandt brothers. / Lukas Brandt liegt erschossen in einer Lagerhalle. Zusammen mit seinem Bruder Jan und Mutter Ulli war er Teil einer kleinkriminellen Familienbande.Nach auSSen treten sie als Lokalbesitzer auf, die dabei sind, ihre Kneipe auf Vordermann zu bringen. Tatsachlich verdienen sie ihr Geld mit Einbruchen jeglicher Art. In Gokhan Kayas Pfandleihe werden sie ihr Diebesgut los, zuletzt Schmuck eines beruchtigten Juweliers.Sein Geschaft gilt als Umschlageplatz fur Geldwasche der Kogler-Bande, angefuhrt von Colin, dessen Vater und eigentlicher Chef gerade sitzt. Colins Bruder buSSte sein Einschreiten bei Brandts Einbruch im Schmuckladen mit dem Verlust eines Auges. Grund genug, Lukas dafur zu bestrafen? Ein Alibi wird behauptet, und es steht die Frage im Raum, welcher Tater gewusst hat, wo sich Lukas wann aufhalten wurde. Das Lagerhaus schien Treffpunkt mit seinem Dealer zu sein, was verraterische Einstichstellen und das kurz vor seinem Tod konsumierte Ecstasy dokumentieren.Dass auch Lukas sechsjahrige, bei ihrer Mutter lebende Nichte Mia bei ihrem Besuch bei Vater Jan eine der bunten Pillen "naschte" und ins Krankenhaus musste, verleiht den Recherchen eine neue Dimension. Genauso, wie die Tatsache, dass Hehler Gokhan von den Brandt-Brudern ubers Ohr gehauen wurde.

programme.title: A case for two / Ein Fall fur zwei
programme.desc: The body of Niklas Konig lies on the grounds of a Frankfurt rowing club. The young man was brutally beaten to death. The evening before he had a heated argument with his girlfriend. Both of them have a criminal record, Mina Wirtz even for serious bodily harm. Benjamin Hornberg takes over Mina's defense. The young mother is devastated. She not only lost her great love, but also her control. She had sworn to herself that she would never commit a crime again and wanted to achieve rehabilitation in order to then get her daughter Emma - who had been taken away from her by the youth welfare office - back. Mina was a kind of “model student” in the rehabilitation program. Niklas, on the other hand, who took part in the same program, caused problems. There were indications of a relapse into pill addiction, which is why Niklas originally became a criminal. When Mina found out, the argument broke out. The public prosecutor's office sees the motive here as emotional manslaughter. / Auf dem Gelande eines Frankfurter Rudervereins liegt die Leiche von Niklas Konig. Der junge Mann wurde brutal erschlagen. Am Abend zuvor hatte er einen heftigen Streit mit seiner Freundin.Beide sind vorbestraft, Mina Wirtz sogar wegen schwerer Korperverletzung. Benjamin Hornberg ubernimmt Minas Verteidigung. Die junge Mutter ist am Boden zerstort. Sie hat nicht nur ihre groSSe Liebe verloren, sondern auch die Beherrschung.Dabei hatte sie sich geschworen, nie wieder straffallig zu werden, wollte die Resozialisierung schaffen, um dann ihre Tochter Emma - die ihr das Jugendamt entzogen hatte - zuruckzubekommen. Im Resozialisierungsprogramm war Mina eine Art "Vorzeigeschulerin". Niklas hingegen, der am selben Programm teilnahm, machte Probleme. Es gab Hinweise auf einen Ruckfall in die Tablettensucht, wegen der Niklas ursprunglich kriminell wurde. Als Mina das herausfand, kam es zu besagtem Streit. Die Staatsanwaltschaft sieht hier das Tatmotiv: Totschlag im Affekt.

programme.title: SOKO Leipzig
programme.desc: A young man is rescued lifeless from the Karl Heine Canal. Henry Ste-wens was injured in the head before being placed in the water and drowned. Who wanted to make Henry disappear? Ina and her team begin the investigation into the 20-year-old's death. At the center of the search for clues: Henry's best friend and foster brother Noah, who wanted to meet him on the night of the crime. Was Noah jealous of Henry because he was finally happy? With carpentry training under his belt, he had just proposed to his girlfriend. But where did the money for the strikingly expensive engagement ring come from? Was Henry falling back into old criminal patterns? / Ein junger Mann wird leblos aus dem Karl-Heine-Kanal geborgen. Henry Ste-wens wurde am Kopf verletzt, bevor er ins Wasser gelegt wurde und ertrank. Wer wollte Henry verschwinden lassen?Fur Ina und ihr Team beginnen die Er-mittlungen um den Tod des 20-Jahrigen. Im Zentrum der Spurensuche: Henrys bes-ter Freund und Ziehbruder Noah, der sich in der Tatnacht mit ihm treffen wollte. War Noah eifersuchtig auf Hen-ry, weil der endlich glucklich war?Mit der Tischlereiausbildung in der Tasche machte er seiner Freundin gerade erst einen Heiratsantrag. Doch woher kam das Geld fur den auffallend teuren Verlobungsring? Fiel Henry in alte kriminelle Muster zuruck?

programme.sub-title: Thea Dorn and guests discuss current books / Über aktuelle Bucher diskutieren Thea Dorn und Gaste

Roman with Pasolini", Jose Rizal: "Noli me tangere" and Iris Wolff: "Lichtungen" "The Literary Quartet" is recorded at the round table in the foyer of the Berliner Ensemble. / Zum zehnjahrigen Jubilaum des "Literarischen Quartetts" begruSSt Thea Dorn drei ehemalige Kulturstaatsminister: Claudia Roth, Monika Grutters und Julian Nida-Rumelin.Besprochen werden: Aldous Huxley: "Schone neue Welt", Albert Ostermaier: "Die Liebe geht weiter. Roman mit Pasolini", Jose Rizal: "Noli me tangere" und Iris Wolff: "Lichtungen"."Das Literarische Quartett" wird im Foyer des Berliner Ensembles am runden Tisch aufgezeichnet.

programme.desc: The updated late edition of the "heute journal" rounds off the news day on ZDF - with the latest news, background reports, briefings and interviews. / Die aktualisierte Spatausgabe des "heute journal" rundet den Nachrichtentag im ZDF ab - mit den neuesten Nachrichten, Hintergrundberichten, Schaltgesprachen und Interviews.

programme.title: Famous and infamous - sex, scandals, murder / Beruhmt und Beruchtigt - Sex, Skandale, Mord
programme.desc: October 25, 1995. Susan Smith reports to the police that her car containing her two young sons, Michael and Alex, was stolen by an unknown person. However, the search is unsuccessful. After the mother becomes increasingly entangled in contradictions, the investigators uncover the terrible truth. Susan Smith sank the car with her two sons in a lake. She is sentenced to life in prison for her cruel act. Susan Smith is serving her sentence in a women's correctional facility in South Carolina. There she tries to gain advantages by seducing several law enforcement officers. When the affair is discovered, the officers themselves become defendants.Contemporary witnesses, former guards and court officials try to determine Susan Smith's motives, and in the process paint a disturbing portrait of a young woman who apparently never got over her father's suicide and the abuse by her stepfather.Sex, murder and scandals - this ten-part series deals with some of the most spectacular crimes of the last decades. Criminal cases full of tragedy, cruelty and endless suffering. Whether murdering sports stars, serial killers or sex with minors, the series deals with the deepest depths of criminal history. Contemporary witnesses, experts and those affected describe the trap from their perspective and clarify many unsolved questions. / 25. Oktober 1995. Susan Smith berichtet der Polizei, dass ihr Wagen mit ihren beiden kleinen Sohnen Michael und Alex von einem Unbekannten gestohlen wurde. Die Suche verlauft jedoch ergebnislos.Nachdem sich die Mutter zunehmend in Widerspruchen verstrickt, kommen die Ermittler der schrecklichen Wahrheit auf die Spur. Susan Smith hat den Wagen mit ihren beiden Sohnen in einem See versenkt. Fur ihre grausame Tat wird sie zu lebenslanger Haft verurteilt.Susan Smith verbringt ihre Haftstrafe in einer Justizvollzugsanstalt fur Frauen in South Carolina. Dort versucht sie, sich Vorteile zu verschaffen, indem sie mehrere Vollzugsbeamte verfuhrt. Als die Affaren auffliegen, werden die Beamten selbst zu Angeklagten.Zeitzeugen, ehemalige Warter und Gerichtsbeamte versuchen, die Motive von Susan Smith zu ermitteln, und zeichnen dabei das verstorende Portrat einer jungen Frau, die den Suizid ihres Vaters und den Missbrauch durch den Stiefvater anscheinend nie verwunden hat.Sex, Mord und Skandale - in dieser zehnteiligen Reihe geht es um einige der spektakularsten Verbrechen der letzten Jahrzehnte. Kriminalfalle voller Tragik, Grausamkeit und unendlichem Leid.Ob mordende Sportstars, Serienkiller oder Sex mit Minderjahrigen, die Reihe beschaftigt sich mit den tiefsten Abgrunden der Kriminalgeschichte. Zeitzeugen, Experten und Betroffene schildern die Falle aus ihrer Sicht und klaren dabei so manche ungeloste Frage auf.

programme.title: Leben an der deutsch-deutschen Grenze
programme.desc: Barbed wire and mines have divided Germany into East and West for 40 years - the death strip of the inner German border separates the country. For many Germans it becomes fate. In the film they tell their experiences: including refugees and border guards - and two women from Magdeburg. They are the first GDR citizens to cross the open border on November 9, 1989 - near Helmstedt, before the wall comes down in Berlin. For the Germans in the western "zone fringe area", the border is sometimes a profitable business. A million tourists a year put money into the pockets of the local economy, which also benefits from tax breaks and investment subsidies. On the GDR side, however, there is no way in or out of the five-kilometer-wide "exclusion zone" on the border without a special permit. There is a curfew and a ban on gatherings at night to make escapes under cover of darkness more difficult. Today the former border is the “Grune Band”: a unique nature reserve that winds through the middle of Germany. / 40 Jahre teilen Stacheldraht und Minen Deutschland in Ost und West - trennt der Todesstreifen der Innerdeutschen Grenze das Land. Fur viele Deutsche wird er zum Schicksal.Im Film erzahlen sie ihre Erlebnisse: darunter Fluchtlinge und Grenzsoldaten - und zwei Frauen aus Magdeburg. Sie sind die ersten DDR-Burger, die am 9. November 1989 uber die geoffnete Grenze fahren - bei Helmstedt, bevor in Berlin die Mauer fallt.Fur die Deutschen im westlichen "Zonenrandgebiet" ist die Grenze zuweilen ein eintragliches Geschaft. Eine Million Touristen pro Jahr spulen Geld in die Taschen der einheimischen Wirtschaft, die auch von Steuererleichterungen und Investitionszulagen profitiert. Auf DDR-Seite hingegen fuhrt in die funf Kilometer breite "Sperrzone" an der Grenze ohne Sonderausweis kein Weg hinein oder heraus. In der Nacht gelten dort eine Ausgangssperre und ein Versammlungsverbot, um Fluchten im Schutze der Dunkelheit zu erschweren. Heute ist die ehemalige Grenze das "Grune Band": ein einzigartiges Naturschutzgebiet, das sich mitten durch Deutschland schlangelt.

programme.title: Chemie des Kochens
programme.desc: Why do we love ice cream and pizza, and what is the secret to the perfect fries? Anyone who is interested in good food and would like to understand it better must look at the molecular level. In the "Terra X" two-part series "Chemistry of Cooking" Dr. Mai Thi Nguyen-Kim literally goes into the interior of pots, pans and ovens and gets to the bottom of our food culture. She shows how food changes during preparation and becomes tasty. In the episode "Water" Dr. Mai Thi Nguyen-Kim gets to the bottom of the most versatile of all elements. Water is not only the origin of all life, but is also found in all of its physical states in the kitchen: liquid, gaseous and ice. You need water for a hearty bouillabaisse at the southern French harbor, for steaming the perfect yeast dumpling in the Alps, but also for the creamy Sicilian granita. And what does water have to do with the perfect fries? Without water, there are no delicacies. / Warum lieben wir Eis und Pizza, und was ist das Geheimnis der perfekten Pommes? Wer sich fur gutes Essen interessiert, und es besser verstehen mochte, muss auf die molekulare Ebene schauen.Im "Terra X"-Zweiteiler "Chemie des Kochens" blickt Dr. Mai Thi Nguyen-Kim buchstablich in das Innere von Topfen, Pfannen, Öfen und geht unserer Esskultur auf den Grund. Sie zeigt, wie sich Nahrungsmittel wahrend der Zubereitung verandern und schmackhaft werden.In der Folge "Wasser" geht Dr. Mai Thi Nguyen-Kim dem vielseitigsten aller Elemente auf den Grund. Wasser ist nicht nur der Ursprung allen Lebens, sondern kommt auch in all seinen Aggregatzustanden in der Kuche vor: flussig, gasformig und als Eis. Wasser braucht man sowohl fur eine deftige Bouillabaisse am sudfranzosischen Hafen, zum Dampfen des perfekten Germknodels in den Alpen, aber auch fur die cremige sizilianische Granita. Und was hat Wasser mit der perfekten Pommes zu tun? Ohne Wasser keine Kostlichkeiten.

programme.title: Myth Castle (1) - Permanent home / Mythos Burg (1) - Feste Heimat
programme.desc: The "Terra This episode sheds light on the exciting past of famous castles - such as Burg Eltz on the Moselle or Windsor Castle in England. In the 12th and 13th centuries, Central Europe experienced a building boom. Well over 10,000 castles were built within 100 years. And the castle had already established itself throughout Europe as a status symbol of the powerful and as an effective residential and defensive structure. If all the monuments of power were still preserved, in Germany you would drive past a castle every 25 kilometers. The age of castles and their inhabitants has left its mark on German culture and language to this day. The word “burg” can be found in well over a thousand German place names alone. This episode of the “Terra X” series “Mythos Burg” is dedicated to the “burg” property. Even its original type - the moth - is as simple as it is ingenious: Build a tower, if possible on an elevated position, with a wide panoramic view and build a fence or wall around the outside. The castle is finished. A successful model: Over the centuries, increasingly complex and magnificent buildings emerge. The competition for the most beautiful, largest and most powerful castle was open. Europe is becoming a castle landscape. The focus of the two-part documentary is on famous and very important buildings at the time such as Eltz Castle, Hammerstein Castle, Trifels Castle and also Windsor Castle in England. How and where were castles built, how did people live in them, how did they defend their homes? With the help of various visual stylistic devices, life is breathed into the bulwarks of yesteryear. In an experiment, internationally renowned scientists show the sophisticated methods that were used to build and inhabit castles in the Middle Ages. / Die "Terra X"-Dokumentation "Mythos Burg" beleuchtet, wie die Burg als Wohn- und Wehrbau zum architektonischen Erfolgsmodell des Mittelalters wurde.Wie prachtvoll oder wie entbehrungsreich war das Leben auf den Burgen des Mittelalters? Diese Folge beleuchtet die aufregende Vergangenheit beruhmter Burgen - wie etwa Burg Eltz an der Mosel oder Windsor Castle in England.Im 12. und 13. Jahrhundert erlebte Mitteleuropa einen Bauboom. Innerhalb von 100 Jahren wurden weit uber 10.000 Burgen gebaut. Und bereits zuvor hatte sich die Burg als Statussymbol der Machtigen und als effektiver Wohn- und Wehrbau europaweit durchgesetzt. Waren all die Monumente der Macht noch erhalten, wurde man etwa in Deutschland alle 25 Kilometer an einer Burg vorbeifahren. Bis heute hat das Zeitalter der Burgen und ihrer Bewohner Spuren in der deutschen Kultur und Sprache hinterlassen. So steckt allein in weit uber tausend deutschen Ortsnamen das Wort "Burg".Diese Folge der "Terra X"-Reihe "Mythos Burg" widmet sich der Immobilie "Burg". Schon ihr Urtyp - die Motte - ist genauso schlicht wie genial: Errichte einen Turm, moglichst auf erhohtem Posten, mit weitem Panoramablick und ziehe einen Zaun oder eine Mauer auSSen herum. Fertig ist die Burg. Ein Erfolgsmodell: Über die Jahrhunderte entstehen immer komplexere und prachtvollere Bauten. Der Wettbewerb um die schonste, groSSte und machtigste Burg war eroffnet. Europa wird zu einer Burgenlandschaft.Im Mittelpunkt der zweiteiligen Dokumentation stehen beruhmte und seinerzeit sehr bedeutende Bauten wie Burg Eltz, Burg Hammerstein, Burg Trifels und auch Windsor Castle in England. Wie und wo wurden Burgen gebaut, wie lebten die Menschen auf ihnen, wie verteidigten sie ihr Zuhause? Mithilfe verschiedener visueller Stilmittel wird den Bollwerken von einst Leben eingehaucht. International renommierte Wissenschaftler zeigen im Experiment, mit welch ausgefeilten Methoden die Burgen des Mittelalters errichtet und bewohnt wurden.

programme.title: Arctic
programme.desc: After an emergency landing in the Arctic, Overgård is faced with a difficult decision: Should he wait by the plane for rescue or dare the life-threatening trek through the ice? When a rescue helicopter crashes, there is only one survivor. But the woman is unresponsive and her condition continues to worsen. Overgård straps them onto a sled and sets off through the icy landscape. A plane crashes over the Arctic, pilot Overgård (Mads Mikkelsen) is the only survivor. He sets up a makeshift camp in the wreckage of the plane and waits for help. A helicopter can actually locate him because he has written the letters "SOS" in the snow. But the landing in the middle of a storm fails and the helicopter crashes. Of the two passengers, only the co-pilot (Maria Thelma Smáradottir) is still alive, but is seriously injured and unresponsive. And her condition is getting worse and worse, so that Overgård only sees one way out. He wants to try to reach a rescue point far away. With the injured woman on a sled, he sets off on foot through the Arctic. But he doesn't just have to fight against hunger, the freezing temperatures and strong storms, an ice bar soon also takes in the weather. In his directorial debut, the Brazilian Joe Penna presents the fight between man and nature in its most extreme form. The hostile Arctic with its seemingly endless ice landscapes is both frightening and fascinating. The filming took place during the winter in the Icelandic highlands, which also posed an enormous challenge for the film crew due to the weather conditions. The Danish actor Mads Mikkelsen, who has already proven his skills in numerous international productions, shines in the leading role. / Nach einer Notlandung in der Arktis steht Overgård vor einer schweren Entscheidung: Soll er beim Flugzeug auf Rettung warten oder die lebensgefahrliche Wanderung durch das Eis wagen?Als ein Rettungshubschrauber verungluckt, gibt es nur eine Überlebende. Doch die Frau ist nicht ansprechbar und ihr Zustand verschlechtert sich immer mehr. Overgård schnallt sie auf einem Schlitten fest und macht sich auf den Weg durch die eisige Landschaft.Ein Flugzeug sturzt uber der Arktis ab, Pilot Overgård (Mads Mikkelsen) ist der einzige Überlebende. In den Trummern des Flugzeugs baut er sich ein provisorisches Lager auf und wartet auf Hilfe. Tatsachlich kann ihn ein Hubschrauber lokalisieren, da er die Buchstaben "SOS" in den Schnee geschrieben hat.Doch die Landung inmitten eines Sturms misslingt, der Helikopter verungluckt. Von den zwei Insassen ist nur die Kopilotin (Maria Thelma Smáradottir) noch am Leben, jedoch schwer verletzt und nicht ansprechbar. Und ihr Zustand verschlechtert sich immer mehr, sodass Overgård nur noch einen Ausweg sieht.Er will versuchen, einen weit entfernten Rettungspunkt zu erreichen. Mit der Verletzten auf einem Schlitten macht er sich zu FuSS auf den Weg durch die Arktis. Doch er muss nicht nur gegen Hunger, die eisigen Temperaturen und starken Sturme kampfen, auch ein Eisbar hat bald seine Witterung aufgenommen.In seinem Regiedebut prasentiert der Brasilianer Joe Penna den Kampf Mensch gegen Natur in seiner extremsten Form. Die lebensfeindliche Arktis mit ihren schier endlosen Eislandschaften ist dabei gleichermaSSen furchteinfloSSend und faszinierend.Die Dreharbeiten fanden wahrend des Winters im islandischen Hochland statt, was fur die Filmcrew aufgrund der Witterungsbedingungen ebenfalls eine enorme Herausforderung darstellte.In der tragenden Hauptrolle brilliert der danische Schauspieler Mads Mikkelsen, der sein Konnen bereits in zahlreichen internationalen Produktionen beweisen konnte.

programme.title: hallo deutschland
programme.desc: Das abwechslungsreiche Gesellschaftsmagazin des ZDF prasentiert emotionale Geschichten uber Menschen in Deutschland und Deutsche in aller Welt.True Crime gehort ebenso zu "hallo deutschland" wie Alltagsreportagen oder die "Retro"-Reihe uber herausragende Ereignisse der vergangenen Jahrzehnte. Dazu Reise, Lifestyle und das Neueste aus der Welt der Stars und Sternchen.

programme.title: Tobie Lolness - Small world, big adventure / Tobie Lolness - Kleine Welt, groSSes Abenteuer
programme.sub-title: Fight for freedom (1) / Kampf fur die Freiheit (1)
programme.desc: Tobie returns to the tree to help his friend Nils. He is accused of treason by his people. Meanwhile, a devastating plague of caterpillars breaks out in the treetops. Tobie even manages to get the woodcutters to join him in the fight against Jo Pull Mitch. Rolden has a seizure due to the hard physical work in the crater and dies as a result. / Tobie kehrt zuruck in den Baum, um seinem Freund Nils zu helfen. Unterdessen bricht eine verheerende Raupenplage in der Baumkrone aus.Bernique, die bizarre Tochter des Gefangnisdirektors, rettet in letzter Sekunde das Dorf vor den Raupen und wird als Heldin gefeiert, wahrend Tobie vor den Holzfallern eine bewegende Rede halt, die alle vollstandig von Nils Unschuld uberzeugt.Tobie schafft es sogar, dass die Holzfaller gemeinsam mit ihm in den Kampf gegen Jo Mitch ziehen. Rolden hat einen Schwacheanfall aufgrund der harten korperlichen Arbeit im Krater und stirbt an den Folgen.

programme.title: Tobie Lolness - Small world, big adventure / Tobie Lolness - Kleine Welt, groSSes Abenteuer

But Jo Mitch himself and his closest followers have already escaped with Sim and Maia Lolness as hostages. All other prisoners are freed by Tobie and the lumberjacks. Doch Jo Mitch selbst und seine engsten Gefolgsleute sind bereits mit Sim und Maia Lolness als Geiseln geflohen.Alle anderen Gefangenen werden von Tobie und den Holzfallern befreit. Bei der Gedenkzeremonie von Albert Rolden erscheint Elisha und lasst Tobie wissen, dass ihre Mutter wieder gesund ist und sie von nun an nicht mehr von seiner Seite weichen wird.

programme.title: Simon
programme.sub-title: We invent a game! / Wir erfinden ein Spiel!
programme.desc: Simon, Lou and Ferdinand have invented a new game. Ferdinand spontaneously expands the rules of the game. As Franz continues to invent new rules, Simon slowly has enough. Suddenly it starts to rain and the friends decide to continue playing in the house. But dad isn't happy about it at all. Too many things can break when playing ball indoors. Then Simon himself suggests changing the rules of the game. / Simon, Lou und Ferdinand haben ein neues Spiel erfunden. Spontan erweitert Ferdinand die Spielregeln. Als dann Franz auch noch laufend neue Regeln dazuerfindet, reicht es Simon langsam.Plotzlich fangt es an zu regnen, und die Freunde beschlieSSen, im Haus weiterzuspielen. programme.title: Meine Freundin Conni
programme.desc: Conni packs up Teddy and off we go. A sleepover at your girlfriend's is something exciting if you've never stayed somewhere else before. Conni is full of anticipation. Conni ist voller Vorfreude.Sie darf die Meerschweinchen futtern und isst zum ersten Mal Gemusefritten. Zum Nachtisch gibt es eine Kissenschlacht. Conni findet alles super, nur in der Nacht bekommt sie Heimweh. Doch Julia muntert Conni auf. Beide albern so lange herum, bis sie mude sind.

programme.title: Meine Freundin Conni
programme.desc: Conni has to go to the hairdresser because her bangs are hanging in front of her eyes. She dares to go to the hairdressing salon with her mom. There is a lovely hairdresser there who patiently answers Conni's questions: "Does cutting hair hurt?" Conni does the self-test and is surprised that she doesn't notice anything. She chooses the scented vanilla shampoo for washing her hair and sits down on an extra high chair. Conni beams as she looks at her new hairstyle in the mirror. / Conni muss zum Friseur, denn ihr Pony hangt vor ihren Augen. Zusammen mit Mama traut sie sich in den Friseursalon. Dort ist eine liebe Friseurin, die geduldig Connis Fragen beantwortet."Tut Haare schneiden weh?" Conni macht den Selbsttest und ist uberrascht, dass sie nichts merkt. Sie wahlt das duftende Vanilleshampoo fur das Haarewaschen und nimmt auf einem extra hohen Stuhl Platz. Conni strahlt, als sie ihre neue Frisur im Spiegel betrachtet.

programme.title: Meine Freundin Conni
programme.desc: Conni thinks about how frogs and toads move. Is there a difference? Grandpa suggests going on a discovery tour with Simon. Plants and animals develop in spring. Frogs hop, toads run. Conni learns what a toad hike is and even helps carry the bucket. Together with Grandpa they see tadpoles and watch storks building nests. / Conni uberlegt sich, wie sich Frosch und Krote fortbewegen. Gibt es einen Unterschied? Opa schlagt vor, gemeinsam mit Simon auf Entdeckungstour zu gehen.Im Fruhling entwickeln sich Pflanzen und Tiere. Frosche hupfen, Kroten laufen. Conni erfahrt, was eine Krotenwanderung ist, und hilft sogar beim Eimertragen. Zusammen mit Opa sehen sie Kaulquappen und beobachten Storche beim Nestbau.

programme.title: Bibi Blocksberg
programme.desc: Bibi and her friend Moni are bored while touring the castle. So Bibi tries out her witchcraft, with the result that the two girls end up in a secret room. There they discover the portrait of Princess Karla von Klunkerburg, who looks very similar to Bibi. When Bibi then behaves like a princess, it becomes clear: she has the young witch's disease. There is only one way to combat this: Bibi has to travel to the place of her dreams. / Bibi und ihre Freundin Moni langweilen sich wahrend einer Schlossbesichtigung. So probiert Bibi ihre Hexenkunste aus, mit dem Ergebnis, dass die beiden Madchen in einem geheimen Zimmer landen.Dort entdecken sie das Portrat von Prinzessin Karla von Klunkerburg, die Bibi sehr ahnlich sieht. Als sich Bibi danach wie eine Prinzessin verhalt, ist klar: Sie hat die Junghexenkrankheit. Gegen die gibt es nur ein Mittel: Bibi muss an den Ort ihrer Traume reisen.

programme.title: Taylors Welt der Tiere
programme.desc: Taylor and Tommy have a school trip coming up. While Tommy can't wait, Taylor isn't very enthusiastic. She is afraid of being separated from Gorilla Jack for so long. The day before they leave for the school trip, Taylor notices that Jack has caught a cold. Taylor definitely doesn't want to leave her hairy boyfriend alone. Tommy is extremely disappointed. Sie hat Angst davor, so lange von Gorilla Jack getrennt zu sein.Am Tag vor der Abreise zur Klassenfahrt stellt Taylor fest, dass Jack sich erkaltet hat. So will Taylor ihren behaarten Freund auf keinen Fall alleinlassen. Tommy ist mega enttauscht. Er hat sich so auf die Reise mit Taylor gefreut. Ist Jack wirklich so krank?

programme.title: Pirate Academy - Not for landlubbers / Pirate Academy - Nichts fur Landratten
programme.sub-title: Cards on the table / Karten auf den Tisch

programme.title: Pirate Academy - Not for landlubbers / Pirate Academy - Nichts fur Landratten
programme.sub-title: Finn, the protector / Finn, der Beschutzer

His protection is meant to keep them from getting into danger. He gets them into great trouble precisely because of his rash heroic actions. / Kaptn Yogatee glaubt an die Tauglichkeit seiner Seepferchen als Piraten und schickt sie auf eine Exkursion in die Wildnis. Finn ist uberzeugt, dass die drei ohne seinen Schutz verloren sind.Als Sina, Klaus und Elisa zu ihrer Exkursion in den Dschungel aufbrechen, begleitet Finn sie heimlich. Sein Schutz soll sie davor bewahren, in Gefahr zu geraten. Dabei bringt er sie gerade durch seine ubersturzten Heldentaten in groSSe Schwierigkeiten.

programme.title: Robin Hood - rascal from Sherwood / Robin Hood - Schlitzohr von Sherwood
programme.desc: An old man gives his wife a beautiful ring made of pure gold. When thieves see this, they steal the piece of jewelry. Will Marian be able to conjure the ring back? In fact, she can save it. But when he returns it to the old woman, Prince John takes it because she supposedly hasn't paid taxes. The prince places the ring in his already bulging gold chest. Marian's help is needed again. She simply makes the gold invisible. So the prince believes that the gold has been stolen. He then has Matilda put in prison. Now the imagination of Robin and his gang is asked: How can they free Matilda? / Ein alter Mann schenkt seiner Frau einen wunderschonen Ring aus purem Gold. Als Diebe das beobachten, stehlen sie das Schmuckstuck. Gelingt es Marian, den Ring zuruckzuzaubern?Tatsachlich kann sie ihn retten. Aber bei der Ruckgabe an die alte Frau nimmt Prinz John ihn an sich, weil sie angeblich keine Steuern gezahlt hat. Der Prinz legt den Ring in seine bereits prall gefullte Goldkiste. Schon wieder ist Marians Hilfe gefragt.Sie macht das Gold einfach unsichtbar. So glaubt der Prinz, das Gold sei gestohlen worden. Daraufhin lasst er Matilda ins Gefangnis stecken. Nun ist die Fantasie von Robin und seiner Bande gefragt: Wie konnen sie Matilda befreien?

programme.title: Robin Hood - rascal from Sherwood / Robin Hood - Schlitzohr von Sherwood
programme.desc: Trevor built a flying machine. But something goes wrong on the first test flight and Derke, the dragon enchanted as a hamster, sits alone in the plane and crashes. Nevertheless, Prince John wants to have the flying machine. Robin Hood and his buddies quickly hide the battered piece and Tuck is given the task of building a new one. Unfortunately it doesn't fly at all. And then two flying machines appear over Sherwood. / Trevor hat eine Flugmaschine gebaut. Doch schon beim ersten Testflug geht etwas schief, und Derke, der als Hamster verzauberte Drache, sitzt allein in der Maschine und - sturzt ab.Trotzdem will Prinz John die Flugmaschine haben. Schnell verstecken Robin Hood und seine Kumpel das ramponierte Teil, und Tuck bekommt den Auftrag, eine neue zu bauen. Die fliegt aber leider gar nicht. Und dann tauchen zwei Flugmaschinen uber Sherwood auf.

programme.title: Peter Pan - New Adventures / Peter Pan - Neue Abenteuer
programme.desc: It's May and it's snowing in London. The siblings are happy that Peter is taking them to beautiful Neverland. But Hook awaits them there with a powder that has a nasty effect. If you get it, it turns you evil. When the pirates want to throw the powder on Peter, Poppy, the flower woman, gets it. She gets angry and makes it terribly hot. Neverland is in danger of withering away. The children are looking for an antidote. / Es ist Mai, und in London schneit es. Die Geschwister freuen sich, dass Peter sie ins schone Nimmerland mitnimmt. Doch dort erwartet sie Hook mit einem Pulver, das eine fiese Wirkung hat.Wenn man es abbekommt, macht es einen bosartig. Als die Piraten das Pulver auf Peter schutten wollen, bekommt es Poppy, die Blumenfrau, ab. Sie wird bose und lasst es furchtbar heiSS werden. Nimmerland droht zu verdorren. Die Kinder suchen ein Gegenmittel.

programme.title: Zoom - The white dolphin / Zoom - Der weiSSe Delfin
programme.desc: A pearl wholesaler comes to Maotou to buy black pearls. However, Auru forgot to collect some. To satisfy his father, he comes up with a plan. He simply takes white pearls and dyes them with Bobby the squid's ink. When he hears from his friends that his father ended up in prison because of this, he quickly tries to get black pearls. His friends Yann and Inapo help. / Ein PerlengroSShandler kommt nach Maotou, um schwarze Perlen einzukaufen. Auru hat jedoch vergessen, welche zu sammeln. Um seinen Vater zufriedenzustellen, fasst er einen Plan.Er nimmt einfach weiSSe Perlen und farbt sie mit der Tinte von Tintenfisch Bobby ein. Als er von seinen Freunden hort, dass sein Vater deshalb im Gefangnis landen konnte, versucht er schnell, schwarze Perlen zu besorgen. Seine Freunde Yann und Inapo helfen dabei.

programme.title: Zoom - The white dolphin / Zoom - Der weiSSe Delfin
programme.desc: Marina has discovered a new game: she lets Seelowin Daisy perform tricks. Everyone is thrilled by the skillful performance, except Anita. She forbids Marina from playing. To comfort Marina, Maimiti posts a video of the sea lion show on the Internet. Anita is horrified and says that she and Daisy escaped from an evil animal trainer and is now afraid that if he sees the video, he might want to get Daisy back. The next day, Daisy's tank is empty. / Marina hat ein neues Spiel entdeckt: Sie lasst Seelowin Daisy Kunststucke vorfuhren. Alle sind begeistert von der gekonnten Darbietung, nur Anita nicht. Sie verbietet Marina das Spiel.Um Marina zu trosten, stellt Maimiti ein Video der Seelowenshow ins Internet. Anita ist entsetzt und erzahlt, dass sie mit Daisy einem bosen Tiertrainer entkommen ist und jetzt Angst hat, er konnte sich, wenn er das Video sieht, Daisy zuruckholen wollen.Am nachsten Tag ist Daisys Becken leer.

programme.title: Bibi and Tina / Bibi und Tina
programme.desc: Bibi, Tina and Alex drive to the Sanders, who are opening a horse farm by the sea. The three friends help with the preparations. As soon as everything is prepared, something unexpected happens. Suddenly the horses disappear and the newly built stable collapses. Bibi, Tina and Alex suspect the Sanders' neighbors. The neighbors are probably smugglers and want to continue to bring their stolen goods to land undisturbed. / Bibi, Tina und Alex fahren zu den Sanders, die einen Reiterhof am Meer eroffnen. Die drei Freunde helfen bei den Vorbereitungen. Kaum ist alles hergerichtet, passiert etwas Unerwartetes.Plotzlich sind die Pferde verschwunden, und der neu gebaute Stall sturzt ein. Bibi, Tina und Alex verdachtigen die Nachbarn der Sanders. Wahrscheinlich sind die Nachbarn Schmuggler und wollen weiterhin ungestort ihre gestohlenen Waren an Land bringen.

programme.title: Linha da Frente
programme.sub-title: Live Longer, Live Better / Viver Mais, Viver Melhor
programme.desc: It's 10 pm and Bairro Alto is transformed into a street market. Bars compete with each other to see who sells the most alcohol, challenging the limits of whoever passes by. Instead of glasses, drinks are served in buckets. Bachelor parties, senior trips. Lisbon is the city where you drink until you drop. / Sao 10 da noite e Bairro Alto está transformado numa feira. programme.title: The Hatred of the Villages / O Ódio das Vilas
programme.desc: After wasting the golden years of his privileged youth in a bohemian life, Antonio Vargas, the heir to one of the most influential families in the town, meets the caretaker's daughter in the fields of his properties. A simple young woman, but who embodies the woman she always dreamed of. / Apos desperdiçar os anos dourados da sua juventude privilegiada numa vida boemia, Antonio Vargas o herdeiro de uma das famílias mais influentes da vila encontra, nas searas das suas propriedades, a filha do caseiro. Uma jovem simples, mas que encarna a mulher com que sempre sonhou.

programme.title: Grande Entrevista
programme.desc: The fascinating world of political communication. Antonio Costa's green tie in the debates. The gestures of Rui Rio. The rhetoric of Andre Ventura. Is it possible to sell politicians like soap? Advertiser Edson Athayde and brand specialist Carlos Coelho, in Grande Interview. / O mundo fascinante da comunicaçao política. O publicitário Edson Athayde e o especialista em marcas Carlos Coelho, na Grande Entrevista.

programme.title: Game of Thrones - The True History of Europe / A Guerra dos Tronos - A Verdadeira Historia da Europa
programme.desc: Henry IV and the new king of France. But being Protestant, few accept seeing him wear the crown. In April 1590, the king and his troops, 21,000 men, arrived at the gates of Paris. programme.title: Gus the Minorca Knight / Gus, o Cavaleiro Minorca
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a little boy, Gus, who wanted to be a great knight. Sorry, not a great knight... The greatest knight in the entire kingdom of Karamel. The problem is that Gus is... minorca! He's three apples tall, but he has a heart the size of a house! / Era uma vez um rapazinho, Gus, que queria ser um grande cavaleiro. Desculpem, nao um grande cavaleiro... O maior cavaleiro de todo o reino de Karamel. O problema e que Gus e... minorca! Ele tem tres maças de altura, mas tem um coraçao do tamanho de uma casa!

programme.title: Petit
programme.desc: Discover Petit's unique and imaginative perspective on everyday situations that become fantastic adventures that he will live together with his friends. Based on the award-winning book "Petit El Monstruo" by Isol. / Descubra a perspetiva única e imaginativa de Petit sobre situações do quotidiano que se tornam aventuras fantásticas que ele irá viver, juntamente com os seus amigos. Baseado no premiado livro "Petit El Monstruo" de Isol.

programme.title: Grizzy E Os Lemingues
programme.desc: In order to finally be on par with Grizzy's imposing build and have some weight in the cabin, the Lemmings decide to wear an inflatable sumotori suit. Grizzy is abruptly thrown out of the room. He then decides to go on a special juice diet to become the strongest. / De modo a finalmente estar ao mesmo nível da constituiçao imponente de Grizzy e ter algum peso na cabana, os Lemingues decidem usar um fato de sumotori insuflável. Grizzy e bruscamente atirado para fora da sala. Decide entao fazer uma dieta especial de sumo para se tornar o mais forte.

programme.title: Radar XS
programme.desc: Radar XS is a news program for children aged 8 to 12 that aims to encourage critical thinking and conscious citizenship. We will bring together politics and culture, economics and sport, science and children's literature, national and international current affairs in a simple and objective language. / Radar XS e um telejornal para crianças dos 8 aos 12 anos onde se pretende incentivar o pensamento crítico e a cidadania consciente. Vamos juntar a política e a cultura, a economia e desporto, a ciencia e a literatura infantil, a atualidade nacional e internacional numa linguagem simples e objetiva.

programme.title: My Scene / A Minha Cena
programme.desc: In the program "A Minha Cena" children are the protagonists. Every week, in each episode, the children take us through their lives and show us their "favorite scenes". / No programa "A Minha Cena" as crianças sao as protagonistas. Todas as semanas, em cada episodio, as crianças conduzem-nos pela sua vida e mostram-nos as suas "cenas favoritas".

programme.title: Agenda Zigzaguear

programme.title: Sempre Atrasados
programme.desc: Every morning, Nuno and Malika leave home 30 minutes early to go to school and they still arrive late every morning! This is because every morning, something incredible happens along the way. But even though their stories are always true, the school principal never believes them... / Todas as manhas, Nuno e Malika saem de casa 30 minutos mais cedo para ir à escola e ainda assim todas as manhas chegam atrasados! Isto porque todas as manhas, algo incrível acontece no caminho. Mas mesmo que as suas historias sejam sempre verdadeiras, a diretora da escola nunca acredita nelas...

programme.title: Escola de Herois
programme.desc: Hero School is a school for budding superheroes, where children learn to master their innate powers to help people, solve problems and try to make the world a better place. / A Escola de Herois e uma escola para super-herois principiantes, onde as crianças aprendem a dominar os seus poderes inatos para ajudar as pessoas, resolver problemas e tentar tornar o mundo num lugar melhor.

programme.title: Lobito's Tales / Os Contos do Lobito
programme.desc: Lobito dreams of being like the heroes of the storybooks he loves to read, traveling from story to story to live their adventures. But as the intrepid little wolf quickly discovers, reaching a happy ending is no easy task and he will have to learn from his mistakes. / Lobito sonha ser como os herois dos livros de historias que mais gosta de ler, viajando de conto em conto para viver as suas aventuras. Mas como o intrepido lobinho depressa descobre, chegar ao final feliz nao e tarefa fácil e terá de aprender com os seus erros.

programme.title: Rev and Roll
programme.desc: Join Rev, an 8-year-old boy, and his best friend, Rumble, a boisterous and powerful truck who thinks he's a dog, and live big, fun adventures with them in their hometown of Fender Bend! / Junta-te Rev, um menino de 8 anos, e ao seu melhor amigo, Rumble, um camiao turbulento e poderoso que pensa que e um cachorro, e vive com eles grandes e divertidas aventuras na sua cidade natal, Fender Bend!

programme.title: A Escola dos Roaridos / A Escola dos Rugidos
programme.desc: Going to school for the first time is one of the biggest challenges we have to face. Roaring School helps children prepare for school life by exploring a child's first year through the relationships and experiences of our mini monsters. / Ir para a escola pela primeira vez e um dos maiores desafios que temos de enfrentar. A Escola dos Rugidos ajuda as crianças a prepararem-se para a vida escolar explorando o primeiro ano da criança atraves dos relacionamentos e experiencias dos nossos mini monstros.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Numberblocks are a really fun group of numbers that work together to solve big and small problems and will teach you to count in a really fun way! / Os Numberblocks sao um grupo de números muito divertido que trabalham juntos para resolver grandes e pequenos problemas e vao ensinar-te a contar de uma forma muito divertida!

programme.title: Kiwi
programme.desc: Let's learn English with Twiki and Twini! Each episode will be an adventure to discover new words and new sounds. / Vamos aprender Ingles com Twiki e Twini! Cada episodio será uma aventura para descobrir novas palavras e novos sons.

programme.title: A Grande Descoberta
programme.desc: Hugo, like all children, has a curious personality, and constantly questions himself on a journey in search of knowledge, logic and understanding the meaning of things. / Hugo, tal como todas as crianças, tem uma personalidade curiosa, e questiona-se constantemente numa jornada em busca de conhecimento, da logica e de compreender o significado das coisas.

programme.title: Ziggy and the Zootram
programme.desc: Ziggy is a friendly freshwater crocodile from Australia. He and his friends live in their eccentric houses located in a crater on an island. Ziggy and his friends have a very special secret - besides walking like people, talking like people - they all work in a zoo! / Ziggy e um simpático crocodilo-de-água-doce da Austrália. Ele e os seus amigos vivem nas suas excentricas casas situadas numa cratera de uma ilha. Ziggy e os seus amigos tem um segredo muito especial - alem de andarem como gente, falarem como gente - todos trabalham num jardim zoologico!

programme.title: Dimitri
programme.desc: Dimitri, a small bird, was lost from his family during migration and now roams the African continent, very different from his home continent, Europe. Deprived of his family and friends, Dimitri learns to overcome his fears to explore the extraordinary world of the savannah. / Dimitri, um pequeno pássaro, perdeu-se da sua família durante a migraçao e agora vagueia pelo continente africano, muito diferente do seu continente natal, a Europa. Privado da sua família e amigos, Dimitri aprende a superar os seus medos para explorar o mundo extraordinário da savana.

programme.title: Mia Go
programme.desc: Mia is a girl whose enthusiasm infects everyone around her. With her fearless sense of adventure, she tries things for the first time with a fearless attitude. Mia lives in the busy city Everyday with her closest friends and together they go on great adventures. / Mia e uma menina cujo entusiasmo contagia todos ao seu redor. Com seu destemido sentido de aventura, ela tenta as coisas pela primeira vez com uma atitude destemida. Mia mora na movimentada cidade Todososdias com os seus amigos mais proximos e juntos vao viver grandes aventuras.

programme.title: The Art of Healing / A Arte da Cura
programme.desc: In the beginning, medicine was magical. The darkness of the night was feared, nature was venerated. Illness was a punishment from the Gods, and only a few had the power to heal. A doença era castigo dos Deuses, e so alguns detinham o poder da cura. Buda, Imhothep, Hipocrates, Galeno, sao as referencias.

programme.desc: Frankfurt, 1987. Alfred Herrhausen is trying to achieve power at Deutsche Bank. His colleagues react with outrage to his revolutionary proposal for debt relief for developing countries. / Frankfurt, 1987. Alfred Herrhausen está a tentar alcançar o poder no Deutsche Bank. Com o apoio de Christian, o seu mentor, quer definir o rumo do futuro como único porta-voz do banco. Os seus colegas reagem com indignaçao à sua proposta revolucionária de alívio da dívida dos países em desenvolvimento.

programme.title: Sevilla vs Barcelona - Spanish LaLiga 2025/26 - Week 8 - Mini Match
programme.desc: Sevilla have not won any of their last 19 LaLiga games against Barcelona, a run that stretches back to October 2015, losing their last seven in a row – their longest consecutive losing streak against the Catalans in the top-flight. Barcelona have avoided defeat in their last nine away LaLiga matches against Sevilla, their longest unbeaten run away to them in the competition.

programme.title: Real Madrid vs Villarreal -Spanish LaLiga 2025/26 - Week 8 - Mini Match
programme.desc: Real Madrid have not lost any of their last four LaLiga games against Villarreal, winning the last two, this after failing to win any of their previous four against the Yellows in the competition. They have not won three or more in a row against them in LaLiga since 2011. Villarreal have lost 17 of their 25 LaLiga away matches against Real Madrid, their highest number of away defeats against a single opponent in the competition.

programme.title: Lille vs PSG - French Ligue 1 2025/2026 Week 7 - Mini Match
programme.desc: Lille have won just one of their last 13 home Ligue 1 games against Paris SG, a 5-1 victory on 14 April 2019, which remains Paris Saint-Germains biggest away defeat in the top-flight in the 21st century. Lille have lost their last two Ligue 1 matches and could suffer three consecutive defeats in the competition for the first time since December 2019-January 2020. Lille could also fail to score in three consecutive Ligue 1 games for the first time since September 2017.

programme.title: Brentford vs Manchester City - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 8 - Mini Match
programme.desc: Since completing a Premier League double over Manchester City in 2022-23, Brentford are winless in their last four against the Citizens in the division. programme.title: Chelsea vs Liverpool -English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 8 - Mini Match
programme.desc: After their 3-1 win in May, Chelsea could enjoy back-to-back league wins over Liverpool for the first time since November 2014. Liverpool are winless in their last four Premier League games at Stamford Bridge and could lose away to Chelsea two seasons running in the league for the first time since losing three on the bounce from 2004-05 to 2006-07.

programme.title: Manchester United vs Sunderland - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 8 - Mini Match
programme.desc: Manchester United have lost just two of their last 30 league games against Sunderland, with this their first since a 3-0 win in April 2017. Across all competitions, Sunderland have managed to win just one of their last 31 away games against Manchester United, winning 1-0 in May 2014 thanks to Sebastian Larsson’s winner.

programme.title: Beauty UFC 320 / MMA UFC 320
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Boks: Oleksandr Gvozdyk - Tommy Karpency
programme.desc: Roki Marcano, Mike Tyson, Sugar Ray Robinson, Muhammad Ali, Joe Luis. Should the more reason more to follow this noble martial skill? First traces of boxes we are already in the third century before Christ on Sumerian drawings. In the modern age, the first rules of boxes were established 18. century in London and define the combination of combat, equipment and illicit and permitted types of blows. Don't miss every opportunity to enjoy this exciting sport. / Roki Marčano, Majk Tajson, Šugar Rej Robinson, Muhamed Ali, Džo Luis. Treba li još koji razlog više da bi pratili ovu plemenitu borilačku veštinu? Prve tragove boksa nalazimo već u trećem veku pre Hrista na sumeranskim crtežima. U modernom dobu prva pravila boksa ustanovljena su 18. veku u Londonu i definišu prostor borbe, opremu te nedozvoljene i dozvoljene vrste udaraca. Ne propustite svaku priliku da uživate u ovom uzbudljivom sportu.

programme.title: Martial Sport - MMA: Niggemann Vs Sow / Borilački sport - MMA: Niggemann vs Sow
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: MMA UFC Fight Night
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path set after the hand of Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team of Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspešnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Košarka - Euroleague: Hapeel Tel Aviv - Maccabi Tel Aviv / Košarka - Euroleague: Hapeol Tel Aviv - Maccabi Tel Aviv
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The FIBA ​​led the main word in this competition until 2000. when clubs took control of the competition through its Euregation Basketball Association. The format of the competition changed through history and contained a part of the groups after which elimations in the playoffs followed. The winner of this competition decides on the final tournament called Final Four. The most successful clubs of this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathianos, Varese, Olympiacos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.title: Basketball - Aba Liga: Crvena Zvezda - Zadar / Košarka - ABA liga: Crvena zvezda - Zadar
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League: Seville - Barcelona / Fudbal - Španska liga: Sevilla - Barcelona
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path set after the hand of Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team of Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspešnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Real Madrid - Asvel / Košarka - Euroleague: Real Madrid - Asvel
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The format of the competition changed through history and contained a part of the groups after which elimations in the playoffs followed. The winner of this competition decides on the final tournament called Final Four. The most successful clubs of this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathianos, Varese, Olympiacos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. programme.title: Footbal - League Europe: Fenerbahce - Nice / Fudbal - Liga Evrope: Fenerbahce - Nice
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of UEFE since 1971. years. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was a cup of fair cities that played since 1955. until 1971. years. From that season, the competition is officially called the UEFA Cup and is under that name until 2009. when it was renamed to the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the competition format itself changed several times, and from the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which the elimination follow. The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972. for the UEFA Cup final by the Italian artist Bertoni and each year is awarded to the winner who keeps him a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko fudbalsko takmičenje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Evropske fudbalske federacije UEFE od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog takmičenja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone takmičenje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Evrope. Tokom godina se sam format takmičenja nekoliko puta menjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobednika ovog takmičenja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane italijanskog umetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodeljuje pobedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League: Galatasaray - Tofas / Košarka - Turska liga: Galatasaray - Tofas
programme.desc: The beginnings of the Turkish basketball dwell back before the League founding in 1966. years. Ear even early 20. The centuries of hoops under the hoops were known in Turkey. Students with Rober College in Istanbul in 1904. They first discovered the charms of this team sport. The first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs started the year after the founding of the league. The second league was launched three years later. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams playing each with every twice in the regular part after which the plejof is the eight best teams. The two weakest placed teams fall out of the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko pre osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plejof osam najboljih ekipa. programme.title: Košarka - Euroleague: MacCabi Tel Aviv - Paris / Košarka - Euroleague: Maccabi Tel Aviv - Paris
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The FIBA ​​led the main word in this competition until 2000. when clubs took control of the competition through its Euregation Basketball Association. The format of the competition changed through history and contained a part of the groups after which elimations in the playoffs followed. The winner of this competition decides on the final tournament called Final Four. The most successful clubs of this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathianos, Varese, Olympiacos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.title: Basketball - Aba Liga: Crvena Zvezda - Zadar / Košarka - ABA liga: Crvena zvezda - Zadar
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Football: Wwin League BiH: Rudar - Borac / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Rudar - Borac
programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. The entrance of the cubes from the Republika Srpska two years later received a format with 16 clubs in the two-circular competition system. Today, 12 teams competed in the league, which has been divided into league after the 22-year-in-law and the league for survival. The first historical champion of BiH was a leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most conquered championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The largest European success is the placement of the railway worker in the UEFA Cup semifinals in 1984. Years. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Majke šampioni
programme.desc: In the six semi-municipal episodes, the interlocutors were mothers of large, trophy athletes who, everyone in their own way, marked the history of sports of these areas. Through what difficulties and waivers are the parents face when it is necessary to see the talent of your children? What's the moment, when you see in which direction they move their lives? How long does it take to make dreams come true, and how much to never come to these achievements? Unfortunately, during the series for TV Arena, the sport will also talk to the mother who was awarded the largest world tragedy, the loss of the child. About the deaths of their sons, the strengths were forces to talk mothers Dražen Petrović and Haris Brkić. Lifebers, laughter and tears, strong emotions would describe the six episodes of the series in which their lives and parenting represented Mothers of Novak Djokovic, Jelena Brooks, Luka Jovića, as well as mothers of the tragicly killed Drazen Petrovic and Haris Brkić. / U šest polusatnih epizoda sagovornice su bile majke velikih, trofejnih sportista koji su, svako na svoj način, obeležili istoriju sporta ovih prostora. Kroz kakve teškoće i odricanja se suočavaju roditelji kada je neophodno ispratiti talenat svoje dece? Koji je to trenutak, kada vidite u kom pravcu kreću njihovi životi? Koliko je potrebno da se snovi ostvare, a koliko da do tih ostvarenja nikada ni ne dođe? Nažalost, tokom serijala za TV Arena sport govoriće i majke koje je zadesila najveća ovozemaljska tragedija, gubitak deteta. O pogibijama svojih sinova smogle su snage da pričaju majke Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića. Životni ringišpil, smeh i suze, snažne emocije… tako bi u najkraćem opisali šest epizoda serijala u kojima su svoje živote i roditeljstvo predstavile majke Novaka Đokovića, Ivane Španović, Jelene Bruks, Luke Jovića kao i majke tragično nastradalih Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića.

programme.title: Majke šampioni
programme.desc: In the six semi-municipal episodes, the interlocutors were mothers of large, trophy athletes who, everyone in their own way, marked the history of sports of these areas. Through what difficulties and waivers are the parents face when it is necessary to see the talent of your children? What's the moment, when you see in which direction they move their lives? How long does it take to make dreams come true, and how much to never come to these achievements? Unfortunately, during the series for TV Arena, the sport will also talk to the mother who was awarded the largest world tragedy, the loss of the child. About the deaths of their sons, the strengths were forces to talk mothers Dražen Petrović and Haris Brkić. Lifebers, laughter and tears, strong emotions would describe the six episodes of the series in which their lives and parenting represented Mothers of Novak Djokovic, Jelena Brooks, Luka Jovića, as well as mothers of the tragicly killed Drazen Petrovic and Haris Brkić. / U šest polusatnih epizoda sagovornice su bile majke velikih, trofejnih sportista koji su, svako na svoj način, obeležili istoriju sporta ovih prostora. Kroz kakve teškoće i odricanja se suočavaju roditelji kada je neophodno ispratiti talenat svoje dece? Koji je to trenutak, kada vidite u kom pravcu kreću njihovi životi? Koliko je potrebno da se snovi ostvare, a koliko da do tih ostvarenja nikada ni ne dođe? Nažalost, tokom serijala za TV Arena sport govoriće i majke koje je zadesila najveća ovozemaljska tragedija, gubitak deteta. O pogibijama svojih sinova smogle su snage da pričaju majke Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića. Životni ringišpil, smeh i suze, snažne emocije… tako bi u najkraćem opisali šest epizoda serijala u kojima su svoje živote i roditeljstvo predstavile majke Novaka Đokovića, Ivane Španović, Jelene Bruks, Luke Jovića kao i majke tragično nastradalih Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića.

programme.title: Football: Wwin League BiH: Sarajevo - Zrinjski / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Sarajevo - Zrinjski
programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. Today, 12 teams competed in the league, which has been divided into league after the 22-year-in-law and the league for survival. The first historical champion of BiH was a leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most conquered championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The largest European success is the placement of the railway worker in the UEFA Cup semifinals in 1984. programme.title: Basketball - Aba Liga: Crvena Zvezda - Zadar / Košarka - ABA liga: Crvena zvezda - Zadar
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.desc: With all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga proudly stands. In the highest rank of a football competition founded in 1963, 18 teams compete, which start matches for a popular plate every year in August. It was most often won by Bayern Munich, as many as 24 times. The cheerleading culture, full of tribes and top football is what Bundesliga adorns from its beginnings to the present day. Don't miss the opportunity to enjoy the Bundesliga matches. You will definitely not be sorry. / Ob vsem, kar nam je Nemčija skozi zgodovino dala, ponosno stoji tudi Bundesliga. V najvišjem rangu nogometnega tekmovanja, ustanovljenega leta 1963, se pomeri 18 ekip, ki vsako leto v avgustu pričnejo tekme za priljubljeni krožnik. Največkrat ga je osvojil Bayern Munchen, in sicer kar 24-krat. Kultura navijanja, polnih tribin in vrhunskega nogometa je tisto, kar Bundesligo krasi od njenih začetkov do današnjih dni. programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Domzale, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Domzale, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Domzale, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Domzale, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.desc: The League under different names has existed since its founding in 1923, with a break during World War II. V ligi nastopa 14 ekip, slovenske barve pa zastopa HK Olimpija Ljubljana.

programme.title: Nogomet (M): Borussia M. - Freiburg, Bundesliga 2025/2026
programme.desc: With all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga proudly stands. In the highest rank of a football competition founded in 1963, 18 teams compete, which start matches for a popular plate every year in August. It was most often won by Bayern Munich, as many as 24 times. The cheerleading culture, full of tribes and top football is what Bundesliga adorns from its beginnings to the present day. Don't miss the opportunity to enjoy the Bundesliga matches. You will definitely not be sorry. / Ob vsem, kar nam je Nemčija skozi zgodovino dala, ponosno stoji tudi Bundesliga. V najvišjem rangu nogometnega tekmovanja, ustanovljenega leta 1963, se pomeri 18 ekip, ki vsako leto v avgustu pričnejo tekme za priljubljeni krožnik. Največkrat ga je osvojil Bayern Munchen, in sicer kar 24-krat. Kultura navijanja, polnih tribin in vrhunskega nogometa je tisto, kar Bundesligo krasi od njenih začetkov do današnjih dni. Ne zamudite priložnosti, da uživate v tekmah Bundeslige. Zagotovo vam ne bo žal.
