programme.title: Nogomet (m): E Frankfurt - B. Munchen, Bundesliga 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): E Frankfurt - B. Munchen, Bundesliga 2025/2026
programme.desc: With all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga proudly stands. In the highest rank of a football competition founded in 1963, 18 teams compete, which start matches for a popular plate every year in August. It was most often won by Bayern Munich, as many as 24 times. The cheerleading culture, full of tribes and top football is what Bundesliga adorns from its beginnings to the present day. Don't miss the opportunity to enjoy the Bundesliga matches. You will definitely not be sorry. / Ob vsem, kar nam je Nemčija skozi zgodovino dala, ponosno stoji tudi Bundesliga. V najvišjem rangu nogometnega tekmovanja, ustanovljenega leta 1963, se pomeri 18 ekip, ki vsako leto v avgustu pričnejo tekme za priljubljeni krožnik. Največkrat ga je osvojil Bayern Munchen, in sicer kar 24-krat. Kultura navijanja, polnih tribin in vrhunskega nogometa je tisto, kar Bundesligo krasi od njenih začetkov do današnjih dni. Ne zamudite priložnosti, da uživate v tekmah Bundeslige. Zagotovo vam ne bo žal.

programme.title: Košarka (M): Neptunas - Cluj, Eurocup 2025, Group a / Košarka (M): Neptunas - Cluj, Eurocup 2025, Skupina A
programme.desc: The Euro was created in 2002 as the second "Euroleague Basketball" competition. This competition is fighting the strongest basketball clubs that have failed to qualify for the Euroleague, mostly involved in the Top 15 most powerful European leagues. Clubs are provided by national championships and trophies and through invitations, i.e. "Wildcards". / Evrokup je nastal leta 2002 kot drugo tekmovanje "Evrolige Basketball". V tem tekmovanju se borijo najmočnejši košarkarski klubi, ki se niso uspeli uvrstiti v Evroligo, v njem pa večinoma sodelujejo klubi iz top 15 najmočnejših evropskih lig. Uvrstitev v Evrokup si klubi zagotovijo preko nacionalnih prvenstev in pokalov ter preko povabil, t.i. "wildcards".

programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Domzale, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Domzale, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Karel X.: Burboni in Gorizia, documentary of the month, Mon. / Karel X.: Burboni na Goriškem, dokumentarec meseca, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Moravec Dušan ... Who was the only king buried in Slovenian territory? / R: Moravec Dušan... Kdo je bil edini kralj, ki je pokopan na slovenskem ozemlju?
programme.desc: The documentary introduces us to the fate of the last representatives of the French royal family, who have become refugees due to revolutions. Ironically, the term refugee, "refuge", was first recorded when Louis XIV, the Sun King, expelled a large number of Hugenots from his homeland. His grandson Karel X. was also sentenced to exile after the July Revolution - he sought refuge from Scotland, Prague to Gorizia, hoping to be safe here from cholera. After a hundred members of his entourage, they were housed in various palaces around the city. Due to the mild climate, this later became known as the Austrian Nice. In 1836, they were awaited in Gorizia the warm autumn, and formerly a vital 79-year-old became the only death toll in the city for a good two weeks. Thus, the Franciscans in Kostanjevica, whose church had previously provided a space for the tombs of aristocratic families, became the guardians of the remains of the refugee king through the contract. In the following decades, other members of the dynasty wanted to be buried. Among them was Maria Theresa Šarlot, daughter of Louis XVI. and Mary Antoaneta. Her life story was very tragic. Her parents ended under the guillotine, her brother died in crude foster care, and after years of captivity, she became the wife of her cousin, son Karl X. Together, they took care of his niece and nephew, born after his brother's death, who became a symbol of hope for French legitimists. Henrik V. later wasted the last chance that Bourbon would take over the throne again, and the descendant of his sister became the Austrian Empress. During the visit of the Isonzo Front, the Zita ordered to transfer sarcophage from the Nabrežinsko stone to Vienna Safe. After the renovation of the demolished church, they were returned to the monastery. After the end of the war and the breakup of Austria-Hungary, the area again passed under the Kingdom of Italy. Shortly after World War II, allies set new borders. It was the French that decided that the monastery remained separated from Stara Gorica. Behind him, however, a new one has grown ... The past and current conditions at Kostanjevica are presented by Pater Niko Žvokelj and the administrator of the Škrabč Library Mirjam Brecelj. The historians of Gorizia also speak about the circumstances, changes through time and today's attitude towards heritage: dr. Renato Podbersic, Ph.D. Urška Strle and curator Cristina Bragaglia. The initiative to return the remains to France is commented on by journalist Ervin Milharčič Hladnik. The documentary also lacks the shots of the flowering of roses, the interiors of the Gorizia palaces, and the restored murals and stucco. We will be convinced that the royal family found a safe harbor at the intersection of different cultures after difficult life trials, where it can finally rest in peace. / Dokumentarni film nam predstavi usodo zadnjih predstavnikov francoske kraljeve rodbine, ki so zaradi revolucij postali begunci. Ironično je bil izraz begunec, »refuge«, prvič zabeležen, ko je Ludvik XIV., Sončni kralj, iz domovine izgnal veliko število hugenotov. Njegov vnuk Karel X. je bil po julijski revoluciji tudi obsojen na izgnanstvo – zatočišče je iskal od Škotske, Prage do Gorice v upanju, da bo tu varen pred kolero. Čez sto članov njegovega spremstva se je nastanilo v različnih palačah po mestu. To je zaradi milega podnebja pozneje postalo znano kot avstrijska Nica. Leta 1836 jih je v Gorici pričakala topla jesen, prej vitalen 79-letnik pa je že v dobrih dveh tednih postal edina smrtna žrtev kolere v mestu. Tako so frančiškani na Kostanjevici, katerih cerkev je že prej nudila prostor grobnicam plemiških družin, s pogodbo postali varuhi posmrtnih ostankov begunskega kralja.V naslednjih desetletjih so ob glavi družine želeli biti pokopani tudi drugi člani dinastije. Med njimi je bila tudi Marija Terezija Šarlota, hči Ludvika XVI. in Marije Antoanete. Njena življenjska zgodba je bila zelo tragična. Njeni starši so končali pod giljotino, njen brat je umrl v surovem rejništvu, sama pa je po letih ujetništva postala žena svojega bratranca, sina Karla X. Skupaj sta skrbela za nečakinjo in nečaka, rojenega po bratovi smrti, ki je postal simbol upanja za francoske legitimiste. Henrik V. je kasneje zapravil zadnjo možnost, da bi Burboni ponovno prevzeli prestol, potomka njegove sestre pa je postala avstrijska cesarica. Ravno Zita je med obiskom Soške fronte ukazala prenesti sarkofage iz nabrežinskega kamna na varno na Dunaj. Po prenovi porušene cerkve so bili vrnjeni v samostan. Po koncu vojne in razpadu Avstro-Ogrske je območje spet prešlo pod Kraljevino Italijo. Kmalu po drugi svetovni vojni so zavezniki določali nove meje. Prav Francozi so odločili, da je ostal samostan ločen od stare Gorice. Za njim pa je kmalu zrastla Nova ...Pretekle ter zdajšnje razmere na Kostanjevici nam predstavita pater Niko Žvokelj ter skrbnica Škrabčeve knjižnice Mirjam Brecelj. O takratnih okoliščinah, spremembah skozi čas ter današnjem odnosu do dediščine spregovorijo tudi goriški zgodovinarji: dr. Renato Podbersič, dr. Urška Strle ter kustosinja Cristina Bragaglia. Pobudo za vrnitev posmrtnih ostankov v Francijo pokomentira novinar Ervin Milharčič Hladnik. V dokumentarnem filmu ne manjkajo niti posnetki cvetenja vrtnic, interierjev goriških palač ter restavriranih fresk in štukatur. Prepričali se bomo, da je kraljeva družina po težkih življenjskih preizkušnjah našla varen pristan prav na stičišču različnih kultur, kjer lahko končno počiva v miru.

programme.title: S-Prehodi: Katja Pegan, Director of the Koper Theater, Mon. / S-prehodi: Katja Pegan, direktorica gledališča Koper, pon.
programme.desc: The Jubilee 25th season is signed by the Koper Theater this year, known for its numerous collaborations with cross -border theaters and their creators. Although he is considered the second youngest Slovenian professional theater, founded in 2001, theater life in this city has a long tradition. Historical sources from the 15th century state that the theater was already in Koper during the Venetian Republic, first in the old town, near Carpacciev, then in Grison's house on the then Belveder. A century later, a new theater building was built, and today it stands today. At the studio we host the director of the Katja Pegan Theater. / Jubilejno 25. sezono letos podpisuje Gledališče Koper, znano po svojih številnih sodelovanjih z zamejskimi gledališči in njihovimi ustvarjalci. Čeprav velja za drugo najmlajše slovensko poklicno gledališče, ustanovljeno je bilo leta 2001, ima gledališko življenje v tem mestu že dolgo tradicijo. Zgodovinski viri iz 15. stoletja navajajo, da je bilo v Kopru gledališče že v času Beneške republike, najprej v starem mestnem jedru, ob Carpaccievi hiši, nato v Grisonovi hiši na takratnem Belvederju. Stoletje pozneje so zgradili novo gledališko stavbo in na tem mestu stoji še danes. V studiu gostimo direktorico gledališča Katjo Pegan.

programme.title: Osmi and, pound. / Osmi dan, pon.
programme.desc: R: Alexander vocach ... Introducing interesting stories of a company that has in different ways marked several generations of residents of the province near Mura. In Murska Sobota, an exhibition dedicated to the 100th anniversary of the former Mura textile factory was organized. The rich archive has been revealing from the beginning through nationalization and the flourishing period to the last years and empty Mura's buildings. Particularly valuable are the personal stories of sewing - Mura's women who were the heart of the factory. At the Slovenian Cinematheque we took a look at the retrospective of Františka Čapa: the Czech period, the selection of the initial works of this director and the screenwriter that were created in his homeland. He later worked in Germany and Yugoslavia, and in 1953 he introduced himself with an unforgettable comedy Vesna. The films of Japanese director Momoko Seto are considered to be associated with science, fiction and experimentation. In them, the author points to environmental issues in an innovative way, and the main protagonists are nature and natural processes that are often invisible to the free eye. We met with the director at the recent festival of the FEKK short film. During the summer European tour, we talked to Bill Evans, a jazz musician who is very restrained until any definition in music. -The music is good and bad,- a true saxophonist who has been able to start a successful career with Miles Davis, in which he recorded as many as twenty-six solo albums. / R: Vokač Aleksandra... Predstavljamo zanimive zgodbe podjetja, ki je na različne načine zaznamovalo več generacij prebivalcev pokrajine ob Muri. V Murski Soboti so namreč pripravili razstavo, posvečeno 100. obletnici nekdanje tekstilne tovarne Mura. Bogat arhiv razkriva vse od začetkov prek nacionalizacije in obdobja razcveta pa do zadnjih let in praznih Murinih stavb. Še posebej dragocene so osebne zgodbe šivilj – Murinih žensk, ki so bile srce tovarne. V Slovenski kinoteki smo si ogledali retrospektivo Františka Čapa: češko obdobje, izbor začetnih del tega režiserja in scenarista, ki so nastala v njegovi domovini. Kasneje je deloval tudi v Nemčiji in Jugoslaviji, slovenskim gledalcem pa se je leta 1953 predstavil z nepozabno komedijo Vesna. Za filme japonske režiserke Momoko Seto velja, da povezujejo znanost, fantastiko in eksperimentalnost. Avtorica v njih na inovativen način opozarja na okoljsko problematiko, glavni protagonisti pa so narava in naravni procesi, ki so prostemu očesu pogosto nevidni. Z režiserko smo se srečali na nedavnem festivalu kratkega filma FeKK. Med poletno evropsko turnejo smo se pogovarjali z Billom Evansom, jazzovskim glasbenikom, ki je zelo zadržan do kakršnegakoli opredeljevanja v glasbi. -Glasba je glasba, je dobra in slaba,- pravi saksofonist, ki mu je sodelovanje z Milesom Davisom omogočilo začetek uspešno kariere, v kateri je posnel kar šestindvajset samostojnih albumov.

With him, rock music also became an intimate and spiritual experience, and not just a carefree dance party. He was quoted every step of the way. / Ob omembi ameriških sanj verjetno marsikdo takoj pomisli na brezskrbno pohajkovanje pod žgočim kalifornijskim soncem. Skupina The Beach Boys je namreč opevala vse, kar si na idiličnih razglednicah iz te ameriške zvezne države predstavljamo: sonce, morje, visoke valove in na njih izklesane deskarje, pomanjkljivo oblečena dekleta, divje dirkanje s kabrioleti … In potem? Spomladi leta 1966 je skupina The Beach Boys izdala album Pet Sounds in spremenila smer popularne glasbe. Točneje: spomladi leta 1966 je Brian Wilson pod znamko The Beach Boys izdal Pet Sounds in namignil na spremembe v popularni glasbi. Z njim je rockovska glasba postala tudi intimno in duhovno doživetje, in ne več samo brezskrbna plesna zabava. Na vsakem koraku so ga citirali celo Beatli.

Na Kambreškem, ki meji s sosednjo Benečijo pa je o navadah svojih prednikov ob lesenem ognjišču v spomeniško zaščiteni Lukčevi hiši, spregovorila Jožica Strgar. V oddaji pa tudi zgodba o nenavadnih ritualih, ki so jih njega dni izvajali v jami Triglavca, kamor je ekipo odpeljal Boris Čok, raziskovalec stare vere.

programme.title: As if it were yesterday / Com si fos ahir
programme.desc: A group of Dantics Companys Outittites, after twenty-five years, meet at the funeral dun dells. The Institute's time made them a heterogeneous, gamber and full of life group, but life was distributed very diverse to TV3 on the table, after the end of the creek, which was broadcast for eight seasons. As if it were yesterday it runs in Barcelona and the protagonists live throughout the geography of the city. The series, starring Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Labyrinth of Shadows), Montse Germán (Infidels) and Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), wants to present everyday life that can sometimes be raw, sometimes pathetic, but which can also be tender, light and even fun. / Una colla dantics companys dinstitut es retroben, despres de vint-i-cinc anys, al funeral dun dells. Lèpoca de linstitut els va convertir en un grup heterogeni, gamberro i ple de vida, però la vida els va anar repartint fitxes molt diverses.Nova aposta de TV3 per la sobretaula, despres del final de La Riera, que es va emetre durant vuit temporades. Com si fos ahir transcorre a Barcelona i els protagonistes viuen repartits per tota la geografia de la ciutat. La sèrie, protagonitzada per Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Laberint d’ombres), Montse Germán (Infidels) i Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), vol presentar una quotidianitat que de vegades pot ser crua, de vegades patètica, però que tambe pot ser tendra, lleugera i, fins i tot, divertida.

programme.title: As if it were yesterday / Com si fos ahir
programme.desc: A group of Dantics Companys Outittites, after twenty-five years, meet at the funeral dun dells. The Institute's time made them a heterogeneous, gamber and full of life group, but life was distributed very diverse to TV3 on the table, after the end of the creek, which was broadcast for eight seasons. As if it were yesterday it runs in Barcelona and the protagonists live throughout the geography of the city. The series, starring Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Labyrinth of Shadows), Montse Germán (Infidels) and Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), wants to present everyday life that can sometimes be raw, sometimes pathetic, but which can also be tender, light and even fun. / Una colla dantics companys dinstitut es retroben, despres de vint-i-cinc anys, al funeral dun dells. Lèpoca de linstitut els va convertir en un grup heterogeni, gamberro i ple de vida, però la vida els va anar repartint fitxes molt diverses.Nova aposta de TV3 per la sobretaula, despres del final de La Riera, que es va emetre durant vuit temporades. Com si fos ahir transcorre a Barcelona i els protagonistes viuen repartits per tota la geografia de la ciutat. La sèrie, protagonitzada per Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Laberint d’ombres), Montse Germán (Infidels) i Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), vol presentar una quotidianitat que de vegades pot ser crua, de vegades patètica, però que tambe pot ser tendra, lleugera i, fins i tot, divertida.

programme.title: Ladies' paradise / El paraíso de las señoras
programme.desc: Treaty by her boyfriend, Teresa Sen goes from village and flees to the big city. programme.title: The lady in yellow / La signora in giallo
programme.desc: Murder, She Wrote (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American crime drama series starring Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. It aired weekly on CBS from 1984 to 1996 and continued, with several TV movies, until 2003 (such as Sleeper Murder, The Rime of the Lost Boy and Appointment with Death). Angela Lansbury served as the show's executive producer in its final seasons. Jessica Fletcher is a perspicacious mystery writer, who often finds herself dealing with mysterious murders, for which she always manages to discover the culprit. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small town, the fictional Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of Murder, She Wrote is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the producer's first choice. The part was initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however turned it down. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. È andato in onda settimanalmente sulla CBS dal 1984 al 1996 e continuò, con diversi TV-movie, fino al 2003 (come Vagone letto con omicidio, La ballata del ragazzo perduto e Appuntamento con la morte). Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni. Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. La parte era stato offerta inizialmente a Jean Stapleton e Doris Day, che però rifiutarono.

programme.title: The lady in yellow / La signora in giallo
programme.desc: Murder, She Wrote (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American crime drama series starring Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. It aired weekly on CBS from 1984 to 1996 and continued, with several TV movies, until 2003 (such as Sleeper Murder, The Rime of the Lost Boy and Appointment with Death). Angela Lansbury served as the show's executive producer in its final seasons. Jessica Fletcher is a perspicacious mystery writer, who often finds herself dealing with mysterious murders, for which she always manages to discover the culprit. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small town, the fictional Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of Murder, She Wrote is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the producer's first choice. The part was initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however turned it down. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. È andato in onda settimanalmente sulla CBS dal 1984 al 1996 e continuò, con diversi TV-movie, fino al 2003 (come Vagone letto con omicidio, La ballata del ragazzo perduto e Appuntamento con la morte). Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni. Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. La parte era stato offerta inizialmente a Jean Stapleton e Doris Day, che però rifiutarono.

programme.title: The man of the house / Luomo di casa

In his daily life he finds himself dealing with a family made up almost exclusively of women: his wife Vanessa and his three daughters Mandy, Eve and Kristin. / Mike Baxter, direttore marketing di un noto marchio di negozi sportivi, è un uomo allantica e di sani principi. Nella vita quotidiana si trova alle prese con una famiglia composta quasi esclusivamente da donne: la moglie Vanessa e le tre figlie Mandy, Eve e Kristin.

programme.title: Cliche
programme.desc: Justice acts as a guiding star for orientation, but when it comes to giving a definition we immediately get lost. In today's imagination it is a word invoked, abused, always linked to its opposite, injustice, and we can see that immediately. The episode of Cliche dedicated to the word "Justice" and the areas that it shapes in our imagination begins from this provocation. Because "justice is a fluid word that hides deceptions", according to the psychiatrist and psychotherapist Graziano Martignoni, who speaking in the episode among Lorenzo Buccella's guests, recalls how it is a purely human construction that finds confirmation and conflict in the law, which in turn is a human construction that is very distant, for example, from the spontaneous feelings of a child. It is also far from the feelings of the individual, especially when it comes to a gender comparison, between man and woman. This is supported by the journalist and writer Irene Soave, who ranges in her research from the working situation, with the book "The Statute of Workers", to changes in customs, with the book "Etiquette for Marriage Girls", to discover that, in all areas, many feminine clichés are confirmed which unfortunately give shape to a very real gender gap. Gino Cecchettin then speaks, sadly known in the news for the femicide of his daughter Giulia, who believes "a compromise with justice is necessary to avoid suffering all your life", and the Oscar-winning actress Emma Thompson, who underlines the thin line that leads from the sense of personal justice to militant activism, which she is often involved with. The journey into clichés and the sense of justice ends with the intervention of Antonio Di Pietro, politician and former magistrate famous for the Mani Pulite investigation, who often found himself confronted with the limits and contradictions of human justice with respect to the law. Also in the episode is the writer Tommaso Soldini, who rereads the classic of American literature "To Kill a Mockingbird" by Harper Lee, the artist Sir Taki with his work of video-collage created with material from the historical RSI archives, and musical performances by DJ Yeelen. / La giustizia fa da stella polare per orientarsi, ma quando si tratta di darne una definizione ci si perde subito. Nell’immaginario di oggi è una parola invocata, abusata, sempre legata al suo opposto, l’ingiustizia, e quella invece la si vede subito. Da questa provocazione prende il via la puntata di Cliche dedicata alla parola “Giustizia” e agli ambiti che questa disegna nel nostro immaginario. Perche “giustizia è una parola fluida che nasconde inganni”, secondo lo psichiatra e psicoterapeuta Graziano Martignoni, che intervenendo in puntata tra gli ospiti di Lorenzo Buccella, ricorda come sia una costruzione puramente umana che trova riscontro e scontro nella legge, a sua volta costruzione umana lontanissima, ad esempio, dal sentire spontaneo di un bambino. E lontana anche dal sentire del singolo, soprattutto quando si tratta di un confronto di genere, tra uomo e donna. Lo sostiene la giornalista e scrittrice Irene Soave, che spazia nelle sue ricerche dalla situazione lavorativa, con il libro “Lo statuto delle lavoratrici”, ai cambiamenti del costume, con il libro “Galateo per ragazze da marito”, per scoprire che, in tutti gli ambiti, si confermano molti luoghi comuni al femminile che purtroppo danno forma a un realissimo gap di genere.Intervengono poi Gino Cecchettin, tristemente noto alla cronaca per il femminicidio della figlia Giulia, che ritiene necessario “un compromesso con la giustizia per non soffrire tutta la vita”, e l’attrice premio Oscar Emma Thompson, che rimarca il confine sottile che porta dal senso di giustizia personale all’attivismo militante, di cui lei spesso di è occupata. Chiude il viaggio nei luoghi comuni e nel senso di giustizia l’intervento di Antonio Di Pietro, politico ed ex magistrato famoso per l’inchiesta Mani Pulite, che spesso si è trovato a confrontarsi con i limiti e le contraddizioni della giustizia umana rispetto alla legge.Nella puntata anche lo scrittore Tommaso Soldini, che rilegge il classico della letteratura americana “Il Buio oltre la siepe” di Harper Lee, l’artista Sir Taki con la sua opera di video-collage realizzata con materiale degli archivi storici RSI, e gli interventi musicali a cura della DJ Yeelen.

programme.title: The lady in yellow / La signora in giallo
programme.desc: Murder, She Wrote (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American crime drama series starring Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. It aired weekly on CBS from 1984 to 1996 and continued, with several TV movies, until 2003 (such as Sleeper Murder, The Rime of the Lost Boy and Appointment with Death). Angela Lansbury served as the show's executive producer in its final seasons. Jessica Fletcher is a perspicacious mystery writer, who often finds herself dealing with mysterious murders, for which she always manages to discover the culprit. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small town, the fictional Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of Murder, She Wrote is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the producer's first choice. The part was initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however turned it down. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. È andato in onda settimanalmente sulla CBS dal 1984 al 1996 e continuò, con diversi TV-movie, fino al 2003 (come Vagone letto con omicidio, La ballata del ragazzo perduto e Appuntamento con la morte). Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni. Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. La parte era stato offerta inizialmente a Jean Stapleton e Doris Day, che però rifiutarono.

programme.title: The man of the house / Luomo di casa
programme.desc: Mike Baxter, marketing director of a well-known sports store brand, is an old-fashioned and principled man. In his daily life he finds himself dealing with a family made up almost exclusively of women: his wife Vanessa and his three daughters Mandy, Eve and Kristin. / Mike Baxter, direttore marketing di un noto marchio di negozi sportivi, è un uomo allantica e di sani principi. Nella vita quotidiana si trova alle prese con una famiglia composta quasi esclusivamente da donne: la moglie Vanessa e le tre figlie Mandy, Eve e Kristin.

programme.title: I'm coming back to you / Ritorno da te
programme.desc: Abby, a Los Angeles lawyer entirely dedicated to work, agrees to participate in a nature retreat with her best friend Rachel. The intention to indulge in relaxation and forget the daily stress, however, clashes with the meeting of Sean, an old friend of Abby, with whom the woman has no longer had contact since the end of high school. An excursion at sunset will be an opportunity to dispel old resentments and make peace but also to develop a new awareness of oneself and others. / Abby, avvocata di Los Angeles interamente dedita al lavoro, acconsente a partecipare a un ritiro nella natura con la sua migliore amica Rachel. Lintenzione di abbandonarsi al relax e dimenticare lo stress quotidiano però si scontra con lincontro di Sean, un vecchio amico di Abby, con cui la donna non ha più contatti dalla fine delle superiori. Unescursione al tramonto sarà loccasione per dissipare i vecchi rancori e fare pace ma anche per maturare una nuova consapevolezza di se e dellaltro.

programme.title: Bonfire / Falò
programme.sub-title: The agriculture of the future - Raid on the Atlantic / L’agricoltura del futuro - Razzia sull’Atlantico
programme.desc: Thousands of civilians killed while waiting for a food parcel. In the Gaza Strip people are not dying only from Israeli bombs. For months now, an increasing number of Palestinians have been targeted as they desperately try to grab food for their families. The very few food distribution points have turned into gigantic militarized traps. Exactly two years after the start of the war in response to the Hamas massacre of 7 October 2023, Falò returns to Israel again this time to document the traps of the food aid system, amidst the complaints of international organizations and Israel which denies it. According to the Swiss Philippe Lazzarini, general commissioner of UNRWA, the UN agency for aiding Palestinian refugees: "Gaza is becoming the cemetery of international humanitarian law." / Migliaia di civili uccisi in attesa di un pacco alimentare. Nella Striscia di Gaza non si muore solo per le bombe israeliane. Da mesi ormai un numero crescente di palestinesi viene colpito mentre cerca disperatamente di accaparrarsi del cibo per la propria famiglia. I pochissimi punti di distribuzione alimentare si sono trasformati in gigantesche trappole militarizzate. A due anni esatti dallinizio della guerra in risposta al massacro di Hamas del 7 ottobre 2023, Falò torna di nuovo in Israele questa volta per documentare le trappole del sistema degli aiuti alimentari, tra le denunce delle organizzazioni internazionali e Israele che nega. Secondo lo svizzero Philippe Lazzarini, commissario generale dellUNRWA, lAgenzia ONU per il soccorso ai profughi palestinesi: "Gaza sta diventando il cimitero del diritto umanitario internazionale."

programme.title: The upstairs neighbors / I vicini del piano di sopra
programme.desc: Thomas and Anna have been going through a profound marital crisis for some time. The new neighbors upstairs, on the contrary, seem to experience an overwhelming passion, so much so that they are often noticed for their ardent effusions. Determined to address the topic, Anna invites them for an aperitif, but the evening takes a completely unexpected turn. / Thomas e Anna attraversano da tempo una profonda crisi coniugale. programme.title: Docteur Godard, lhomme qui voulait tout quitter
programme.sub-title: The man who wanted to make a new life / Luomo che voleva rifarsi una nuova vita
programme.desc: 1999, Brittany, France. A wonderful September day, the sun is shining and the sea is calm. The case begins with the discovery of a dinghy off the coast, it belongs to a sailing ship chartered in Saint-Malo. In the dinghy are an oilskin pea coat and a checkbook. The sailing ship had been chartered by a doctor with a practice in Caen who then left with his two children without leaving a trace. The authorities search everywhere for the boat and the missing family, in vain. In the van and in the doctor's house the investigators find traces of blood. The blood of Dr. Godard's wife. It is the beginning of a court case that will last over twelve years. The disappearance is shrouded in mystery, various clues are found in the sea in an inexplicable way. Is this a suicide disguised as a shipwreck? / 1999, Bretagna, Francia. Una meravigliosa giornata di settembre, splende il sole e il mare è calmo. Il caso inizia con la scoperta di un gommone al largo della costa, appartiene a un veliero noleggiato a Saint-Malo. Nel gommone ci sono una giacca da marinaio di tela cerata e un libretto degli assegni. Il veliero era stato noleggiato da un medico con studio a Caen che poi è partito con i suoi due bambini senza lasciare traccia. Le autorità cercano ovunque la barca e la famiglia scomparsa, invano. Nel furgone e nellabitazione del dottore gli inquirenti trovano tracce di sangue. Il sangue della moglie del dottor Godard. È linizio di un caso giudiziario che durerà oltre dodici anni. La scomparsa è avvolta nel mistero, vari indizi vengono ritrovati in mare in maniera inspiegabile. Si tratta di un suicidio mascherato da naufragio?

programme.title: Docteur Godard, lhomme qui voulait tout quitter
programme.sub-title: The man who wanted to make a new life / Luomo che voleva rifarsi una nuova vita
programme.desc: The second episode opens with a turning point in the investigation, the investigators receive an anonymous letter. According to the mysterious informant, Doctor Godard and his two children are alive and on the Isle of Man, in the Irish Sea. The French gendarmes go to the scene and collect the testimonies of various people who confirm the presence of the fugitive. A hotel manager claims to have seen him in the company of a blonde woman. But the track is a dead end. According to Jean-Paul Aubry, of the research section of the Rennes gendarmerie, to find the reason for the escape one must dig into the doctor's life and past. The investigations reveal the complex character of Doctor Godard, a shady man with multiple and surprising facets, a proponent of alternative medicine, passionate about esotericism and very close to a sect that may have helped him stage his disappearance. / Il secondo episodio si apre con una svolta nellinchiesta, gli inquirenti ricevono una lettera anonima. Secondo linformatore misterioso il dottor Godard e i suoi due bambini sono vivi e si trovano sullIsola di Man, nel Mar dIrlanda. I gendarmi francesi vanno sul posto e raccolgono le testimonianze di varie persone che confermano la presenza del fuggitivo. Un direttore dalbergo afferma di averlo visto in compagnia di una donna bionda. Ma la pista è un vicolo cieco. Secondo Jean-Paul Aubry, della sezione ricerche della gendarmeria di Rennes, per trovare il motivo della fuga bisogna scavare nella vita e nel passato del dottore. Le indagini svelano la complessità caratteriale del dottor Godard, un uomo ombroso dalle molteplici e sorprendenti sfaccettature, fautore della medicina alternativa, appassionato di esoterismo e molto vicino a una setta che potrebbe averlo aiutato nel mettere in scena la sua scomparsa.

programme.title: Quando sboccia lamore
programme.desc: Rory, a young public relations professional arrives at a picturesque BandB for her parents' wedding anniversary. Where she meets the ex who broke her heart with his new girlfriend, in a panic she pretends that the owner of BandB is her boyfriend. / Rory, una giovane professionista delle pubbliche relazioni arriva in un pittoresco BandB per lanniversario di matrimonio dei suoi genitori. Dove incontra lex che le ha spezzato il cuore con la sua nuova ragazza, in preda al panico finge che il proprietario del BandB sia il suo ragazzo.

programme.title: The lady in yellow / La signora in giallo
programme.desc: Murder, She Wrote (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American crime drama series starring Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. It aired weekly on CBS from 1984 to 1996 and continued, with several TV movies, until 2003 (such as Sleeper Murder, The Rime of the Lost Boy and Appointment with Death). Angela Lansbury served as the show's executive producer in its final seasons. Jessica Fletcher is a perspicacious mystery writer, who often finds herself dealing with mysterious murders, for which she always manages to discover the culprit. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small town, the fictional Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of Murder, She Wrote is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the producer's first choice. The part was initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however turned it down. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. È andato in onda settimanalmente sulla CBS dal 1984 al 1996 e continuò, con diversi TV-movie, fino al 2003 (come Vagone letto con omicidio, La ballata del ragazzo perduto e Appuntamento con la morte). Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni. Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. La parte era stato offerta inizialmente a Jean Stapleton e Doris Day, che però rifiutarono.

programme.title: Cuntrasts
programme.sub-title: 104 houses for 104 families – Patricia Scarpatetti and her new village / 104 Hauser fur 104 Familien – Patricia Scarpatetti und ihr neues Dorf
programme.desc: Nino Schurter wants to achieve even more great results in his last year in the mountain bike World Cup. At almost 40 years old, he once again faces the tough professional routine, straining his body, despite knowing that many opponents are even 20 years younger than him and that victories are becoming rarer. Florian Zutt's documentary follows the Graubünden mountain bike legend from the start of the season at the Cape Epic in South Africa, through the World Championships in Valais, up to his last participation in a World Cup race at his home. Once again Nino Schurter gives everything to make his dream of winning in Lenzerheide come true. At the same time, the film allows us to get to know Nino Schurter in his private life, discovering who he is as a person and a father. It's a dive into the environment and family that shaped him. How will the champion be able to detach himself from the life of the professional he has lived for almost 25 years? / Nino Schurter anche nel suo ultimo anno nella Coppa del Mondo di mountain bike vuole raggiungere una volta di più grandi risultati. A quasi 40 anni, affronta ancora una volta la dura routine professionale, sforzando il suo corpo, pur sapendo che molti avversari hanno anche 20 anni meno di lui e che le vittorie diventano più rare.Il documentario di Florian Zutt segue la leggenda grigionese della mountain bike dall’inizio della stagione alla Cape Epic in Sudafrica, passando per i Campionati del Mondo in Vallese, fino alla sua ultima partecipazione a una gara di Coppa del Mondo a casa sua. Ancora una volta Nino Schurter dà tutto per realizzare il sogno di vincere a Lenzerheide.Allo stesso tempo, il film permette di conoscere Nino Schurter nella sua vita privata, scoprendo il suo essere persona e padre. È un tuffo nell’ambiente e nella famiglia che lo hanno plasmato.Come potrà il campione staccarsi dalla vita del professionista che ha vissuto per quasi 25 anni?

programme.title: Millie la Magnifique
programme.desc: Millie is a creative, resourceful and clever 8-year-old girl. With her friends Maya and Ben, and her dog Wallace, she forms a small team always ready to take on the challenges of her neighborhood. Build a pirate ship, a mini-library or a birdhouse... Millie is full of imagination to improve the daily lives of her neighbors. / Millie est une fillette de 8 ans creative, debrouillarde et astucieuse. Avec ses amis Maya et Ben, et son chien Wallace, elle forme une petite equipe toujours prompte à relever les defis de son quartier. Construire un bateau pirate, une mini-bibliothèque ou une cabane à oiseaux… Millie deborde d’imagination pour ameliorer le quotidien de ses voisins.

programme.title: Millie la Magnifique
programme.desc: When Millie realizes she could use a creative space at Dad's house (like the Imaginarium), she and her dad decide to build their own treehouse in the backyard. After a few failed enlargements, Millie and Dad realize that simplicity is often best. They decide to redo their design while keeping everything simple and the cabin is a magnificent success. / Quand Millie realise qu’elle pourrait utiliser un espace de creation chez papa (comme l’Imaginarium), elle et son père decident de construire leur propre cabane dans les arbres dans le jardin. Après quelques agrandissements echoues, Millie et papa se rendent compte que la simplicite est souvent ce qu’il y a de mieux. Ils decident de refaire leur dessin en gardant le tout simple et la cabane est un succès magnifique.

programme.title: Millie la Magnifique
programme.desc: Realizing that Mr. Lin's store could use some sprucing up, Millie, Ben and Alicia decide to surprise him with some new paint. / Se rendant compte que le magasin de M. Lin pourrait etre quelque peu rafraîchi, Millie, Ben et Alicia decident de le surprendre avec de la nouvelle peinture.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Maddie and Triggs are very hungry, but the oven is broken. Luckily, mom knows how to transform fresh produce into a good, balanced dish using the microwave. programme.title: Temps present
programme.sub-title: Harassment, online terror / Harcèlement, la terreur en ligne
programme.desc: It is a well-hidden reality: many people, especially women, are today targeted by strangers who harass and threaten them on social networks. A report by Cedric Louis and Elisabeth Logean. / C’est une realite bien cachee : de nombreuses personnes, surtout des femmes, sont aujourd’hui visees par des inconnus qui les harcèlent et les menacent sur les reseaux sociaux. Et le harcèlement n’est pas encore considere comme une infraction en Suisse ; il n’apparait donc pas dans les statistiques de la criminalite suisse. Ce phenomène est-il sous-estime ? Temps Present est alle à la rencontre de victimes et d’un cyberharceleur.Un reportage de Cedric Louis et Elisabeth Logean.

programme.title: Noir comme neige
programme.desc: In Switzerland, Captain Andreas Meyer narrowly escapes death after receiving a wooden sculpture of a devil with red eyes, an object from Savoyard folklore. Inexplicable coincidence: on the French coast, the same statuette is found by police officer Constance Vivier near the body of Victor Carron, a wood merchant who mysteriously died in an isolated chapel. Sculptor Kate Karswell, the last local artist to make the famous devil statuettes, becomes the main suspect, while evil forces attack Andreas and Constance...They join forces to shed light on this dark affair which will lead them to investigate a series of increasingly strange incidents: cell phone explosion, pacemaker failure, GPS malfunction... Curse or manipulation? / En Suisse, le capitaine Andreas Meyer echappe de peu à la mort après avoir reçu une sculpture en bois dun diable aux yeux rouges, objet issu du folklore savoyard. Coïncidence inexplicable : côte franç̧ais, une même statuette est retrouvee par la gendarme Constance Vivier près du corps de Victor Carron, un negociant en bois mysterieusement decede dans une chapelle isolee.La sculptrice Kate Karswell, dernière artiste locale à confectionner les fameuses statuettes de diable, devient la principale suspecte, tandis que des forces malfaisantes s’acharnent sur Andreas et Constance...Ils unissent leurs efforts pour eclaircir cette tenebreuse affaire qui va les amener à enqueter sur une serie dincidents de plus en plus etranges : explosion de portable, panne de pacemaker, dysfonctionnement de GPS... Malediction ou manipulation ?

programme.title: La profileuse

programme.title: La profileuse
programme.sub-title: The Phoenix Strangler 1/2 / LÉtrangleur de Phoenix 1/2
programme.desc: Micki Pistorius has to deal with a new affair that upsets her. A man kills women after raping them and abandons the bodies in a sugar cane field. The process is violent and constantly repeated and improved. Micki manages to establish a precise profile and the testimony of the sister of one of the victims makes it possible to establish a robot portrait / Micki Pistorius doit soccuper dune nouvelle affaire qui la bouleverse. Un homme tue des femmes après les avoir violees et abandonne les corps dans un champ de cannes à sucre. Le procede est violent et sans cesse repete et ameliore. Micki arrive a etablir un profil precis et le temoignage de la sœur dune des victimes permet detablir un portrait robot

Why is he suddenly so dissatisfied? Very simple: the noon demon. / Film diffuse en VOSTToni Faller va bien. programme.title: A bon entendeur
programme.sub-title: My apple is beautiful / Elle est belle ma pomme
programme.desc: It is perhaps the Swiss’ favorite fruit: the apple. Green, red, sweet, tangy, to chew or to cook, we enjoy it all year round. Local production is important, but also very demanding, whether organic or integrated. Farmers must constantly combat pests and fungi to produce attractive and beautiful fruits. “A word to the wise” wanted to know what treatments are necessary to obtain an organic apple or a conventional apple. Report and comparison at two producers, in Bramois (VS) and Lully (GE), Tuesday at 8:10 p.m. on RTS1. / C’est peut-etre le fruit prefere des Suisses : la pomme. Verte, rouge, sucree, acidulee, à croquer ou à cuire, on la deguste tout au long de l’annee. La production locale est importante, mais egalement très exigeante, qu’elle soit biologique ou integree. Les agriculteurs doivent constamment lutter contre les ravageurs et les champignons pour produire des fruits attrayants et beaux. « À bon entendeur » a voulu savoir quels traitements sont necessaires pour obtenir une pomme bio ou une pomme conventionnelle. Reportage et comparaison chez deux producteurs, à Bramois (VS) et à Lully (GE), mardi à 20h10 sur RTS1.

programme.title: Temps present
programme.desc: Lausanne, the poisonous legacy of dioxin: Dioxin pollution discovered in Lausanne in 2020 is one of the most serious in Europe. What are the people of Lausanne who have been exposed to the responsible incinerator at risk today? Should they fear developing cancer or serious consequences for their children? Residents today live in fear and demand accountability. Exclusively for Temps Present, European experts cast doubt on the reassuring words of the Vaudois authorities. / Lausanne, l’heritage empoisonne de la dioxine: Une pollution à la dioxine decouverte à Lausanne en 2020 est l’une des plus grave d’Europe. Que risquent aujourd’hui les Lausannois qui ont ete exposes à l’incinerateur responsable? Doivent-ils craindre de developper un cancer ou de graves consequences pour leurs enfants ? Des habitants vivent aujourd’hui dans la peur et exigent des comptes. En exclusivite pour Temps Present, des experts europeens mettent en doute les propos rassurants des autorites vaudoises.

programme.title: Focus / Mise au point
programme.desc: Drone alert: is Switzerland ready?: Mysterious drones flying over Danish airports and military bases just before a European summit in Copenhagen which notably focuses on an anti-drone wall. Russia is suspect number and every country including Switzerland wonders how it would react to an intrusion. Report.Investigation: cargo ships sent to India to be dismantled: What happens to cargo ships and cruise ships when they are no longer seaworthy? Very few are dismantled in Europe, a large part of the fleet leaves for India where they are dismantled by an army of small, cheap hands in very relative safety conditions. Agriculture of the future: growing vertically or under the sea: A hangar near Zurich, inside the stacks of bins where some of our aromatic herbs now grow. We call it a vertical farm and it embodies the future of agriculture, just like perhaps this underwater structure that grows basil near Genoa. / Alerte aux drones : la Suisse est-elle prete ?: De mysterieux drones qui survolent des aeroports et des bases militaires danois juste avant un sommet europeen à Copenhague qui porte notamment sur un mur anti-drones. La Russie est le suspect numero et chaque pays dont la Suisse se demande comment il reagirait face à une intrusion. Reportage.Enquete : des cargos envoyes en Inde pour etre demanteles: Que deviennent les cargos et les bateaux de croisière quand ils ne sont plus en etat de naviguer ? Très peu sont demanteles en Europe, une grosse partie de la flotte part pour l’Inde où ils sont demontes par une armee de petites mains bon marche dans des conditions de securite très relatives.Agriculture du futur : cultiver vertical ou sous la mer: Un hangar proche de Zurich, à l’interieur des piles de bacs où pousse desormais une partie de nos herbes aromatiques. On appelle ça une ferme verticale et cela incarne le futur de l’agriculture, tout comme peut-etre cette structure sous-marine qui cultive du basilic près de Genes.

programme.title: Les Simpson
programme.desc: The most famous cult animated series on the small screen, multi-awarded, and adored all over the world, is finally coming to your home! Created by Matt Groening (who named the characters after members of his own family, with the exception of Bart), The Simpsons was first broadcast at Christmas in 1989, then was scheduled on a regular basis from January 1990. The series then enjoyed enormous success, with viewers and critics agreeing that it was the most realistic - and funniest - portrayal of of the basic American family. The Simpsons live in a nice house in Springfield. First there is Homer, the father of the family addicted to donuts, a specialist in bad advice and disasters of all kinds, particularly at his workplace, the city's nuclear power plant. His wife, Marge, is a mother and wife totally devoted to her family who sports a particularly imposing blue hairstyle. Their 10-year-old eldest son, Bart, does as he pleases. A true dunce, he does one stupid thing after another, to the great despair of his younger sister Lisa, 8 years old, a gifted child, a philosopher at heart and a seasoned saxophonist. Finally, little Maggy supports her family in silence, showing her emotions only through the noises she makes with her pacifier. The series was created by Matt Groening and developed by James L. Brooks, Matt Groening and Sam Simon. James L. Brooks and Matt Groening are executive producers. Al Jean and Matt Selman also serve as executive producers and showrunners on the series. / La serie animee culte la plus celèbre du petit ecran, multi-recompensee, et adoree dans le monde entier, debarque enfin chez vous ! Creee par Matt Groening (qui a nomme les personnages daprès les membres de sa propre famille, à lexception de Bart), Les Simpson a ete diffusee la première fois à Noël, en 1989, puis a ete programmee de façon regulière dès janvier 1990. La serie a alors connu un enorme succès, les telespectateurs et les critiques setant accordes à dire quelle etait le portrait le plus realiste - et le plus drôle - de la famille americaine de base. Les Simpson habitent dans un joli pavillon à Springfield. Il y a dabord Homer, le père de famille accro aux donuts, specialiste des mauvais conseils et des catastrophes en tous genres, notamment sur son lieu de travail, la centrale nucleaire de la ville. Sa femme, Marge, est quant à elle une mère et une epouse totalement devouee à sa famille qui arbore une coiffure bleue particulièrement imposante. Leur fils aine de 10 ans, Bart, nen fait quà sa tete. Veritable cancre, il enchaîne les betises au grand desespoir de sa sœur cadette Lisa, 8 ans, enfant surdouee, philosophe dans lâme et saxophoniste aguerrie. Enfin, la petite Maggy supporte sa famille en silence, manifestant ses emotions uniquement grâce aux bruits quelle fait avec sa tetine. La serie a ete creee par Matt Groening et developpee par James L. Brooks, Matt Groening et Sam Simon. James L. Brooks et Matt Groening en sont les producteurs delegues. Al Jean et Matt Selman sont egalement producteurs delegues et showrunners de la serie.

programme.title: Humour
programme.sub-title: Antonia de Rendinger – Me Game! / Antonia de Rendinger – Moi Jeu !
programme.desc: It’s certain that when she grows up, little Antonia will be a huge artist, adored all over the world! Well yes: from comedy to tragedy, this kid loves to act, sing, speak 8 languages ​​and make people laugh. So Antonia plays, has fun, flourishes! Developed from reworked improvisations, this show in unconditional freedom marks a break with previous ones: it is no longer one story that she tells us but ten, which are linked together like so many pearls on a necklace. The stage becomes a real playroom where more than 20 characters meet, from the young mother overwhelmed by shared custody to the old school SVT teacher, including a tragic Cleopatra. Social diversity, the cult of Brel, Bluebeard or female pleasure throughout the world are all themes that this new opus addresses. Heir to Sylvie Joly, Zouk, Albert Dupontel, or Philippe Caubère, Antonia handles madness and takes care of the text, the acting and the content with exhilarating demand and exuberance! / C’est sûr, quand elle sera grande, la petite Antonia sera une immense artiste, adulee dans le monde entier ! Bah oui : de la comedie à la tragedie, cette gamine aime jouer, chanter, parler 8 langues et faire rire. Alors Antonia joue, s’amuse, s’epanouit !Élabore à partir d’improvisations retravaillees, ce spectacle en liberte inconditionnelle marque une rupture avec les precedents : ce n’est plus une histoire qu’elle nous raconte mais dix, qui s’enchaînent comme autant de perles sur un collier. La scène devient une veritable salle de jeu où se croisent plus de 20 personnages, de la jeune maman depassee par la garde partagee à la prof de SVT old school, en passant par une Cleopâtre tragedienne. La mixite sociale, le culte de Brel, Barbe bleue ou le plaisir feminin à travers le monde sont autant de thèmes qu’aborde ce nouvel opus.Heritière de Sylvie Joly, Zouk, Albert Dupontel, ou Philippe Caubère, Antonia manie la folie et soigne le texte, le jeu et le fond avec une exigence et une exuberance jouissives !

But six years later, Hikari, Asato's biological mother, contacts them and asks to have her child back. / Alors qu’ils se decident à avoir un enfant, Satoko et son mari Kiyokaz decouvrent quils ne pourront pas car Kiyokaz est sterile. Après une douloureuse periode de doutes et de remise en question, ils choisissent d’adopter. Asato entre alors dans leur famille, et grandit heureux, entoure par des parents aimants. programme.title: Focus / Mise au point
programme.desc: Drone alert: is Switzerland ready?: Mysterious drones flying over Danish airports and military bases just before a European summit in Copenhagen which notably focuses on an anti-drone wall. Russia is suspect number and every country including Switzerland wonders how it would react to an intrusion. Report.Investigation: cargo ships sent to India to be dismantled: What happens to cargo ships and cruise ships when they are no longer seaworthy? Very few are dismantled in Europe, a large part of the fleet leaves for India where they are dismantled by an army of small, cheap hands in very relative safety conditions. Agriculture of the future: growing vertically or under the sea: A hangar near Zurich, inside the stacks of bins where some of our aromatic herbs now grow. We call it a vertical farm and it embodies the future of agriculture, just like perhaps this underwater structure that grows basil near Genoa. / Alerte aux drones : la Suisse est-elle prete ?: De mysterieux drones qui survolent des aeroports et des bases militaires danois juste avant un sommet europeen à Copenhague qui porte notamment sur un mur anti-drones. La Russie est le suspect numero et chaque pays dont la Suisse se demande comment il reagirait face à une intrusion. Reportage.Enquete : des cargos envoyes en Inde pour etre demanteles: Que deviennent les cargos et les bateaux de croisière quand ils ne sont plus en etat de naviguer ? Très peu sont demanteles en Europe, une grosse partie de la flotte part pour l’Inde où ils sont demontes par une armee de petites mains bon marche dans des conditions de securite très relatives.Agriculture du futur : cultiver vertical ou sous la mer: Un hangar proche de Zurich, à l’interieur des piles de bacs où pousse desormais une partie de nos herbes aromatiques. On appelle ça une ferme verticale et cela incarne le futur de l’agriculture, tout comme peut-etre cette structure sous-marine qui cultive du basilic près de Genes.

programme.title: Temps present
programme.sub-title: Harassment, online terror / Harcèlement, la terreur en ligne
programme.desc: It is a well-hidden reality: many people, especially women, are today targeted by strangers who harass and threaten them on social networks. Women who the police sometimes dissuade from filing a complaint because everything happens online, in a virtual world, yet their fear is very real. And harassment is not yet considered an offense in Switzerland; it therefore does not appear in Swiss crime statistics. Is this phenomenon underestimated? Temps Present went to meet victims and a cyberstalker. A report by Cedric Louis and Elisabeth Logean. / C’est une realite bien cachee : de nombreuses personnes, surtout des femmes, sont aujourd’hui visees par des inconnus qui les harcèlent et les menacent sur les reseaux sociaux. Des femmes que la police dissuade parfois de porter plainte car tout se passe en ligne, dans un monde virtuel, pourtant leur peur est bien reelle. Et le harcèlement n’est pas encore considere comme une infraction en Suisse ; il n’apparait donc pas dans les statistiques de la criminalite suisse. Ce phenomène est-il sous-estime ? Temps Present est alle à la rencontre de victimes et d’un cyberharceleur.Un reportage de Cedric Louis et Elisabeth Logean.

programme.title: Objectif Monde Lhebdo
programme.sub-title: Tourism in the land of war / Tourisme au pays de la guerre
programme.desc: Since the invasion of Ukrainian territory by Russia, Ukraine has become a favored destination for dark tourism, or “thanatourism”. Agencies offer tourists the opportunity to visit places where death has left its mark for a low cost. Afghanistan, Mexico, North Korea but also Iraqi Kurdistan are among the popular destinations. Karim Amin was able to follow these Swiss people, fans of travel like no other, for the magazine Mise au Point on the RTS. / Depuis l’invasion du territoire ukrainien par la Russie, l’Ukraine est devenue une destination privilegiee du tourisme noir, ou “thanatourisme”. Des agences proposent à des touristes de se rendre pour un coût modique des lieux où la mort a laisse des traces. programme.title: Die Aquarium-Profis
programme.desc: Big, bigger, biggest! Commercially available indoor aquariums are also nice, but Wayde King and his partner Brett Raymer have little to do with 10-liter tanks. Her specialty is breathtaking underwater worlds! From the octagonal ecosystem with morays and stingrays to the telephone booth aquarium to the shark tank for the doctor's office: there is almost no idea that the boys don't dare to try. Accordingly, the motto of the two New Yorkers is: What others dream of, we make it happen! And their super aquariums not only appeal to the underwater inhabitants, but also to the public. Wherever Brett and Wayde present their impressive custom-made products to the public, people cannot help but be amazed. / GroSS, groSSer, am groSSten! Handelsubliche Zimmer-Aquarien sind auch nett, doch mit 10-Liter-Becken haben Wayde King und sein Partner Brett Raymer wenig am Hut. Ihr Spezialgebiet sind atemberaubende Unterwasserwelten! Vom achteckigen Ökosystem mit Muranen und Stachelrochen uber das Telefonzellen-Aquarium bis zum Haifisch-Tank fur die Arztpraxis: Es gibt fast keine Idee, an die sich die Jungs nicht herantrauen. Dementsprechend lautet das Motto der beiden New Yorker: Wovon andere traumen, setzen wir in die Tat um! Und ihre Super-Aquarien gefallen nicht nur den Unterwasserbewohnern ausgesprochen gut, sondern auch dem Publikum. Wo immer Brett und Wayde ihre beeindruckenden Spezialanfertigungen der Öffentlichkeit prasentieren, kommen die Leute aus dem Staunen nicht heraus.

programme.title: Mountain Life - dream home wanted / Mountain Life - Traumhaus gesucht
programme.desc: From the forested peaks of the Blue Ridge Mountains in the eastern Appalachians to Bald Mountain with its magnificent alpine sports, the high mountain village of Midway in Utah and the picturesque peaks of the Rockies to Hawaii's tropical Mauna Loa: There are numerous remote mountain towns in the United States that hardly anyone knows about. They are the perfect retreat for stressed city dwellers and exhausted families fleeing traffic chaos, hustle and bustle and pollution. And just as the mountain destinations are different, the properties are also different, because, depending on budgets and availability, there is almost everything - from a rustic log cabin with a wood stove to a bamboo bungalow with a view of the volcano to a fully glazed design property with a private spa. The documentary series follows mountain fans on their search for their dream home. / Von den bewaldeten Bergkuppen der Blue Ridge Mountains im Osten der Appalachen uber Bald Mountain mit seinen grandiosen Alpinsportmoglichkeiten, das Hochgebirgsdorf Midway in Utah und die malerischen Gipfel der Rockies bis zu Hawaiis tropischem Mauna Loa: In den Vereinigten Staaten gibt es zahlreiche abgelegene Gebirgsorte, die kaum jemand kennt. Sie sind der perfekte Ruckzugsort fur gestresste Stadter und erschopfte Familien, die vor Verkehrschaos, Hektik und Umweltverschmutzung fluchten. Und so unterschiedlich die Mountain-Destinationen sind, so verschieden sind auch die Immobilien, denn, abhangig von Budgets und Verfugbarkeit gibt es fast alles - von der rustikalen Blockhutte mit Holzofen uber den Bambus-Bungalow mit Vulkanblick bis hin zum vollverglasten Designobjekt mit privatem Spa. Die Doku-Serie begleitet Berg-Fans bei ihrer Suche nach dem Traumhaus.

programme.title: Mountain Men - Wilderness Survival / Mountain Men - Überleben in der Wildnis
programme.desc: Three men have decided to dedicate their lives to simple survival. And it's not as simple as it sounds at first. Without any connection to modern life, they spend their time in the harsh mountain world of America, fighting hungry animals, mudslides, storms and falling trees to get what they need to survive. / Drei Manner haben sich entschieden, ihr Leben dem simplen Überleben zu widmen. Und das nicht so simpel wie es im ersten Moment klingt. Ohne jedwede Verbindung zum modernen Leben verbringen sie ihre Zeit in der rauen Bergwelt Amerikas, kampfen mit hungrigen Tieren, Schlammlawinen, Unwetter und fallenden Baumen um sich selber zu beschaffen, was sie zum Leben brauchen.

programme.title: King of Queens
programme.desc: Doug has a bad toothache. The only thing that can help is a root canal treatment, says his dentist, Dr. Farber. Unfortunately, Farber recently found out that his former babysitter, Carrie, used to be hooked on him. In Doug's presence, the now-divorced doctor thinks about what his life would be like if he had noticed Carrie's crush. Doug panics: he thinks Farber was torturing him because of it. / Doug hat starke Zahnschmerzen. Da hilft nur noch eine Wurzelbehandlung, meint sein Zahnarzt Dr. Farber. Dummerweise hat Farber vor Kurzem herausgefunden, dass seine ehemalige Babysitterin Carrie fruher Feuer und Flamme fur ihn war. In Dougs Anwesenheit uberlegt der mittlerweile geschiedene Arzt, wie sein Leben wohl aussahe, wenn er Carries Schwarmerei bemerkt hatte. Doug gerat in Panik: Er glaubt, Farber wurde ihn deshalb foltern.

programme.title: Die Aquarium-Profis
programme.desc: The Geraldi family resides on a luxurious property in Florida. There, patriarch Phil and his six sons already have a clear idea of ​​which aquatic roommates they would like to have: alligators and sharks! However, the former live in SuSS water and the latter in salt water. The solution? A huge two-part tank in which both predator species feel comfortable and don't get in the way. Also on the agenda is the 50th anniversary of a caravan company in Vegas. For this special occasion, the boss wants a walk-in camper aquarium with a wow factor. / In Florida residiert Familie Geraldi auf einem luxuriosen Anwesen. Dort haben Patriarch Phil und seine sechs Sohne bereits eine genaue Vorstellung, welche aquatischen Mitbewohner sie gerne hatten: Alligatoren und Haie! Allerdings leben erstere im SuSS-, letztere im Salzwasser. Die Losung? Ein riesiges zweigeteiltes Becken, in dem sich beide Raubtierspezies wohlfuhlen und nicht in die Quere kommen. AuSSerdem steht das 50-jahrige Jubilaum einer Wohnwagenfirma in Vegas auf dem Programm. Zu diesem besonderen Anlass wunscht sich der Boss ein begehbares Camper-Aquarium mit Wow-Effekt.

programme.title: Fruhling
programme.desc: Mark causes a serious accident with a horse. The young rider Charlotte then obliges the veterinarian to nurse her stallion back to health. The girl's request is explosive because Charlotte's mother Luisa is against treating the horse for some unknown reason. She seems to downright hate the animal. Mark suggests taking the stallion into his home for the duration of the treatment. Luisa Gossner's hatred is based on the fact that her husband died in an accident with the stallion Henry a year ago and she blames the horse for it. This doesn't stop Mark, with Filippa's support, from taking care of Henry, who himself feels his owner's rejection and suffers from it. When Mark learns by chance that Luisa blames herself for her husband's accident, he realizes that it could be important for people and horses to find each other again. Meanwhile, Katja supports the doctor Dr. Schneiderhahn, who has now become a friend to Katja. Schneiderhahn's mother Elisa has a brain tumor and doesn't have long to live. While caring for the old woman, Katja learns of her last wish: she wants to go to the “Ellenbogen” again on the island of Sylt, the northernmost spot in Germany. Elisa's memories of her late husband, her great love - and happy family times are associated with this place. Katja and Dr. Together, Schneiderhahn hatch a plan to fulfill Elisa's last wish. With Professor Gabriel's support, they organize an ambulance and crew and make their way to the sea together with the old lady and Pastor Sonnleitner. / Mark verursacht einen folgenschweren Unfall mit einem Pferd. Die junge Reiterin Charlotte verpflichtet den Tierarzt daraufhin, ihren Hengst wieder gesund zu pflegen. Brisanz hat die Bitte des Madchens, weil Charlottes Mutter Luisa aus unerfindlichem Grund gegen eine Behandlung des Pferdes ist. Sie scheint das Tier geradezu zu hassen. Mark schlagt vor, den Hengst fur die Dauer der Behandlung bei sich zu Hause aufzunehmen. Luisa Gossners Hass liegt darin begrundet, dass ihr Mann vor einem Jahr bei einem Unfall mit dem Hengst Henry ums Leben kam und sie dem Pferd die Schuld daran gibt. Mark hindert das nicht, sich mit Filippas Unterstutzung aufopfernd um Henry zu kummern, der selbst die Ablehnung seiner Besitzerin spurt und darunter leidet. Als Mark durch Zufall erfahrt, dass Luisa sich durchaus selbst eine Mitschuld am Unfall ihres Mannes gibt, wird ihm klar, dass es fur Mensch und Pferd wichtig sein konnte, wieder zueinanderzufinden. Wahrenddessen unterstutzt Katja die Ärztin Dr. Schneiderhahn, die inzwischen fur Katja zu einer Freundin geworden ist. Schneiderhahns Mutter Elisa hat einen Hirntumor und nicht mehr lange zu leben. Bei der Pflege der alten Frau erfahrt Katja von deren letztem Wunsch: Sie will noch einmal an den „Ellenbogen“ auf der Insel Sylt, dem nordlichsten Fleck Deutschlands. Mit diesem Ort verbinden sich Erinnerungen Elisas an ihren verstorbenen Mann, ihre grosse Liebe – und an gluckliche Familienzeiten. Katja und Dr. Schneiderhahn hecken gemeinsam einen Plan aus, um Elisa ihren letzten Wunsch zu erfullen. Mit Professor Gabriels Unterstutzung organisieren sie einen Rettungswagen samt Besatzung und machen sich gemeinsam mit der alten Dame sowie Pfarrer Sonnleitner auf den Weg ans Meer.

programme.title: Cold Blood

programme.title: Die Aquarium-Profis
programme.desc: The Geraldi family resides on a luxurious property in Florida. There, patriarch Phil and his six sons already have a clear idea of ​​which aquatic roommates they would like to have: alligators and sharks! However, the former live in SuSS water and the latter in salt water. The solution? A huge two-part tank in which both predator species feel comfortable and don't get in the way. Also on the agenda is the 50th anniversary of a caravan company in Vegas. For this special occasion, the boss wants a walk-in camper aquarium with a wow factor. / In Florida residiert Familie Geraldi auf einem luxuriosen Anwesen. Dort haben Patriarch Phil und seine sechs Sohne bereits eine genaue Vorstellung, welche aquatischen Mitbewohner sie gerne hatten: Alligatoren und Haie! Allerdings leben erstere im SuSS-, letztere im Salzwasser. Die Losung? Ein riesiges zweigeteiltes Becken, in dem sich beide Raubtierspezies wohlfuhlen und nicht in die Quere kommen. AuSSerdem steht das 50-jahrige Jubilaum einer Wohnwagenfirma in Vegas auf dem Programm. Zu diesem besonderen Anlass wunscht sich der Boss ein begehbares Camper-Aquarium mit Wow-Effekt.

programme.title: Die Aquarium-Profis
programme.desc: Today the aquarium professionals are taking on a sporting challenge. In Lafayette, California, they meet with Mark Mastrov, who made his fortune with a thriving fitness chain. Now the businessman is expanding his private house and wants a handsome aquarium. No problem for Wayde and Brett, who only know fitness studios from outside. A hexagonal underwater habitat is also to be designed for a casino in the state of Alabama. A special eye-catcher will be a true-to-scale replica of the historic “Middle Bay Lighthouse”. / Heute nehmen die Aquarium-Profis eine sportliche Herausforderung an. In Lafayette, Kalifornien, treffen sie sich mit Mark Mastrov, der sein Vermogen mit einer florierenden Fitnesskette gemacht hat. Jetzt vergroSSert der Geschaftsmann sein Privathaus und wunscht sich dafur ein ansehnliches Aquarium. Kein Problem fur Wayde und Brett, die Fitnessstudios allerdings sonst nur von drauSSen kennen. Fur ein Casino im Bundesstaat Alabama soll zudem ein hexagonales Unterwasser-Habitat designt werden. Ein besonderer Blickfang wird dabei eine maSSstabsgetreue Replika des historischen "Middle Bay Lighthouse".

programme.title: Ritter aus Leidenschaft
programme.desc: The simple squire William Thatcher dreams of a life as a noble knight. When his master suddenly dies, William puts on his armor and from then on takes part in the jousting games. But one day the fraud threatens to be exposed. / Der einfache Knappe William Thatcher traumt von einem Leben als edler Ritter. Als sein Herr plotzlich verstirbt, zieht William dessen Rustung an und nimmt fortan an den Ritterspielen teil. Doch eines Tages droht der Schwindel aufzufliegen.

programme.title: Der letzte Tempelritter
programme.desc: The two Templar Knights Behmen von Bleibruck and Felson desert and return to Europe. There they are recognized and arrested. To avoid punishment, they accept a sensitive assignment from the cardinal. / Die beiden Tempelritter Behmen von Bleibruck und Felson desertieren und kehren nach Europa zuruck. Dort werden sie erkannt und festgenommen. Um ihrer Bestrafung zu entgehen, nehmen sie einen heiklen Auftrag des Kardinals an.

programme.title: Lieber Thomas
programme.desc: The GDR is still young, but Thomas Brasch no longer fits in. Above all, it is his father Horst who, as a party official, wants to help build the new German state. But Thomas, the eldest son, would rather be a writer. Thomas is a dreamer, an obsessive and a rebel. His first play was banned and he was soon expelled from film school. When the Soviet tanks rolled through Prague in 1968, Brasch protested with his girlfriend Sanda and other students with a leaflet campaign in the streets of Berlin - and ran into the wall. His own father betrayed him, and Thomas Brasch went to prison. Released on parole, Brasch works in a factory and writes about love, revolt and death. But you can't do anything with someone like him in the GDR. He falls in love with Katarina Thalbach, who is newly married to someone else, and writes a play for her. With no prospect of making his works available to the East German audience, Thomas leaves his homeland - together with Katarina, whom he was ultimately able to win over. He is initially acclaimed in the West, makes several films and is invited to Cannes twice. Thalbach can hardly save himself from engagements. A new life - characterized by money, parties and drugs. But Brasch doesn't want to see his art sold as a commodity. Even after the fall of the Wall, back in East Berlin, he is far from calm. / Die DDR ist noch jung, aber Thomas Brasch passt schon nicht mehr rein. Es ist vor allem sein Vater Horst, der als Parteifunktionar den neuen deutschen Staat mit aufbauen will. Doch Thomas, der alteste Sohn, will lieber Schriftsteller werden. Thomas ist ein Traumer, ein Besessener und ein Rebell. Schon sein erstes Stuck wird verboten, und bald fliegt er auch von der Filmhochschule. Als 1968 die sowjetischen Panzer durch Prag rollen, protestiert Brasch mit seiner Freundin Sanda und anderen Studenten mit einer Flugblattaktion in den StraSSen Berlins - und rennt vor die Wand.Sein eigener Vater verrat ihn, und Thomas Brasch kommt ins Gefangnis. Auf Bewahrung entlassen, arbeitet Brasch in einer Fabrik und schreibt uber die Liebe, die Revolte und den Tod. Aber mit einem wie ihm kann man in der DDR nichts anfangen. Er verliebt sich in die frisch mit einem anderen verheiratete Katarina Thalbach und schreibt ihr ein Theaterstuck auf den Leib. Ohne Aussicht, seine Werke dem ostdeutschen Publikum zuganglich machen zu konnen, verlasst Thomas die Heimat - zusammen mit Katarina, die er letztendlich fur sich gewinnen konnte.Im Westen wird er anfangs bejubelt, dreht mehrere Kinofilme, wird zweimal nach Cannes eingeladen. Thalbach kann sich vor Engagements kaum retten. Ein neues Leben - gepragt von Geld, Partys und Drogen. Doch Brasch will seine Kunst nicht als Ware verkauft sehen. Auch nach dem Mauerfall, zuruck in Ostberlin, ist er weit davon entfernt, Ruhe zu geben.

programme.title: Kassensturz
programme.desc: Overpriced help - emergency tradesmen take advantage of it. The drain is clogged and the shower is in danger of flooding, or the apartment door can no longer be opened: some emergency tradesmen shamelessly exploit such emergencies and rip off customers with exorbitant prices. Because of the Artiflex company alone, numerous dissatisfied viewers reported to “Kassenrutsch”. The “Kassen Rush” legal expert gives tips on how to avoid such cost traps. “Are you allowed to do that?” – Attach cat net to the balconyIn the series “Is that allowed?” “Kassenrutsch” legal expert Gabriela Baumgartner answers legal questions from everyday life. A spectator put a cat net on the balcony. The administration wants to ban this. Is she allowed to? Test dog crates - not all of them are safe for four-legged friends. Dogs only travel safely in the car in a dog crate. This protects both the animals and the passengers traveling with them in the event of an accident. “Kassenrutsch” and TCS tested nine dog boxes for cars: The crash test shows that some of the tested models are dangerous for dogs and passengers in the event of a collision. / Überteuerte Hilfe – Notfallhandwerkerinnen zocken abAbfluss verstopft und die Dusche droht zu uberschwemmen, oder die Wohnungsture lasst sich nicht mehr offnen: Solche Notlagen nutzen manche Notfallhandwerker schamlos aus und zocken Kundinnen mit uberrissenen Preisen ab. Allein wegen der Firma Artiflex meldeten sich zahlreiche unzufriedene Zuschauerinnen und Zuschauer bei «Kassensturz». Die «Kassensturz»-Rechtsexpertin gibt Tipps, wie sich solche Kostenfallen vermeiden lassen.«Darf man das?» – Katzennetz am Balkon anbringenIn der Serie «Darf man das?» beantwortet «Kassensturz»-Rechtsexpertin Gabriela Baumgartner Rechtsfragen aus dem Alltag. Eine Zuschauerin hat ein Katzennetz am Balkon angebracht. Die Verwaltung will dies verbieten. Darf sie das?Test Hundeboxen – Nicht alle sind sicher fur VierbeinerHunde reisen im Auto nur in einer Hunde-Box wirklich sicher. Diese schutzt bei einem Unfall sowohl die Tiere wie auch die mitfahrenden Passagiere. «Kassensturz» und TCS haben neun Hundeboxen furs Auto getestet: Der Crashtest zeigt: Einige der getesteten Modelle sind bei einem Aufprall gefahrlich fur Hund und Mitfahrende.

programme.title: Sternstunde Philosophie

programme.desc: Two years after the terrorist attack on October 7th, violence continues to escalate. Millions of displaced people, famine, unfreed hostages, irreconcilable desire for destruction. How can we think of a protective way out: for Israel, the Palestinians, international humanitarian law? / Zwei Jahre nach der Terrorattacke des 7. Oktober eskaliert die Gewalt weiter. Millionen vertriebene Menschen, Hungersnot, unbefreite Geiseln, unversohnlicher Zerstorungswille. Wie lasst sich ein schutzender Ausweg denken: fur Israel, die Palastinenser, das humanitare Volkerrecht?
